nas legs 'ongs khrid de 'phags pa dang / legs 'ongs kyang de dang lhan cig 'phags so/ /ji tsam na don mthun de dag 'thab par brtsamasanyeshing glang dag kyang 'thab par brtsamasalgenas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag sngan cad gcig gis gcig mthong na snying du sdug na deng bdag cag gcig gis gcig mthong na 'thab par brtsams shing laglang dag kyang gcig gis gcig mthong na 'thab par rtsom pa las na④/ ma la 'dir 0nyes 'ongs de ma 'ongs sam zhes bltas pa dang / ji tsam na de dag gis legs 'ongs der 'ongs pa mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ni legs 'ongs ma yin gyi nyes 'ongs ༷yin te/ 'di'i le lan gyis bdag cag 'thab par brtsams shing / glang dag kyang 'thab par rtsom mo zhes de dag gis de bskrad par brtsams pa dang / khyim bdag des smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ni kho bo'i chung 0po grogs kyi bu yin gyis 'di lam bskrad cig /de dag gis smras pa/khyim bdag khyod ni don mthun la dbang ba yin mod kyil/ bdag cag 'di dang lhan cig 'gro mi phod de/ gal te 'di 'gro na bdag cag mi 'gro'o/ /khyim bdag des legs 'ongs la smras pa/ bu khyod phyi bzhin 'brang zhing shog shig dang〈nye/ kho bos khyod kyi phyir zan gzhag par bya'o/ /legs 'ongs phyi bzhin 'brang zhing 'ong ba na khyim bdag des kyang de'i don du zan 'jog par byed cing kha cig ni sa gzhi la sas g.yogs te 'jog par byed/ kha cig ni shing ljon pa'i yal chag dag la lo ma dag gis g.yogs te 'jog par byed do/ /de'i zanasnyigang dag sa gzhi la sas g.yogs te bzhag pa de dag ni wa dag gis zos/gang dag shing sngon pa'i yal ga dag la lo ma dag gis g.yogs te bzhag pa de 8—52

dag ni bya dgashedang spre'u dag gis zos nas legs 'ongs kyis cung zad ni thob/phal cher mi⑧thob nas de shin tu nyam nga bas 'tsho zhing 'gro'o/ /srid pa tha ma pa'i sems can zag pa zad pa ma thob par bar ma dor rgyun chad cing dus byed par 'gyur ba ni gnas ma yin skabs ma yin te/ de ni gnas med pas legs 'ongs mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas/ mnyan yod kyi phyi rol khron pa'i kha na ngal sosazhing 'dug go/ /legs 'ongs kyi sring mo khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi mna' ma byed pa de'i bu mo mngag gzhug ma chu bum thogs te khron pa de'i drung du chu chur0song ba dang / des legs 'ongs bzhin gzugs lasakyingo shes nas des de la smras pa/ jo co khyod chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa khyim bdag rtogs ldan gyi bu legs 'ongs ma lags sam/ sring mo yin no/ /jo cosakhyod kyi yab yum gnyis gar bzhud/ dus la bab bo/ /de'i khyim dang / bang mdzod kyi rnam pa dang / zhing gi rnam pa dang / nor gyi ⑨rnam pa dang /'bru'i rnam pa dag gar mchis/ thams cad mes tshig go/ /grong pa'i mi gang dag zong thogs te yul gzhan du mchis pa dag gar mchis/ kha cig ni rgya mtsho chen por gru bo che zhig par gyur/ kha cig ni zong zong ma yin par gyur/ kha cig ni de nyid du tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar gyur/ kha cig ni de nyid du 'khod de tshig kyang mi ster ro/ /nye du dag gar mchis/ kha cig ni dus la bab/kha cig ni bros/ kha cig ni de nyid na 'khod de tshig kyang mi ster ro/ /bran dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dag gar mchis/kha cig ni dus la bab/ kha cig ni bros/ kha cig ni de nyid na 'khod de tshig kyang mi ster ro/ /bu mo des de thos nas de mchi mas brnangs te 'dug nas des 8—53

legs 'ongs la smras pa/ jo ponyebadag gis khyod kyi lcam mo la sbran gyi bar du re zhig 'di nyid na gzhes ②shig ces smras te bu mo de song nas jo mo la smras pa/jo mo khyod kyi dral posabyon no/ /des smras pa/ zong ji lta bus byon/ bu mos smras pa/ jo mo khar0ba dang / ral rul dang / sprang phorasnyigyis byon no / /des bu mo de'i dulag tu gos dag dang / kās pa ṇa dag bskur nas smras pa/ jo co tshul 'di skad ces snga ma 'di tsam je gsol zhing mnobs shig dang slad kyisalgegal te dbon po dag dang / dbon mo dag dang mjal bar gyur na de dag kās pa ṇa ji snyed cig 'bul bar 'gyur bas khyod nye du dag gis glo bas bas par mi 'gyur ro zhes gyis shig /bu mo de der song ste legs 'ongs la gos dag dang / kārsā pa ṇa dag phul nas smras pa/ jo co 0lcam gyi mchid nas snga ma 'di tsam je gsol zhing mnobs shig dang slad kyis ⑩gal te dbon po dag dang ⑩/ dbon mo dag dang mjal hubar gyur na/ de dag kācho pa ṇa ji snyed cig 'bul bar 'gyur bas7khyod nye du dag gis glo bas bas par mi 'gyur ro zhes mchi'o zhes ⑩smras te song ngo / /legs 'ongs ⑩kyis bsams pa/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni nye du'i 'khor rgya che ba yin la / bdag kyang sngon nye du'i 'khor rgya che ba yin pas da der song na de dag bdag la gtam 'dri bas 0ring du thogs par 'gyur zhing des bdag ltogs te 'chi bar 'gyur gyis ()je g.yar sus bza' 0zhing 'grangs chanas der song ste/nye du'i tshogs dag la bde bar so ⑥sor kun dga' bar bya'o snyam nas de chang pa'i khyim du song ste/ des ji tsam gyis ra ro bar 'gyur ba de tsam gyi chang sar pa 'thungs nas de ra ro ste skyed mos tshal du song nas nyal lo/ /mnyan 8—54

yod na skyed7mos tshal 'joms pa'i mi dag skyedakhumos tshal nyug par byed cing /de dag gis gal te mi gnyid log pa mthong na de rkang pas sgul bar byed cing gal te sad na ni de la 'di skad ces/ kye nang rje khyod kyis mnyan yod na skyedasamos tshal 'joms pa'i mi dag skyed ༷mos tshal nyug par byed cing de dag mi gnyid log pa 'joms par byed do zhes ma thos sam/ ⑤mongs la song shig ces zer ro/ /gal te ma sad na ni bcom ste 'dong bar byed pas skyed mos tshal 'joms pa'i mi de dag der lhags te〈legs 'ongs nyal ba mthong nas de dag gis de rkang pas bsgul na ma sad nas ji tsam na de dag gis de bcom ste dong ngo / /ji tsam na legs 'ongs sad pa dang bdag nyid bcom par mthong nas des ral rul de dag nyid gyon te 'dug go/ /de'i sring mos bsams pa/ci'i phyir bdag gi ⑩ming po de yun ring du thogs snyam nas des bu mo mngag gzhug tsom mngags te ltar ④btang ba dang de der song ste bltas na ji tsam na bcom par mthong nas/ bu mo de song ste jo mo la smras pa/ jo mo jo co bcom ste sngon gyi cha lugs nyid kyis bzhugs so/ /sring mos bsams pa/ de ni sems can skal chad cig yin pas de'i le lan gyis khyim bdag rtogs ldan gyi khyim nor du ma dang ldan pa tshul ma yin pas chud zos par gyur pas da gal te bdag gis de 'dir bcug par gyur na bdag gi gyos po'i khyim yang de'i le lan gyis tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur ro snyam nas des de yal bar bor ro/ /legs 'ongs kyis kyang las kyi sgrib pas de brjed (nyenas de mu lto 0ba dag gi nang du sprezhugs pa dang /ji tsam na mu lto0 ba de dag kyang lag pa stong pa dang / sprang phor stong par 8—55

gyur te phyir lhags nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag sngon cad gar zhugs pa der lag pa gang ba dang / sprang phor gang bar gyur te phyir 'ong na deng bdag cag lag pa stong pa dang / sprang phoranyestong par gyur te phyir lhags pa 'di la rgyu ci yod/ de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gi ②nang du sems canasaskal chad 'ga' zhig zhugs pas des na bdag cag lag pa stong pa dang / sprang phor stong par gyur te phyir lhags so/ /yang de dag gis smras pa/brtag par byas bdag cag kha gnyis su bcad de 'jug par bya'o zhes de dag gis kha0gnyis su bcad de zhugs pa dang / gang dag gi nang du legs 'ongs zhugs pa de dag lag pa stong pa dang / sprang phor stong par gyur te lhags so/ /de dag gis kyang kha gnyis su bcad de zhugs pa dang / gang dag gi nang du legs 'ongs zhugs pa de dag lag pa stong pa dang / sprang phor stong par gyur te0lhags so/ /de dag gis kyang yang kha gnyis su bcad de zhugs pa dang yang de ltar gyur to/ /de dag gis kyang yang dang yang dusakha gnyis su bcad de zhugs pa dang / de lta de ltar gyur nas ji tsam na legs 'ongs dang mu lto ⑨ba gzhan cig dang gnyis lhan cig zhugs pa yang so sor bye ba dang / legs 'ongs ni lag pa stong pa dang / sprang phor7stong par gyur te 'ongs la/ gzhan thams cad lag pa gang ba dang / sprang phor gang bar gyur te 'ongs nas de dag gis smras pa/ sems can skal chad 'di bdag cag gi nang du zhugs pas des na bdag cag lag pa stong pa dang / sprang phor stong par gyur te lhags so zhes de dag gis legasanye'ongs shin tu brdegs te sprang phor gyis de'i kladanepa bcom nas nyes 'ongs khyod phar song shig ces smras te bskrad do/ /khyim bdag mgon 8—56

med zas sbyin gyisashesangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs nas/ des ②zhi shas 'tsho ba dag la bsgo ③ba/shes ldan dag ji srid du sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi khyodage 'dun gyis gdugs tshod ma gsol gyi ⑤bar du mu lto dub 'ga' yang 'jug tu ma gzhug shig /de dag rgyal phyis ⑧sbyin par bya'o/ /de na mu lto ⑨bas 'jug par brtsams pa na sgo bas de dag phyir bzlog pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ kye nang rje kho bo cag gi ming gis khyim bdag bzang byin gyi ming mgon med zas sbyin zhes bya bar grags pa yin na ci'i phyir khyod kho bo cag phyir zlog par byed/yang de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag gi tsonang du yang nyes 'ongs de (nyezhugs par ma gyur tam ltos shig ces de dag gis bltas pa dang /ji tsam na de dag gis legs 'ongs der zhugs pa mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/nyes 'ongs de 'di yin no zhes de dag gis legs 'ongs shin tu brdegs byate sprang phor gyis de'i klad pa bcom nas de dag gis lag pa dang / rkang pa dag nas bzung ste khrid nas phyag dar gyi phung po'i steng du bzhag ste nyes 'ongs khyod 'dir 'dug shig ces smras pa dang / legs 'ongs phyag dar gyi phung po de'i ⑫steng na ngu zhing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabs gsol lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te/ dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar te khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi gnasakyis ga la ba de logs su gshegs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis legs 'ongs phyag dar gyi phung po'i steng na klad pa zhom nas khrag 'dzag cing ngu zhing 'dug pa gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang dge slong rnams la bka' 8—57

stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di ltar srid pa tha ma pa'i sems can yang gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur pas srid pa dag gis ngoms ①par bya zhing srid pa'i yo byad dag gis kyang ngomasakhupar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis legs 'ongs la lhung bzed kyi lhag ma gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi gnas rgyas ga la ba ༷der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdanasabashams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas0khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas bca' ba dang / bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byed/ stobs par byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar bca' ba dang / ⑧bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byas shing bstabs ⑨nas bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod gsol cing ⑩phyag bcabs lhung bzed bzhag par rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos legs 'ongs la lhung bzed kyi ⑩lhag ma gzhag pa brjed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid can yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis legs 'ongs la lhung bzed kyi lhag ma gzhag pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi lhung bzed kyi pham phabs blang bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la legs 'ongs la lhung bzed kyi lhag ma zhog shig ces bka' stsal pa/ brjed pa dran nas des 8—58

ngu bar brtsams pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod ci'i phyir ngu / btsun pa bdag gis ①legs 'ongs la lhung bzed kyi lhag ma gzhag pa bskyud de bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyikhubaka' bcag go/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis zhunga'i bka' bcag pa ma yin gyis du'adi ltar legs 'ongs nyid kyi ⑤las kyi sgrib ༷pas khyod kyis de la lhung bzed kyi ⑦lhag ma gzhag pa brjed par gyur to/ /kun dga' bo khyod song la legs 'ongs bos shig /de song ste legs 'ongs legs 'ongs zhes bos pa dang / du ma dag gis ang zhes lan btab cing de dag gis bsams pa/ deng bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum gyi bla mas gang la dgongs snyam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo phyir log ste gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag gis〈legs 'ongs legs 'ongs zhes bos na/ du ma dag gis ang zhes lan btab na gang mchi bar bgyi/ kun dga' bo song la 'di skad ces/ chu srin bying su pa gsod kyi ri pa༅khyim bdag rtogs ldan gyi bu/ legs 'ongs gang yin pa de tshur shog ces bos shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo song7ste de skad bos pa dang / legs 'ongs kyis bdag gi ming dran nas des tshigs su bcad pa dag smras pa/ legs 'ongs sgra 'di bskyud gyur na/ /ga las 'dir ni mchis par gyur/ /nges par ma legs zad gyur cing / /legs par byung bar gyur yang dag /gang dag khyod la skyabs mchis pa/ /de dag mgon ni kun mkhyen lags/ /gang dag khyod kyi gsung dga' dang / /'phags pa de dag legs 'ongs lags/ /bdag ni skal dang bral ba ste/ /rtsa lag kun gyis spangs gyur cing / /brtse gnas drag po'i gnas thob pa/ /mya ngan zug rngus gzir ba lags/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun 8—59

dga' bos de khrid de zhugs nas gsol pa/ btsunanyepa legs 'ongs de 'di lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu khyod bcom ldan 'das kyi lhung bzed kyi pham phabs za'am/ bcom ldan 'das 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das kyisakhude la lhung bzed kyi pham phabs stsal ba dang / ji tsam na des nyung ngur mthong nas des bsams pa/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum gyi bla mas brgya ③lam na dgongs su zin kyang lhung bzod kyi pham phabs chung ngu zhig bzhag go snyam mo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i sems thugs kyis mkhyen nas bka' stsal pa/ bu legs 'ongs gal te khyod ri rab tsam gyi0kham dag dang / rgya mtsho chen po tsam gyi ltos za bar byed na yang ji srid du khyod tshim par ma gyur pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhung bzed kyi pham phabs zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /des bcom ldan 'das kyi lhung bzed kyi pham phabs zos pa dang / de tshim par gyur nas des ⑤bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du blta bar brtsams pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu legs 'ongs tshim mas/ bcom ldan 'das tshim mo/ /kham tha ma long shig dang mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /des de blangs nas mi snang bar gyur7to/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di su lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag chu srin byis pa gsod7kyi ri pa khyim bdag rtogs ldan gyi bu yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das 'o na bdag gi chung po grogs kyi bu lags so/ /khyim bdag de yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bshad pa mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs pa dang / srid pa tha ma pa'i ⑩sems can de bcom ldan 'das kyi slad bzhin slad bzhin rjes 8—60

su 'brang zhing song nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang du gshegs te dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs pa dang /legs 'ongs kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i las sbyang bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis legs 'ongs la bka' stsal pa/legs 'ongs khyod la kārsā pa ṇa dag yod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu gos kyi grarasheltos shig /des bltas pa dang / ji tsam na kās pa ṇa gnyis yod pa ②mthong nas des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu song la kun dga' ra ba pa rgyal bu dum pa'i gan nas utpal sngon po dag khyer te shog shig /des bcom ldan 'das bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas kun dga' ra ba pa rgyal bu dum pa ga la ba der songasab dang / rgyal bu dum pas de thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba mthong nas des bsams pa/ nyes 'ongs 'di ga shed nas 'dir 'ongs pas bdag la gnod pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur ro snyam nas/des smras pa/ nyes 'ongs kun dga'i ra bar ma 'jug shig /legs 'ongs kyis7tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ bdag ni utpal mi sgrub ste/ /pad ma bdag la dgosalgepa med/ /kho bo kun mkhyen grags ldan pa/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i pho nya yin⑧/ /dum pas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ gal te thub pa zhi bdag 0nyid/ /lha mi rnams kyi mchod gnas kyi/ /mchod pa'i gnas kyis ches mchod pa'i/ /pho nya lags na tshur gshegs spyodarkyi/ /dum pas smras pa/ khyod 8—61

sangs rgyas kyi pho nya yin nam/ legs 'ongs kyis smras pa/ kho botusangs rgyas kyi pho nya yin no/ /don ci'i phyir 'ongs/ utpal dag gi phyir 'ongs so/ /song la ji snyed 'dod pa de snyed khyer te song shig /legs 'ongs kyis utpal sngon po dag gi ②khur khyer te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs 'ongs dge slong rnams la brims shig /legs 'ongs kyis dge slong rnams la utpal sngon po dag brim ③par brtsam0pa dang / dge slong dag mi len nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dri zhim po thams cad ni mig la phan zhing 'di'i las sbyang bar yang byas longasnyishig /dge slong rnams kyis me tog de dag blangs so/ /legs 'ongs kyi sngon zad par sngon po'i skye mched bskyed pas de rgan pa'i mtha' logs na 'dug pas dge slong rnams kyi lag na utpal sngon po dag thogs pa de dag mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang zad par sngon po'i skye mched mngon du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs 'ongs khyod ci'i phyir rab tu mi 'byung / bcom ldan 'das bdag rab tu 'byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rab tu phyungashe/ rdzogs par bsnyen parashemadzad nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la gdams ngag stsal to/ /de de ltar rab tu byung nas gcig pu dben par bag yod pa rtun pa dang ldan pa bdag nyid btang bar gnas pa na rigs kyi bu dag gang gi phyir skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig dag bgos nas yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar byed pa0/ tshangs par spyod pa'i mtha' bla na med pa de tshe de nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas te bsgrubs nas bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /8—62

tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes gotubar byed cing dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan bzhag pa lta bu rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs dral bar gyur cing / rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so sosayang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa dang 'dod pa'i rnyed pa dang bkur steshel rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjedakyipar bya ba dang / mngonasnyedu smra bar bya bar gyur to/ zhade nas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis dgra bcom pa nyid thob nas rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba na/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa dag smras pa/ dpa' bosade nyid gzigs pa yis/ /thabs kyi zhags pas bdag bcings te/ /glang chen rgas pa 'dam phyung ltar/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'dam nas phyung / /bdag ni sngan7cad legs 'ongs gyur/ /de yi 'og tu nyes 'ongs lags/ /da ni thub dbang khyod gsung gis/ /gsal bar legs 'ongs nyid du gyur/ /kun mkhyen lcags 'dra bdag gis ni/ /khyod kyi gsung mchog thos gyur nas/ /da ni gser dang 'dra ba yitsho/ /zag pa med pa'i lus kyang thob/ /rin chen la sogs 'thob pa dang / /mtho ris thar pa 'tshal ba yis/ /rtag tu phan pa bzhed pa yi/ /dge bshes bsten par bgyi ba bzang // //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po drug bcu rtsa lnga pa/ gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 8—63

byung ba de'i tshe na gzhan mu stegs can dag shes ldan dag /dge sbyong gi ta ma na re nga'i bstan pa ni kun du mdzes pa yin no zhes zer na 'di ltar nyes 'ongs la sogs pa mu lto ①ba dag kyang rab tu 'byin par byedasnyen/ de'i bstan pa ji ltar kun du mdzes pa yin zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyan thos chen po ri rab lta busal skye bo phal po che'i tshogs dag smas0pa skyedasapar byed pas 'di'i yon tan bsgrag par bya na gang du bya/ gang du0skyes shing gang du rdib pa de nyid du bya'o snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa ngan spong gi bu dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyisarkyukhyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cigashengan spong gi bu dag tu ljongs rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos dag long ⑩shig ces sgo ⑩shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' 0bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas dge slong rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das ngan spong gi bu dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyis tsokhyed cag las gang bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig tu ngan spong gi bu dag tu ljongs rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos dag long shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul7ba/ 'khor dul ba dang ldan pa/ zhi ba/ 'khor zhi ba dang ldan pa/ grol ba/ 'khor grol ba dang ldan pa/ dbugs phyin pa/ 'khor dbugs phyin pa dang ldan pa/ thul ba/'khor thul ba dang ldan pa/ dgra bcom pa/ 'khor dgra bcom pa dang ldan pa/'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba dang ldan pa/8—64

mdzes pa/ 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ khyu mchog ltar ba lang gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ glang po che ltar glang po che'i phru0gu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ seng ge ltar mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar ngang pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nam mkha' lding ltar bya'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ bram ze ltar slob ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sman pa mkhas pa ltar nad pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/dpa' bo ltar ru pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sa mkhan ltar lam du zhugs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ded dpon ltar tshong pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshong dpon ltar 'khor gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mkhar ②gyi rgyal po ltar blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'khor los sgyur ①ba ltar bu stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ zla ba ltar rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nyi ma ltar 'od zer stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ yul 'khor srung ltar dri za'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/'phags skyes po ltar grul bum gyi 0tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mig mi bzang ltar klu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nor0sbyin ltar gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ thags zangs ris ltar lha ma yin gyikhutshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ brgya byin ltar sum bcu'urtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshangs pa ltar tshangs ris kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/dbang po rnams kyis7shin tu dul ba/ spyod lam dang spyod pa ma 'khrugs pa/chu gter ltar ting nge ba/ sprin ltar chu dang bcas pa/ glang po che'i rgyal po ltar dregs pa dang bral ba/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis 8—65

legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus7sku rnam par mdzes pa/'od 'dom gang gis skukhubargyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun du bzang ba/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigasalgepa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag0pa gsum dang /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ kun shes kauṇḍi0rgya dang / rta thul dang /bzang ldan dang / rlangs pa dang / ming chen dang / grags pa dang / gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangasasal sogs pa nyan thos chen po de dag dang / gzhan yang dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te ngan spong gi bu dag tu chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri gshel ba de logs su ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na/ chu srin byis pa gsod kyi rir byon nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la 'jigs rung gi tshal ri dgas kyi nags na bzhugs so/ /chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag gis bcom ldan 'das ngan spong gi bu dag tu ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na/ chu srin byis pa gsod kyi rir byon nas/ chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la 'jigs rung gi tshal ri dgas kyi nags na bzhugs zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang tshogs nas tshogs su/ byings nas byings su 'dus shing lhags te chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri nas byung stetsho/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'khod do/ /mtha' gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jud 8—66

par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod①/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to①/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pas sang 0bdag cag gi sdum par gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das kyis chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dngasnyikhyim bdag rnams la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyisakyicang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabasashel mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ngo / /de nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis de nyid kyi mtshan mo bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pa dag sta nigon byas nas nang par sngar langs te gdan bshams shing chu ra bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyis/ btsun pa gdugs tshod g.yar dgongs 'tshal na bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol zhes spyan drangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ①snga dro sham thabs gsol/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te/ dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun7du bdar nas/ chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze 8—67

dang khyim bdag rnams kyi bkad sa ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis ①bcom ldan 'das dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas/bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsodasnyepas rang gi lag nas tshim par byed/stobasalgepar byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsodakyipas rang gi lag nas tshim par byas shing bstabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod gsol zhing phyag bcabasaX/ lhung bzed bzhag par rig nas stan ches dma' ba dag blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khod do/ zha'akhod nas bcom ldan 'das la chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'dame kyis klu gdug7pa dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa sogasngo)ma med dang / 'brog gnas la sogs pa de dang de dag kyang btul na/btsun 0pa klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa 'di yun ring po nas bdag cag khon tsom mchis pa rnams la khon7du 'dzin/ mi 'gran pa rnams la 'gran tshol/ mi 'khu ba rnams la 'khu bar bgyid cing lo thog5)'khrungs so 'tshal ma rung bar bgyid na/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su thugs brtse ba'i slad du klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa 'di gdul5)du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo //de nas bcom ldan 'das 0chu srin byis pa gsod ⑥kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis ⑥yang dag par ston par 8—68

mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'judanyepar mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /rnam grangasasnyedu mar chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyisasnyeyang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug dulag khang ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la khyed cag las gang klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa 'dul b.rashespro ba des tshul shing long ⑥shig ces bsgo rgyal dge 'dun la tshul shing brims ⑧shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas/ dge slong rnams la khyed cag las gang klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa 'dul bar spro ba des tshul shing long shig ces bsgo ste dge 'dun la tshul shing brim par brtsams pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshul shing ma bzhes nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag gis bsams pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ci'i slad du tshul shing ma bzhes snyam du bsams na/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi yon tan bsgrag par bzhed par rig nas de dag gis kyang tshul shing sam blangs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis bsams pa/bcom ldan 'das dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag gis ci'i slad du tshul shing ma bzhes snyam du bsams na/ bdag gi yon tan bsgrag par bzhed par rig nasanyeston pa'i thugs la dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o 8—69

snyam nas/ des stan phyed las 'phags te glang po che'i sna lta bu'i lag pa brkyanganyenas tshul shing7blangs so/ /de nasasnyebacom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bosredage slong gnas brtan gang gisasnyitshul shing blangs/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis blangs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong legs 'ongs la 'di skad ces/ de ni klu gdug pa yin gyis0khyod kyis lus kyishedabang po bsrung bar bya'o zhes gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pasakun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las7mnyan nas/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ni klu gdug pa yin gyis khyod kyis lus kyi7dbang po bsrung bar bya'o zhes byung 4)ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis smras pa/btsun pa kun dga' bo ston pa'i bka' mnyan pas bka' bzhin 'tshal/gzhan7du na klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa lta bu sha stag gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'di lta ste / dper na bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ 'dam bu'i tshal lam/ 'od ma'i tshal bzhin du gang bar gyur kyang de dag gis bdag gi spu'i rtse mo tsam yang g.yo bar mi nus na lus kyi dbang po 'gag par lta ga la nus te/ 'di ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi po dag kun du bsten cing goms par byas/ lan mang du byas pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te chu srin byis pa gsod kyi rir bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /chu srin byis pa gsod kyi rir bsod snyoms brgyus nas klu a mra'i 8—70

chu ngogs pa'i gnas ga la ba der song ba dang / klu a mra'i chu ngogs pas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang des bsams pa/ dge sbyong 'dis bdag shi bar gtam thos sam ci na bdag gi gnas su 'ong / re zhig 'di ni glo bur ba yin gyisanye'ong du chug shig snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis chu tshags dang lhung bzed mtha' gcig tu bzhag ste/ snam sbyar sprugs nas rkang pa gnyis bkrus shing lag pa gnyis bsnyal te chu7btsags nas losam lhags pa dag blangs te 'dug nas zas kyi bya ba bya bar brtsams so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis zas kyi bya ba byas nas bsams pa/ klu gdug pa ni 'khrug0par ma byas na dulasnyiba'i gnas su mi rung bas0'di ni klu gdug pa yin pas 'khrugashepar bya'o snyam nas des ②lhung bzed bkrus te lhung bzed kyi khrud ⑨ma'i chu de de'i rdzing der blugs pa dang / klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa de 'khrugs nas des bsams pa/bdag gis dge sbyong 'di 'ong ba dang za ba yang yal bar bor na bdag la brnyas te bdag gi gnas su khrud ma'i chu sdugs par byed pas dge sbyong 'di ni nye bar ma zhi ba zhig yin no snyam nas/ de khros te steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas 'brug sgra chen po phyung ste/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi steng du rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / 'khor lo dang / mda' bo che dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs dbab par brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pas mtshon cha de dag lha'i me tog utpal dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dag tu gyur te/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi lus la 'bab bo/ /klu a 8—71

mra'i chu ngogs pas me mdag gi ⑦char dbab par brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pas me mdag de dag lha'i me tog man da ra ka nisnyedag tu gyur te/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi lus la 'bab bo/ /klu a mra'i chu ngogs pas phyag dar gyi char dbab par brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pas phyag dar de dag lha'i a gsheru'i phye ma dag dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dag dang / rgya spos kyi phye ma dag dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i phye ma dag tu gyur te/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi lus la 'bab bo/ /klu a mra'i chu ngogs pas khro ba'i mthus du ba gtul dub dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus du ba gtul to⑤/ /klu a mra'i chu ngogs pas khro ba'i mthus me sbar ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de na klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa'i khro ba'i mthu dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus snang ba chen po byung bar gyur nas/ chu srin byis pa gsod ⑦kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ni bcom ldan 'das klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa 'dulaphubar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas7bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong yang dang yang du me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi nang na 'di lta ste/ dge slong legs 'ongs 'di mchog yin no/ /gang gi tshe klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa mtshon thams cad zad par gyur pa de'i tshe na des 'bros par brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis kun du me mngon par sprul nas/ klu a mra'i chu ngogs pas tshe dang ldan pa 8—72

legs 'ongs kyi rkang pa'i drung 'ba' zhig zhi bar mthong ba ma gtogs par thams cad kun du 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur paratumathong nas de tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa legs 'ongs ci'i slad du bdag la tho 'tshamakhupar mdzad/ rgakhuba'i chos can kho bo khyod la thokhu'atsham pa ma yin gyi/ khyod kho bo la tho 'tsham0ste/ gal te kho bos yon tan gyi tshogs 'di lta bu thob par ma gyur du zin na khyod kyis deng kho bo ming las lhag ma ma lus par byed par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ btsun pa legs 'ongs bdag gis ci bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/ bzhin bzangasalgetshur shog /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song la skyabs su 'gro ba dang /bslab pa'i gzhi dag long shig⑨ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa lhung bzed du bcug nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa de 'di lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs 0khyod re zhig sngon gyi yinyes par spyad pas/ da ltar dud 'gro'i skye gnas ngan par skyes shing / drag shul can lag pa dmar ba/ snun pa dang rab tu snun pa la zhugs pa/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa/ gzhan gyi srog gcod du 'jud pa/ gzhan gyi srog gcod pas 'tsho bar byed pa yin pas/ khyod 'di nas shi 'phos pa'i 'gro ba ni cir 'gyur/ skye ba ni cir 'gyur/ tshe phyi ma 8—73

ni cir 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'dasarkyubadag gis ji ltar bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol bzhin bzangs lakhyod tshur shog la nga'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang /bslab pa'i gzhi dag longakhul chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la mi 'jigs pa byin cig /btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar skyabs su mchikhub dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag len cing / deng slan cad nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la mi 'jigs pa stsol to/ /de nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams bya mo lab mang po thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la bsnyeder dong0ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'khod do/ /mtha' gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das la chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa btul tam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa ma btul te dge slong legs 'ongs kyis〈klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa btul to/ /btsun pa legs 'ongs gang gis chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa0khyim bdag rtogs ldan gyi bu legs 'ongs kyis so/ /de na kha cig gis smras pa/ bdag cag gi phu nu bo'i bu yin no/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ bdag cagarwaskregi tsha bo yin no/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ bdag cag gi zhang po yin no/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ bdag cag gi chung po grogs kyi bu yin no zhes de dag gis de la bya mo lab mang po phul lo/ /de nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la 8—74

ba de ②logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de ②bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pas btsun pa legs 'ongs lasaphubarten te dgung bdun du bdag cag gi mchod pa'i dbang du bgyis pa'i gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das kyis chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgotsobos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ngo / /chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la khyim bdag rtogs ldan gyi chung po grogs bram ze sbrul0khas sdigs pa zhig 'dug pa de klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa'i 'jigs pas bros te mnyan yod du song ba de ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis glang po che'i ⑦chang pa'i blar bskos te bzhag go/ /de bya ba zhig gi phyir chu srin byis pa gsod ⑤kyi rir phyin pa dang / des ji ltar khyim bdag rtogs ldan gyi bu btsun pa legs 'ongs kyis klu ⑨yo mra'i chu ngogs pa btul ba thos so/ /thos nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs ga la ba der song ste 0phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs la bram ze des 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa legs 'ongs kyis sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / bram ze chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis kho bo las (sprebarten nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun zhag 8bdun du 8—75

mchod pa'i dbang du byas pa'i gdugs tshod la spyan drangs kyis7mi 'tshal lo/ /bram zes smras pa/ gal te khyod kyis da mi gnang na/ gang gi tshe khyod mnyan yod du byon par gyur pa de'i tshe na khyod kyis dang po kho nar bdag gi bsod snyoms gsol pasnyemadzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis de ltar bya'o zhes smras nas de langs te songasango / /de nas bcom ldan 'das chu srin byis pa gsod kyi rir ci dgyes par bzhugs nas/ mnyan yod ga la ba de7logs su ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ mthar gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa na mnyan yod du byon nas/ mnyan yod nasargyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das ngan spong gi bu dag tu ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na mnyan yod du byon nas/mnyan yod na ༷rgyal byed kyi ④tshal bdag gi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang mnyan yod nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyisazhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag mgon med zlos sbyin la chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag par ston par mdzad⑨/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jud par mdzad/yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 8—76

logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pas sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /bram ze sbrul khas sdigs pa des bcom ldan 'das ngan spong ①gi bu dag tu ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na mnyan yod du byon nas mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs ga la ba derasasong ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs bram ze de la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par byed/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'judasnyepar byed/ yang dag par gzengs stod par byed/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byas nas cang mi smra'o/ /de nas bram ze de stan las langs te tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa legs 'ongs kyis sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / bram ze bcom ldan 8—77

'das la zhu'o/ ljade nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bram ze de bdag gi gan du mchis te bdag sang sdum pa gzhan du 'tshal ma la g.yar 'dren na mchid kyis 'tshal lam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sngar mgron du bos pas bdag gir bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis bram ze de la cang mi smra bas dang du blangs so/ /de nas bram ze des tshe dang ldan pa legasasa'ongs kyis cang mi smra b.rashedang du blangs par rig nas/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi drung nas song ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis/ de nyid kyi mtshan mo bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pa dag ④sta gon byed du bcug nas/nang par sngar langs te gdan bshams shing chu ra bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyis btsun pa gdugs tshod g.yar ⑤dgongs 'tshal na/bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol zhes spyan drangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabs gsol/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi bkad sasheg la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams7pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bram ze des kyang tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyi kha zas bsod pa sta gon byas so/ / de nas7tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyang snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nasayi/ bram ze de'i bkad sa ga la ba der song ste phyin 8nas stan 8—78

bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas bram ze des tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs bde bar 'dug par riganyenas/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kha zas bsod pasakhutshim par byas so/ /bram ze des bsams pa/ btsun pa legs 'ongs kyis kha zas bsod pa zos pas 'ju bar mi nus so snyam du rig nas/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa legs 'ongs sang nan ②gsol lam/ des smras pa/ 'thung ngo / /bram ze des glang po che'i chang gi nang du mdzub mo bcug ste skom gyi nang du krog krog dkrugs te/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs la phul lo/ /dgra bcom pa dag ni ma bsams par shes pa dang mthong ba mi 'jug pas/ tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis de 'thungs te/yon bshad pa byas nas stan las langs te song ngo / /de mnyan yod kyi srang re ldes g.yogs pa las thal nas nyi ma'i 'od zer ⑤dag gis lus la phog pa dang /ra ro nas de chang gis ༷myos pa'i shugs kyis sa la sgyel gto/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid can yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis der lo ma ma yin pa'i spyil bu zhig sprul pa mdzad de bkab bo/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi⑧dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par7rig nas bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byed stobs par byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byas shing bstabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod gsol cing phyag bcabs lhung bzed bzhag par rig nas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de 8—79

nas bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag par7ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'judasnyopar mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzadasado/ /rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas yon bshad pa mdzad des/ gdan las bzhengs te gshegs nas phyogs der byon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de btul nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di ni gang gis klu a mra'i chu ngogs pa btul ba'i dge slong legs 'ongs zhes bya ba de yin na/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ dge slong legs 'ongs 'dis da ltar sbrul phrug kyang thulasabar nus sam/ btsun pa rngo mi thog tso/ /dge slong dag de ltar na nyes dmigs 'di dang gzhan dag kyang myos par 'gyur ba 'thung ba las 'byung bas dge slong dag nga la ston pa'o zhes zer ba dag gis myos par 'gyur ba tha na rtswa'i rtse mos kyang btung bar7mi bya zhing blud par yang7mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs sad par mdzad nas bka' stsal pa/ legs 'ongs ci'i phyir 'di ltar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma bsams sonya/ /bde bar gshegs pa ma bsams sonya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang du gshegs te byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu 8—80

yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ①bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis ②'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba 'thung na nyung byed do/ /'bru'i chang zhes bya ba ni chan gyi btung ba dang / phye'i btung ba dang /③ phabs kyi btung ba'o/ /bcos pa'i chang zhes bya ba ni rtsa0ba'i btung ba dang / sdong bu'i btung ba dang / 'dab ma'i btung ba dang / me tog gi btung ba dang /'bras bu'i btung ba'o/ /de gnyi ga bsresalgepa ni 'bru'i chang dang bcosalgepa'i chang zhes bya ba'o⑨/ /de 'thung na zhes bya ba ni mgul du mid na'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang / log par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/'tshod par byed/ nyung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/des na 0ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/dge slong myos par 'gyur ba'i kha dog dme ldan pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i dri dang ldan pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i ro dang ldan pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i myang ba dang ldan pa 'thung na/ 'thungs nas myos par 'gyur na ltung byed du 'gyur la/ 'thungs nas 8myos par mi 'gyur na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong myos par 'gyur ba'i kha dog dang ldan pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i dri dang ldan pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i ro dang ldan pa 'thung na/ 'thungs nas 4)myos par tu)'gyur na ltung byed du 'gyur la/8—81

'thungs nasanyemyos par mi 'gyur na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ / dge slong myos par 'gyur ba'i kha dog dang ldan pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i dri dang ldan pa 'thung na/ 'thungs nas myos par 'gyur na lhung byed du 'gyur la/ 'thungs nas myos par mi 'gyur na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ 9myos par 'gyur ba'i kha dog 'ba' zhig ma 'dres pa dang ldan pa 'thung ba la ni ltung ba med de7de yang tshwa nyid du gyur pa'o/ /dge slong 'bru'i chang 'thung na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /bcos pa'i chang 'thung na nyung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang 'thung na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong 'bru'i chang gi nu rtsikyi'athung na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong sbang ma za na nyung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong tshigs ma za na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong phabs kyi chang bu za na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong me tog dang 'bras bu myos par 'gyur ba dag za na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /bskol ba 'thung ba dang / kha'i nad yod pa la sman pa'i lung gis khur bar srelasab dang / lus dag skudakyipa la ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom7thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasakyil zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis las ci bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug pa/ nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i khyim du skyes/ las ci bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas mu lto yib rnams kyi nang du zhugs shing / nyes 'ongs zhes bgyi ba'i ming du gyur/ las ci bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan ⑩pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams 8—82

cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du bgyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu legs 'ongs nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur7ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas legs 'ongs nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan ②su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyirgya/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na ri bragasaphushig na khyim bdag phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs ⑤spyod che ba zhig 'dug pa de 'khor dang bcas te skyedakyimos tshal gyi sar byung ngo / /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa'i tshe rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang / bkren pa la rjes su snying brtse ba/ bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ bse ru lta bu gcig pu 'jig rten gyi yon gnas su gyur pa dag 'jig rten du byung ngo / /rang sangs rgyas na ba zhig ri brags der bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / khyim bdag des rang sangs rgyas de thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas/ des〈zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag rab tu byung ba 'di sgrod cig /de dag las 'ga' yang rang sangs rgyas de skrod par spro ba med nas/ khyim bdag des spyos te stan 8—83

las langs nas ①rang nyid kyis rang sangs rgyas de'i gnya' ba nas bzung ste bskradakunas smras pa/ nyes 'ongs mu ltosab rnams kyi nang du zhugs shig ces phul ba dang / de0phyag dar gyi phung po'i nang du sgyel0to/ /rang sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po des bsams pa/ khyim bdag nyon mongs pa 'di ha cang smasalgepa dang / nyams par gyur na mi rung gisashe'adi la lag nas drang ba sbyin no snyam nas / des ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dabashem brkyang ba ltar steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang ske/ glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag bya bar brtsams so/ /so so'i skye bo ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du sems gtod par byed pa yin pas khyim bdag de shing ljon pa rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rang sangs rgyas de'i rkang pa gnyis kyi drung du 'gyel nas smras pa/ yon gnas yang dag par gyur pa mar gshegs su gsol/ mar gshegs su gsol/ nyon mongs pa'i 'dam du bying ba bdag gi sug pa nas drang ba stsal du gsol/ rang sangs rgyas de khyim bdag de la rjes su snying brtse ba'i phyir steng gi nam mkha' las shod du babs so/ /khyim bdag des de la mchod pa byas nas〈nyerkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ smon lam 'di skad ces/bdag yon gnas yang dag par gyur pa 'di lta bu la gnod pa byas pa gang yin pa'i las de'i cha dang mthun par mi 'gyur b.rasnyimachod pa byas pa gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba'i khyim du skye zhing / 'di bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes par byed cing thugs byung bar mi byed pa'i yon tan gyi rnam pa de lta bu thob par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /dge slong dag de la de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim 8—84

bdag gang yin pa de ni legs 'ongs 'di yin te/ 'dis rang sangs rgyas de la mchod pa byas nas smon lam btab pa gang yin pa'i las ①de'i rnam par smin pas ni da ltar phyug la nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba'i khyim du skyes so/ /gnod pa byas pa dang nyes 'ongs zhes brjod pa gang yin pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni bskal par sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par gdungs nas las de nyid kyi lhag mas tshe rabs lngasabargyar mu ltosab nyid kyis 'phyan par gyur cing nyes 'ongs zhes bya bar gyur te/ da ltar gyi bar du yang mu ltosab rnams kyi nang du zhugs shing / nyes 'ongs zhes bya ba'i ming du gyur to/ /bdag yon gnas yang dag par gyur pa 'di lta bu la gnod pa byas pa gang yin pa'i las de'i cha dang mthun par mi 'gyur bar du'adi bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes par byed cing / thugs byung bar mi byed pa'i yon tan gyi rnam pa de lta bu thob par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa gang yin pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni ninga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas shing / 'dis rang sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa nga ⑨mnyes par byas shing thugs byung bar ma byas so/ /btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa legs 'ongs kyis las ci bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dang yang du me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan/ de yang smon lam gyi dbang gis te/ gang du smon lam btab ce na/dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa chen po bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i 0tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 8—85

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig patudang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 'jig rten dukhubyung ste/ de bā rā ṇa smikun drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar brten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i bstan pa la 'di rab tu byung nas dge slong gang gis de rab tu phyungasnyiba'i dge slong de de bzhin gshegs pa0yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis yang dang yang du me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /de na 'dis tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob nas/ de'i 'og tu 'chi ba'i tshe smon lam 'di skad ces/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pasayang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon gnas bla na med pa 'od srung la tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob ste/ bdag gis7tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis 7bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la bram ze'i khye'u 'khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skye dgu'i 0tshe lo brgya thub 8pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang tho)zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa'i bstan pa la bdag rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du 8—86

byed cing / ji ltar mkhan po 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa7yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis yang dang yang du me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de bzhin du/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ shākya'ikhuseng ge/ shākya'i rgyal po'i gtso bo des yang dang yang du me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan par gyur cig ces smon lam ②gdab par brtsams pas smon lam de'i dbang gis da ltar de bzhin gshegs pas yang dang yang du me'i khams la snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /dge slong dag de ltaraphun las gcig tu gnag ⑤pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa 0yin la/las gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu dkar ba yin/las 'drenakhum rnams kyi rnam par min pa yang 'drenasam yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag⑥pa rnams dang 'dren ma rnams spangs te/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams la brtsalanebar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /myos par 'gyur ba 'thung ba'i nyung byed de bdun bcu rtsacadagu pa rdzogs sgol// //bar sdom la/ zhi ba ral pa nor bu dang / /sman pa dge 'dun lto dang skas/ /za dang nyes gyur gtum mo dang / /gzhon nu lhung bzed stobs rnams so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /ri brags 8shig na bram ze zhig 'dug pa des mnyan yod pa'i bu mo zhig bag mar blangs nas/ de de dang lhan 8—87

cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur7spyod par byed do/ /de la bu mo zhig byung nas de bsrings7shing bskyed de chen mor gyur to/ /bram ze de la re zhig mnyan yod du bya ba zhig byung nas des shing rta bcas te 'phags pa dang / bu mo des mthong nas des smras pa/ yab gar bzhud/ bram zesasnyesmras pa/ bu mo mnyan yod du'o/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab bdag kyang mchi'o/ /bram zes smras pa/ 0bu mo khyod da mchog thob ⑤pa yin pas khyod kyi lag pa'am rkang pa la 'ga' zhig gis reg 0par gyur na/ bdag cag la mi snyan par 'gyur gyis gyekhyod 'di ⑧nyid na 'dug shig /bu mo des ngu bar brtsams ⑨pa dang / bram ze mos smras pa/ bu mo ci'i phyir ngu / bu mos smras pa/ yab mnyan yod du bzhud na⑩/ bdag der khrid par mi bzhed do/ /bram ze mos smras pa/ rje'i sras bu mo yang khrid cig dang nye du dag mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bram zes smras pa/ bu mo da mchog thob nyepar 'gyur bas 'di'i lag pa'am/rkang pa la 'ga' zhig gis reg 8par gyur na bdag cag la mi snyan par 'gyur gyis tso'adi nyid du zhog shig /bram ze mos smras pa/ rje'i sras dang thabs cig mchis na legs par sbas pa dang / legs par bsrungasalgepar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze des bu mo de shing rtar bcug ste 'phags pa dang / bu mo de ltad mo'i rang bzhin can yin pas pha la dris pa/ yab 'di su'i kun dga' ra ba lags/'di su'i rdzing bu lags/ 'di bu'i lha khang lags/ 'di su'i skyed mos tshal lags/ 'di su'i khron pa lags/ 'di su'i gtsug lag khang lags/ bram zes smras pa/ bu mo 'di ni shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams kyi bste gnas yin no/ /bu mos smras pa/ yab ltar mchi'o/ /bram zes smras pa/ bu mo bsti0gnas 8wa 88

'di na7rigs sna tshogs dang / rus sna tshogs las rab tu byung ba dag 'khod pas khyod kyi lag pa'am rkang pa la 'ga' zhig gis reg⑧par gyur na bdag cagasal mi snyan par 'gyur gyisaX/ tshur shog 'dong ngo zhes de 'phags pa dang / ji tsam na grong bar de nyid nas bram ze dang khyim bdag gi chung ma rab tu mang po gtsug lag khang lta 'dod pa dag mnyan yod kyi phyi rol du byung ba de dag gis bram ze de mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ snam zungs byon pa legs so/ /byon pa legs so/ /khyod yun ring mo ring mo zhig gis gar bzhud/ bram zes smras pa/ kho bo khyod cag nyid ltar 'ongs na khyodasnyecag gar 'dong / rgyal byed kyi tshal du gtsug lag khang ltar mchi'o/ /sru cag tsha mo 'di yang khrid de deng la/ 'di la yang gtsug lag khang ston cig /bu mo de yang de dag dang lhan cig rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo / /drug sde dag gi 7kun du spyod pa ni 'dir bdag cag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa rnams la yang chos bstan par bya/ rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad par bya/ rang gi grags pa yang bsgragasalgepar bya'o snyam pas drug sde dag las gang yang rung bas rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo stong par mi 'jog pas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku nang par sngar langs te so shing bor nas snam sbyar dmar ser gyon te/ rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug go/ /drug sde dag gis grong khyer chen po drug po dag na 'khod pa'i mi rnams 'di lta ste/ rigs las sam/ rus las sam/rgyud las sam/ ming las sam/ gzugs las sam/ bzo las sam 'tsho ba las mi shes pa'am/ ma mthong ba'am/ ma thos pa'am/ ma rig pa'am/rnam par mi shes pa 'ga' yang med pas tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bram ze dang 8—89

khyim bdag gi chung ma rab tu mang po de dag thag ring po kho na nas mthong ste/mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces smras so/ /che ge mo'i ma/ che ge mo'i chung ma/che ge mo'i mna' ma/ che ge mo'i bu mo/ che ge mo'i sring mo 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so/ /khyed cag ci'i phyir yun ring mo ring monyenas zla ba ltar rgyu b.rakhubyed/ de dag gis7smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das kyis mi khom pa brgyad ni gang zag gi tshangs ④par spyad pa'i dus ma lags so zhes legs parasnyigasungs na/ bdag cag ni 'di lta ste/ khyim gyi 'du 'dzi dang ldan pas mi khom pa dgu pa lags so/ /'char nas dusmras pa/ sring mo dag khyed kyis 'ga' zhig gis〈'di skad cesal/ dug can la sogs rgyal po yis//bya ba dag ni ma byas par/ /de dag nyid dang bya ba rnams/ /zhig pa nyid du gyur pa yin/ /bya ba de dag nyid kyang ni/ /yongs su rdzogs par ma gyur par/ /'jig rten dgra bo 'chi bdag deyi/ / 'ong ba 8nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes smras pa ma thos sam/ de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka de'i slad du bdag cag skyed 4)mos tshal du mchis te rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'jug pa dang /gtsug lag khang blta ba dang / bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba'i slad du mchis pa lags so/ /'char gas smras pa/ sring mo dag gal te khyed cag de'i phyir 'ongs na/bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang snying po med pa'i lus las snying po blang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas legs so legs so/ /sring mo dag de ni mjal gyis7'di ltar ltad mo ji ltar blta ba dri bar bya'o/ /sring mo dag khyed cag gang du 'jug par byed/ btsun pa 'char ka bdag cag kun dga'i ra bar 'jug cing gtsug lag 8wa 90

khang blta bar 'tshal lo/ /sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dad pas①/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten dag la gom 'dor na/ / 'dzam bu ②chu bo gser gyi ②sung tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min0/ /zhes gsungs pasasnyide yang legs so/ /sring mo dag khyed kyis gang khyed cag la dugatsug lag khang ston par byed pa'i dge slong 'ga' zhig btsal tam/'phags pa ci bdag cag sgron ma sug pa na thogs bzhin du zhugs gzhan du 'tsholashelam/ btsun pa 'char ka spangs te dge slong gzhan ga la tshol/ khyod pas gzhan khyad par dukhu'aphags pa su zhig mchis kyis7khyod nyid kyis bstan du gsol/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te 'di dag gtsug lag khang bstan par bya na ni bdag gi dge ba'i phyogs yongs su nyams par yang 'gyur/ gal te bstan par mi bya na ni tshig pa'i bsod snyoms kyang ster bar mi 'gyur la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ma dad pa rnams dad pa phun sum tshogs pa yang dag7par 'dzin du gzhug par bya/ gdul bar bya/gzung bar bya/ rab tu dgod7par bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ de'i phyir 'di dag dge ba la nges par sbyar bar byasabya/ rnam pa thams cad du bstan par bya'o snyam du rig nas des me tog dang / bdug spos la sogs pa mchod pa sna tshogs thogs te pog 'phor lag tu blangs nas go rims ⑩ji lta ba bzhin du bstan par brtsams te/ sring mo dag 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi dri gtsang khang ste/ gang du bcom ldan 'das nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 8'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas gang ni nyams par gyur4)/gang ni 'phel bar gyurabya/ gang ni gnod par gyur0/ gang ni nyam nga bar 8—91

gyur / gang ni mi bde bar gyur/ gang ni gnod pa dang nyam nga ba dang mi bde bar gyur/ gang ni ngan song la gzhol/ gang ni ngan song la 'bab/ gang ni ngan song la bab/ gang ni ngan song gi 'damashenas bslang stesnyomatho ris dang /thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba gang gi lag nas ni drang bar bya/ 'phags pa'i nor gyi dbyig dang bral ba gang ni 'phags pa'i nor gyi dbang phyug la gzhag par bya/ gang gi sangs rgyas 'byung bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten ni 'bras bu dang bcas par bya/ gang gi dgesnyeba'i rtsa ba dag ma bskyedasapa ni bskyed par bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dag bskyed pa gang ni yongs su smin par bya/ yongs su smin pa gang ni rnam par grol bar bya zhes mkhyen pa dang gzigs pa 'jug cing 'di ltar/ chu srin gnas kyi dug can pa/ /dus las 'da' bar 'gyur srid kyi0/ /sangs rgyas gdul la byams pa ni/ /dus las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar ma ni bu sdug gcig pu la/ /rtog cing de srog srung bar byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang gdul ba'i skye bo la/ /rtog par mdzad cing de srog srung bar mdzad/ /kun mkhyen rgyud la mnga' ba'i thugs rje yi/ /bzhon0ma gdul ba'i be'u tshol mi skyo ste/ /srid dang ngan 'gros nyams la byams pa ni/ /rab nyams be'u la byams pa'i ba bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba 'jug pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/mi 'jigs pa bzhis bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam 'cha'akhub/ 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra yang dag par sgrog pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis〈'di'i zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol7cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan 8—92

pa kun shes kauṇḍi7rgya'i gtsug lag khang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten mi shes pa'i mun pa dang / 'dren pa med pa dang / yongs su 'dren pa med pashen de'i dang por ye shes kyi mig sman gyi thur mas gang gi chos kyi mig rnam par sbyangs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan rnams dang / rgyal tshab lta bu rnams dang / yun ring po nas rab tu byung ba rnams dang / tshangs par spyod pa mngon par spyodasnyepa rnams dngas/ snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan pa gang yin pa gang gi rgyud la de'i dang por bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten du dge sbyongasnyingam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam / tshangs pa'am/ sus kyang chos dang mthun par bskor mi nus pa chos dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skye bo mang po'i don dang / skye bosamang po la phan pa dang / bde ba dang / 'jig rten la rjes su thugs brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir lan gsum du bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ba de'i yin gyisal/ 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol7cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po'i gtsug lag khang ste / bram ze shing sā la chen po lta bu rmon pa dor stong du gcig gis ma chog pa spangs te rab tu byung ba/ dbyig bye ba phrag drug bcusadang ldan pa/ gser gyi nas bang chung brgyad bcu 4)bdog pa/ bran gyi grong bcwa brgyad bdog pa/sbyor ba'i grong bcu drug bdog pa/ ser skya bzang mo lus gser bas lhag pa dang ldan pa mchil ma'i thal ba smin pa ltar spangs te/ mtshan mo'i thun tha ma la ras sbyar ma'i snam sbyar rin thang 'bum ri ba thogs te 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa gang dag bzhugs pa de dag gi phyir rab tu byung ba/ bsam gtan 8—93

dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa bskyed pa'i phyir nags na brten7pa gang yin pa/ gang mthong na spos kyi glang po che dag kyang rgyags pa dang bral bar 'gyur ba/ ②gang gis bu mangs kyi ③mchod rten du ston par khas blangs nas dge slong gi sdom pa thob pa bcom ldan 'das kyis kyangasredage slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong 'dod pa chung ba/chog shes pa/ sbyangasalgepa'i yon tan smra ba rnams kyi nang na mchog ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong 'od srung chen po'o0zhes gsungs shing bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su bsngags pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i gtsug lag khang ste/mchog thob pa'i bu gang yin pa/ gang lo brgyad gnyis su dbang po'i brda ⑧sprod pa bklags ⑨pa/ rgol ba thams cad tshar bcad ⑩pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab chen po rnams dang / spobs pa chen po rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten thams cad gang gi cha bcu drug par bzhag cing /bcom ldan 'das kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa ma gtogs par/ /'jig rten kun gyi shes rab gang / /shā ri'i bu yi shes rab kyitso/ /bcu drug char yang mi chog go/ /gal te lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di/ /shā ri'i bu dang mnyam gyur pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab kyi/ /bcu drug char yang mi chog go/ /zhes gsungs pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis ⑩'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol 8cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i gtsug lag khang ste/ mdun na 'don gyi bu cod pan med pa'i rgyal srid spangs te rab tu byung ba 8—94

gang yin pa gang gis lha'i dbang po brgyanyebyin gyi khang bzangasakhurnam par rgyal byed rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe ③bos lan gsum du bskul/ kun du bsgul/kun du rab tu bskul ba gang gi rdzu 'phrul gyis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer ④can du nyin mtshan bdun gyis gshegs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams dang / mthu chen po rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis du'adir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol rjocig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'i gtsug lag khang ste/ mi skalasnyeb bzang po las rab tu byung ba gang yin pa bcom ldan 'das kyi yab kyi mched kyi sras gang gi ming yang dag par bsgrags pas/ tshong pa dag rgya mtsho chen po nas bzhon pa'i snod legs par grub cing 'ong bar 'gyur ba bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i mig can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis thona'adir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol ⑩cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa kun ⑫dga' bo'i gtsug lag khang ste/ yun ring po nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bsnyen bkur ba gang yin pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 'bring na nye bar spyod pa/ ston pas yang dag par bsngags pa/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis yang dag par bkur ba gang yin pa bcom ldan 'das kyi yab kyi mched kyi sras las rab tu byung ba bcom ldan 'das kyis mang du thos pa rnams dang / thos pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / thos pa bsags pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa mdzes dga'i gtsug lag khang ste/bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung po su'i sras las rab tu byung ba gal te rab tu ma 8—95

byung na stobs kyi ①'khor los sgyur ②ba'i rgyal por ③'gyur ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjodabang po dag gi sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyisaba'adir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol0cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa sgra can zin gyi gtsug lag khang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sras las rab tu byung ba/ gal te rab tu ma byung na mthu dang ldan pa'i rgyal por 'gyur ba gang yin pa gang rab tu byung na⑧rgyal po mang pos bkur gyi rgyud gcig nas gcig tu rgyud pa yang dag par rgyun chad pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa rnams dang / bslab pa la gus pa rnams dang / bslab pa la yo byad bsnyungs pa thob pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol0cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo'i gtsug lag khang ngo / /'di ni nye dga'i'o⑩/ /'di ni 'dun pa'i'o / /'di ni 'gro mgyogs kyi'o/ /'di ni nab so'i'o/ /'di ni kho bo'i gtsug lag khang ngo / /ci 'di yang lta bar byed dam/ 'phags pa ci bdag cag gisalgegatsug lag khang thams cad bltas nas/ gdod 'phags pa 'char ku'i gtsug lag khang blta bar mi7bgyi'am/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa 'char ku'i gtsug lag khang 'di da shin tu blta bar bgyi'o/ /sring mo dag de bzhin gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka de 'dod chags spyad pa yin pas de'i gtsug lag khang nas sa gzhi (7mon sran gre'u'i phye mas bskus pa dang /rtsig pa bkra zhing 3nye bar bkra ba dang / mal stan be'u phrug gi snying po can bshams pa dang / bum pa btung bas bkang gra bcu snod dang bcas pa bzhag pa dang / skon0 pa'i nang na bca' ba sna tshogs kyis gang ba dag yod do/ /tshe 8—96

dang ldan pa 'char gas bram ze dang khyim bdag gi chung ma rab tu mang po rang gi gtsug lag khang du 'ongs pa rnams la smras pa/ sring mo dag ci je khye'u sus bya'am/ 'on te btung ba 'thung / 'phags pa ci chu klung zlog phyogs su 'bab bam/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa la gsol bar bgyi ba gang lags pa de nyid 'phags pas bdag cag la stsol tam/ 'di ltar bdag cag la gang dkon pa de stsol cig /sring mo dag khyed cagatul ci zhig dkon/ 'phags pa chos mnyan pa'o/ /sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas drug po dag 'jig rten du byung ba ni ngo mtshar rmadakhudu byung ba yin te/ drug po de dag gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba dang / mi nyid dang / dbus pa'i gnas susnyeskye ba dang / dbang po ma tshang ba med pa dang / dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa'o zhes legs par gsungs pas de'i phyir khyed cag dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa skyes pa 'di ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang 'dra ste/ legs so legs sol/ /sring mo dag 'khod cig dang kho bos khyed la chos bstan par bya'o/ /de dag gis de'i rkang pa duganyis la phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir mdun du 'khod pa dang / des de dag la chos bstan par brtsams so// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po drug bcu rtsashedrug pa/ bu mo de yang ltad mo'i rang bzhin can yin pas ri mo ltasnyizhing gzhan du song ngo / /de dag gis kyang chos mnyan nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i rkangashepa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te gtsug lag khang nas byung yingo / /bu mo des gzhan dag byung ba ma 8tshor nas sgo khang de nyid na ri mo lta 0zhing 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char 8—97

mas de dag bskyal nas gtsug lag khang du 'juganyepar brtsams pa dang / des bu mo de sgo khang na 'dug pa mthong nas des de la smras pa/ bu mo khyod ma song ngam/ des 'dzum phyung ba dang 'char kus de la 'o byas te yan lag dang nying lag dag mnamasal/ kun du mnams so/ /bu mo de ngu zhing phyir byung nas pa'i gan du songasaste smras pa/ yab bdag0dge sbyong 'char nas gzhon nu ma dang bral bar bgyis so/ /bram ze des bsams pa/ gal te da cung zad smrar ni bdag gcig pu yin la/ 'di dag ni mang bas bdag la gnod pa byed par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur gyis⑤/ gang du grogs rnyed par gyur pa na ra mda' ba bzlog ①par bya'o snyam mo/ /rgyal byed kyi tshal dang mnyan yod kyi bar na gnas kyi shing ljon pa zhig yod pa de'i drung na bram ze zhig7bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam bramasaze'i gsang tshig klog tu 'jug cing 'dug nas/ bram ze des de dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong 'char nas kho bo'i bu mo gzhon nu ma dang bral bar byas kyis8/ khyed cag kho bo'i tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa yin gyis 'grogs gyis shig /bram ze dag ni yongs su mi rtog pa yin pas de dag dbyug pa dag thogs te der dong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug pa de de dag gis bzung zhing bkri bar brtsams pa dang / de dag gis de bsgul bar yang ma nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul ba'i dus mkhyen nas de'i stobs dbri bar mdzad pa dang / de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka par drangs tshur drangs te khrid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gnod pa dang / nyam nga ba dang / mi bde ba byung ba la mi dgongs 8—98

samanyesnyam pa dngas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa 'di la gdamasalgepa'i tha ma ni0'di yin pas khrid kyang bla'o snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhir gtogs ⑤pa na gnyid log cing 'dug pa se gol gyi sgras sad par mdzad nas bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis gya tshom ༷du mi bya bar legs par brtag par bya'o zhes go bar mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal steng gi khang bzangs kyi lagazhir gtogs pa na gnyid log cing 'dug pa lan gnyis lan gsum du se gol gyi sgras sad par mdzad nas bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis gya tshom ①du mi bya bar legs par brtag par bya'o zhes go bar mdzad do/ /bram ze de dag gis kyang tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgor khrid do/ /de nas rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgo na skye bo phal po che'i tshogs dag bram ze rnams kyis dge sbyong 'char ka bzung ste rgyal po'i sgor khrid de 'ongs so zhes sgra mthon po dang / sgra chen po 'byin to/ /ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhir gtogs pa na gnyid log pa skye bo phal po che'i sgra des sad nas/ des zho shas 'tsho ba dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir skye bo phal po che'i tshogs 'di dag sgra mthon po dang / sgra chen po 'byin par byed/ de dag gis smras pa/ lha btsun pa 'char ka dang / bram ze'i bu mo zhig dang / bram ze zhig dang / bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam rgyal po'i pho brang gi chab sgo na blag cor mchi zhing 0mchis so/ /ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bsams pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di las dgongs nas bdag la rgyal po chen po khyod kyis 8—99

gya tshomanyedu mi bya bar legs par brtag par bya'o zhes bka' stsal to snyam du rig go / /mnyan yod na chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe rtsod pa chen po byungasheb de'i tshe na rnga bo che rdung zhing dung sgril ma yang 'bud par byedasapas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis zho shas 'tsho ba dag la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag rnga bo che yang rdungs 0shig /dung sgril ma yang bus shig /de dag gis rnga bo che brdungs0shing dung sgril ma bus pa dang / rgyal po dang bcas pa'i 'khor 'dus par gyur to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bram ze de dang btsun pa 'char ka nang du thong shig /de gnyis nang du 'ongs pa dang / rgyal pos bram ze de la smras pa/ bram ze khyedabaci zer/lha dge sbyong 'char kus bdag gi bu mo gzhon nu ma dang bral bar bgyis so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka bram ze 'di de skad mchi na khyod ci gsung /lha bdag gis de la sdig pa'i las ma bgyis so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ji ltar dpyadasapar bya/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/lha bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod nyid spobs pa can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa lags pas lha nyid kyi ⑨zhal mchu 'di dgum 0du gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/shes ldan dag 'di la ji ltar shes par bya/ mig gi rnam par shes pas ni gzugs dag mthong mod/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyis ni 'bu mo brtag med/ bu mo de btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du thong la rtog 8tu chug shig /de dag gis7bu mo de btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du btang ba dang / btsun mo phreng ldan mas bu mo de pang ⑩bar bsnyal te smras pa/ bu mo bden par smros shig /gal te khyod btsun pa 'char gas gzhon nu ma dang bral bar byas na yang de ni bram ze mdun na 'don gyi bu las rab tu byung ba yin pas/ khyod kyi khyim thab kyi thab rir 8—100

'bab par 'gyur ro/ /'on te khyod phyugs cung ma smras7pa tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin na ni dge slong la yang dag pa ma yin pas skurakun sems can dmyal ba chen por 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bu mo des smras pa/ joshemo bdag des gzhon nu ma dang bral bar ma bgyis te/ 'di ltar des 'o bgyis shing yan lag dang nying lag dag mnams0/ kun du mnams so/ /btsun mo phrengasaldan mas smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis don de tsam zhig la rgyal po dang bcas pa'i 'khor kun du dkrugs so/ /ci pha dag kyang bu mo dag la 'o0byed cing yan lag dang nying lag dgashel namanya/ kun du mi namanyamam/ de nas bud med rgan mo rnams kyis bu mo de brtags na ji tsam na phyugs chung ma nyams par gyur nas/ de dag gis rgyal po la smras pa/ lha bu mo 'di phyugs7chung ma nyams so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di la gang yus/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha btsun pa 'char ka yus so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag dengaphul bram ze 'di rgya skyegs kyi khang par chug la mes sregs shig /bu mo de yang rte'u dmu rgod kyi rkang pa gnyis la thogs shig /bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya po de dag kyang lag pa dang rkang pa dag chod cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/ lha de7gal te bdag las brten te sems can de snyed cig chab stsal bar gyur na/ don gyis lhas bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa las phyung lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'o na deng la 'bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya po de dag thong la/ bram ze 'di ⑩ni rgya skyegs kyi khang par chug la mes sregs shig /bu mo de yang rte'u dmu rgod kyi rkang pa gnyis la thogs shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas smras pa/ lha gal te bdag las brten te tha na grog 8—101
