matuphra mo 'ga' zhig la gnod par gyur na yang / don gyis lhas bdag bcom ldan 'das7kyi bstan pa las phyung ba kho na lags so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos 'dod chags dang ma bral na yang so sor rtog ③pa'i stobs la ltos/ gal te bram ze dag gis btsun pa 'char ka thub par gyur na ni rdo gcig gis ①kyang bsad ⑤par 'gyur ro/ /shes ldan dag deng dul thams cad khye shig /de dag bkye nas gyesal/ rnga brdungs shing yol bas bcad pa dang / skye bo phal po che'i tshogs dag so sor gyes so/ /rgyal po dang / btsun mo phreng ldan ma dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka gsum 'dug pa na/ rgyal pos btsun mo phreng ldan ma la smras pa/ phreng ldan ma/ btsun pa 'char gas ji ltasabu'i phun7phun byas pas rgyal po dang bcas pa'i 'khor kun du dkrugs pa la ltos/ btsun mo phreng ldan mas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka khyod pas slad kyis rab tu byung ba dge slong ma utpa la'i mdog dang / dge tshul ma skul 0byed dang / dge tshul ma tsi 8ri ka dang / gzhan yang mang po gang lags pa de dag thams cad kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du bgyis na/khyod kyis ni rgyal po dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyi nang du mi mdzes pa 'di lta bu bgyis par gyur kyang / da dung skyo ba mi mnga' 'am/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ phreng ldan ma/ da phyin chad 'khor bar 'khor ba na nyon mongs pa de lta bu dag kun du spyod par mi 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o zhes smras nas de stan las langs te song ngo / /de ngo tsha bas bcom ldan 'das dang phrad par ma nus nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan 8—102

pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan po ji ltar bdag 'khor bar 'khor ba na/ nyon mongs pa de lta bu dag kun du spyod par mi 'gyur ba de ltar bdag la chos bstan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/ ltung ba lhag ma med pa byung bar ma gyur tam snyam na/ ji tsam na des lhag ma yod par mthong nas/ des de bshags par bya ba'i ltung ba gang dag yin pa de dag kyang 'chags su bcug /bsdamanyepar bya ba'i nyung ba gang dag yin pa de dag kyang sdom du bcugashenas/ des de la 'di dang 'di ltar yid la gyis la bag yod pas sgrubs shig ces gdams ngag byin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka gcig pu dben ③pa bag yod pa/ rtun pa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid btang bar gnas pa na rigs kyi bu dag gang gi phyir skra dang kha0spu bregs te gos ngur smrigashedag bgos nas yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar byed pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i mtha' bla na med pa de tshe de0nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas te bsgrubs nas bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar byed cing / dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gserasnyedu mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan bzhag pa lta bu rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs dral bar gyur cing / rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa dang 'dod pa'i rnyed pa dang / bkur ste7la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis ⑩mchod par bya ba dang / rjed par bya yib dang /8—103

mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka dgra bcom pa nyid thob cing rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba natu'adi snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das ni bdag la phan pa mdzad pa/ bde bar gshegs pa ni bdag la legs par mdzad pa stenya/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de ni bdag gi ②sdug bsngal gyi chos mang po dag sel bar mdzad pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni bdag gi bde ba'i chos mang po dag sgrub par mdzad pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni bdag gi sdig pa dumi dge ba'i chos rnam pa du ma dag sel bar mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni bdag gi dge ba'i chos rnam pa du ma dag sgrub par mdzad pa lags na/ bdag gis ci zhig byas na des bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan byas pa dang / nye bar byas pa dang / rab tu byas par 'gyur snyam nas/ des yang bsams pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyadaka' ba mdzad pa brgya stong du ma dag gis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs parasamadzad nas bla na med pa'i mkhyen pa thugs su chud pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni sems can la phan pa'i phyir yin pas/ bdag gis kyang sems can la phan pa bya'o snyam rmanya/ /des bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim pa dad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa 'ga' yod dam snyam na/ des ji tsam na med ⑫par mthong ngo / /su la ltos snyam na bdag nyid la ltos par mthong nas legs kyis 8bdag gis ston pa'i thugs la dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o snyam mo/ /gang gdul ba'i dus yin snyam na/ mnyan yod na bram ze zhi ba la dad pa / zhi ba la bsnyen bkur byed pa zhig 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char 8—104

kus bsams pa/ bram ze de gdulatuba'i dus yin no snyam nas de de'i gan du song ba dang / bram ze des kyang zhi ba la bsnyen bkur byas nas/ kye bram ze bram ze ②zhes bram ze tshol bar byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/kho bo bram ze yin no/ /des smras pal/ bram ze ni thor tshugs ducan yin gyi ⑤khyod ni dge sbyong mgo reg yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ 'di ltar kho bo bram ze yin zhing / kho bo'i ston pa yang bram ze'i mchog yin na khyodakyizhi ba 'di la mngon par dad dam/ des smras pa/ mngon par dad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ kwa'i zhi ba smos shig /ji ltar kho bo bram ze yin zhing kho bo'i ston pa yang bram ze'i mchog yin nam/ zhi bas smras pa/'phags pa 'char ①ka de de bzhin te/ khyod ni bram ze lags shing khyod kyi ston pa yang bram ze'i mchog lags so/ /bram ze des bsams pa/ bdag gis yun ring po nas zhi ba la bsnyen bkur byas na/ 'dis lan 'ga' mi lam du yang ma bstan na/ btsun pa 'char mas smras nasatshig smra bar byed pas/ 0kye ma btsun pa 'char ka ni rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che ba yin no snyam nas des smras pa/btsun pa 'char ka ci'i slad du byon/ khyod nyid gdul ba'i don du'o/ /btsun pa 'char ka de'i slad du 'di nyid du bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka de nyid du 'dug ste/ zas kyi bya ba byas pa dang / bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de'i bsam pa dang /bag la nyal dang / khams dang rang bzhin khong du chud nas 'di ltar bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i 8—105

ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas btsun pa 'char kus bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mesarkyudag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang mkhubagyis/ byams pa dang / mdza' bshesasredang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams⑤/ rus pa'i ri dag lasakhuni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pakhephyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni ⑨mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig 7tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi ⑥rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te0/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisatso/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzung7du gsol/ /deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang / gnas mal dang / bsnyungasnyiba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/8—106

rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du ma blangs so/ /de nas7tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim dang po gnyi gakhunas btul cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ gang gdulakhuba'i dus yin snyam na/ mnyan yod na bram ze zhi ba la dad pa/ zhi ba la bsnyen bkurakhubyed pa zhig 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ bram ze de gdulasaba'i dus yin no snyam nas de de'i gan du song ba dang /bram ze des kyang zhi ba la bsnyen bkur byas nas/ kye bram ze bram ze zhes bram ze tshol bar byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ kho bo bram ze yin no/ /des smras pa/ mgo reg 'di lta bu bram ze ga la yin/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ bram ze ji lta bu yin/ des smras pa/ bram ze ni ral pa can yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas ral pa can du sprul pa dang / ji tsam na bram ze de ngo mtshar skyes nas/ des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka ci'i slad du byon/ khyod nyid gdul0ba'i don du'o/ /btsun pa 'char ka de'i slad du 'di nyid du bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka der 'dug ste zas kyi bya ba byas pa dang / bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ⑧dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas 'di ltar/ bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jigashetshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos 8—107

bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas/ btsun pa 'char mas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis7kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i⑧mi dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang dukhuni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thogatum ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa 'char ka rjobadag ni mngon par zhugs 0pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang /chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisal/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzungarkyudu gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i7bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char gas ji srid 'tsho'i7bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang / gnas mal dang ske/ bsnyung ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi7yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/ bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya7dgos 8—108

so zhes smras te dang du mnyeblangs so/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa 'char gas mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim gnyis pa gnyi ga nas btul ②cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ gang gdul ba'i dus yin snyam na/ mnyan yod na bram ze ser sna can zhig 'dug pa de'i chung ma nor bu la dga' nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas bsams pa/ bram ze de gdulakhuba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka nor bu mkhan gyi cha lugs su byas te de'i khyim du song nas/ nor bu su nyo nor bu su nyo zhes byas pa dang / bram ze mo des thos nas des smras pa/ nor bu dag rin ji tsam du 'tshong0/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ nor bu 'di dag rin che mod kyi/ 'on kyang rin chung ngu'i phyir sbyin no zhes tshe dang ldan pa 'char kas nor bu mkhan gyi cha lugs mi snang bar byas te/ rang gi cha lugs kyis 'dug pa dang / bram ze de ngo mtshar skyes nas des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka ci'i slad du 'dir byon/ khyod nyid gdul ⑧ba'i don du'o/ /btsun pa 'char ka de'i slad du 'di nyid du bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas der 'dug ste zas kyi bya ba byas pa dang / bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong7du chud nas/ 'di ltar bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pas/ stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste / rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag gis yidage ba'i bshes 8—109

gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas/ btsun pa 'char nas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang / mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams①/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyisardo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lagasashete/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang /dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisaX/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tushedang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char kus ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang / gnas mal dang / bsnyung rjoba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/ bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du mkhublangs so/ /de na7tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim 8—110

gsum pa gnyi ga nas btul cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bsams pa/ gang gdul ①ba'i dus yin snyam na/ mnyan yod na bram ze nad pa zhig 'dug pa/ de sman pa dag gis sman kha ba dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba dag gis yid byung nas/ des sgo ba la khyod kyis sman pa 'ga' yang nang du ma btangakhushig ces bsgosanas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa bram ze de gdul ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka sman pa'i cha lugs su byas te/ bram ze de'i0khyim sgor sman pa 'ongs so zhes byas te bsdad pa dang / sgo bas smras pa/ kho bo la bram zes khyod kyis sman pa 'ga' yang nang du ma btang shig ces bsgo stedzo/ kho bo de nyid kyi phyir bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/ khyod song la bram ze la sman pa 'ongs te de na re sman yangasami sbyin/ bya dga'7yang mi slong bar gsang sngags dag gis sos par bya'o zhes zer ro zhes byos shig /sgo ba song ste bram ze de la de skad rgyas par brjod pa dang / des smras pa/ nang du thong shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka nang du zhugs nas/ des gsang sngags dag gis de sos par byas nas/tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas sman pa'i cha lugs mi snang bar byas te/ rang gi cha lugs kyis 'dug pa dang / bram ze de ngo mtshar skyes nas des smras pa/btsun pa 'char ka ci'i slad du 'dir byon/ khyod nyid gdul ba'i don du'o/ /btsun pa 'char ka de'i slad du 'di nyid du bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka der 'dug ste zas kyi bya ba byas pa dang / bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas de'i bsam pa dang / bag la 8—111

nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas/ 'di ltar bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugos pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyenatubatsun pa 'char ka la brten nas/btsun pa 'char kus bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis / mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasal/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisal/bdag dge bsnyen du gzung ༷du gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char gas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang /8—112

gnas mal dang / bsnyung ①ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/ bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du ma blangs so/ /de na7tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim bzhi pa gnyisag nas btul cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bsams pa/ gangakhugadulasnyiba'i dus yin snyam na/mnyan yod na bram ze phyug paX/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ ser sna can mig phra brgya/ bya rog la yang gtor ma mi ster ba/ yo byad kun du 'dzin pa zhig 'dug pa de sgo drung na bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam bram ze'i gsang tshig dag klog tu 'judashenas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ bram ze de gdul ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas gdul ⑩ba la ltos pas/ yang dang yang du der bsod snyoms la zhugs na'/ des der lan 'ga' yang bsod snyoms ma thob nas/ de de nas phyir byung ba bram ze des mthong nas/ des smras pa/ kye dge sbyong khyod byayang dang yang du der 'jug na rnyed pa cung 8zad yod dam/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de'i dad pa'i nor las bsams te smras pa/ bram ze khyod nyid la yang med na ci zhig sbyin par byed/ bram ze des spyos te smras pa/dge sbyong khyod khyim mi dang bcas pa thams cad la sbyin par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas thabs yin no zhes smras te song ngo / /de na bram ze'i khye'u dge slong gi rgyus shes pa zhig gis bram ze de la smras pa/ mkhan pos de dag gi ⑩thabs yin no zhes bgyi ba de'i don ci lags mkhyen tam/ des smras pa/ mi 8—113

shes so/ /skol gyis dang du blang ngo0zhes smras pa gang lags pa de'i don ni de dag gisathabs yin no zhes smras pa de lags so/ /des yang smras pa/ mkhan pos de dag gi khyim mi dang bcas pa thams cad ces bgyi ba de'i don ci lags mkhyen tam/ des smras pa/ mi shes so/ /de dag gi khyim mi dang bcas pa thams cad ces bgyi ba ni/ rgyal rigs dge sbyong gi ta ma 'khor stong nyis brgyasalnga bcu dang bcas pa lags te/ de ltar na mkhan pos don gyisasresangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drangs par gyur to/ /bram ze des smras pa/ kho bos bram ze ⑤rig byed gsum rjodang ldan pa dag ma mthong ngam/ci na gang gi phyir/ dge sbyong mgo reg dag la sbyin par byed/ des smras pa/dge sbyong des deng mkhan po'i mtshan gyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun sang mkhan po'i sdum par spyan 'dren par bgyid do/ /bram zes smras pa/ ci'i phyir de de ltarasabyed/ des smras pa/ mkhan po gal te bdag la thugs mi ches na/ bram ze'i khye'u zhig rtog tu gtang du gsol/ des bram ze'i khye'u zhig rtog tu btang7ba dang / ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun tshogs pa na/ rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste/ bram ze che ge mo zhig sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren no0zhes/ bram ze de'i ming gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du spyan drangs pa des thos so/ /bram ze'i khye'u des de thos nas phyir 'ongs te/ bram ze de la smras pa/ mkhan po de bzhin te/ btsun pa 'char nas mkhan po'i mtshan gyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun sang mkhan po'i sdum par spyan 8—114

drangs kyis①/ zhal zas sta gon bgyid du stsol cig /des smras pa/ kho bos bram zikhurig byed gsum dang ldan pa dag ma mthong ngam ci na/ gang gi phyir dge sbyong mgo reg dag la sbyin par byed/ de dag khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du za bar 'gyur grang / ji tsam ②de nang par langs pa dang /dge slong0chu'i gtsang sbyor dag bram ze de'i khyim du lhags te smras pa/ bram ze chu gang du gzhag par bya/ bram ze des smras pa/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi sdum par ro/ /de bzhin du bshos kyi gtsang sbyor dag lhags te smras pa/bram ze zhal zas gang du brtag par bya/ bram ze des smras pa/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi sdum par ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi ngor mgron du bos pa des/ dus sngar 'gro bar bya zhing ma zin pa dag zin par bya'o zhes bka' stsal pas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka nang par sngar langs te 'phags pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis lam kur de mthong nas smras pa/btsun pa 'char ka gar bzhud/ des smras pa/ bram ze zhig gis bdag lasakyibarten te/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pas der 'gro'o/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ bram ze de ni ma dad pa lags kyisargya/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gyikhugadugs tshodagyebacad par gyur na mi rung gis bdag kyang mchi'o/ /de gnyis der dong ba dang / ji tsam na bram ze de snying las chung ngur 'dug nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de la smras pa/ bram ze khyod kyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs na/ ci'i phyir snying las chung ngur 'dug /zhal zas sta gon byed na 8—115

ci nyes/ bram ze des smras pa/ kho bosatubram ze rig byed gsum dang ldan pa dag ma mthong ngam ci na/ dge sbyong mgo reg dag la sbyin par byed/ khyod bdag gi khyim du zan zokhuzhig /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ bram ze cisakho bo la 'byor pa med snyam mamakha/ kho bos sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang / gnas mal dang / bsnyung0ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag gis bsnyen bkur byed par0yang spro mod kyi/ 'on kyang kho bo khyod la phan gdags pa'i phyir smras/khyedakyisnying las chung ngur ma 'dug par zhal zas sta gon gyis shig /'di ltar sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun ni ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / btsun mo phreng ldan ma dang / rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang / bla mkhyen drang srong byin dang / rnying pa dang / kho bo dang / gzhan yang bram ze dang / khyim bdag rgya che dgusadag gis bkur ster byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod par byas pa yin pas gal te khyod la brten nas / sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod bcad par gyur na/ khyod la rgyal po gdon mi za bar gnod 8pa byed par 'gyur zhing /khyod 0phyag sbal du bcug pas 'chi dgos par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas kyang yod par 'gyur ro/ /bram ze de skrag ste bsams pa/ de ltar 'gyur ro snyam nas des smras pa/ khyim bdag bdag gis zhal zas sta gon ma byas na da ji ltar bya/ khyim bdag gis smras pa/ bram ze mnyan yod na gang nyo bas mi rnyed pa'i rdzas de lta bu med kyisabya/ kārṇa pa ṇa dag 'on cig dang kho bos zhal zas sta gon bya'o/ /bram zes smras pa/ khyim bdag kārsā pa ṇa ji snyed 8—116

dag gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gdugs tshod 'byor par 'gyur/ khyim bdag gis smras pa/ kācho pa ṇa lnga brgyas so/ /bram ze des khyim bdag la kācho pa ṇa lnga brgya phul nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de dag gi steng du kācho pa ṇa gzhan dag gis ①kyang bsnan ②te zhal zas sta gon byas so/ /bram ze des smras pa/ khyim bdag bdag la bstsangashesder dag kyang mi bdog go/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ bram ze khyod bstsang ༷sder dag gis ma 'tsher ⑤par snying las chung bur 'dug shig dang / de dag dudrang srong gi snod dang bcas te gshegs par 'gyur ro/ / de nas ⑦sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gshegs te bzhugs nas/dge slong rnams kyis lhung bzed dag byi dor byas pa bram ze des mthong nas/des bsams pa/ re zhig snod dag kyang bdag gis byi dor byasami dgos so snyam nas de mngon par dad par gyur te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la smras pa/btsun pa 'char ka khyod bdag giyidage ba'i bshes gnyen lags kyis0/ khyod kyis kyang brim pa mdzod la slad kyis bshos gsol cig /sangs rgyas la sogs panyedage slong gi dge 'dun chagasol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bshad pa mdzad de gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /de nas bram ze des smras pa/btsun pa 'char ka da khyod bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /de 'dug pa dang / bram ze des zas brims te des zas kyi bya ba byas pa dang /bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas/ 'di ltar bram ze 8—117

de chung ma dang bcas pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/btsun pa bdag gisatudage ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas/btsun pa 'char nas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ masakhukyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang / mdza' bshes dngas/ rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasaX/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni0thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ / btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/rjo btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisal/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang /gnas mal dang / bsnyung ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci 8—118

gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/ bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du ma blangs so/ /de na ①tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim7lnga pa gnyi gasnyenas btul cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bsams pa/ gang gdulasaba'i dus yin snyam na/mnyan yod na bram ze zhig 'dug pa de'i chung ma gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa mdzes pa yin nasaX/ de de la shin tu lhag par chags pas khyim du 'ga' yang 'jug 0tu mi ster nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bsams pa/bram ze de gdul ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ de bram ze de'i khyim du song ba dang / ji tsam na bram ze de gcin gci zhing 'dug pas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka mthong nas des7smras pa/ dge sbyong ma 'jug par sdod cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas 'di ltar bram ze'i gcin gyi ①rgyun mi 'chad ⑩pa de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka nang du zhugs te bram ze de'i chung ma de yang 'di ltar de'i lto na nang grol gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad phyi rol nas snang ba de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka phyir byung ba dang / bram ze des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka khyod kyis bdag gi mchis 'brang gzigs sam/ des smras pa/ mthong ngo / /ci 'dra khyod kyis ji ltar mthong bar gyur pa de 'dra'o/ /de zhugs te bltas na de ltar mi sdug par mthong nas des de la smras pa/ bram ze mo khyod kyis btsun pa 'char ka la cung zhig ma smras sam/ des smras pa/ cung zad ༅kyang ma smras te/ 'di ltar des bdag spyos te dmod mo bgyis kyis bzhud la de la bzod pa gsol cig /de song ste 8—119

smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka bdag gi mchis 'brang ①la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/sal tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/ bzod par bya'o/ /des de sngon ji lta ba bzhin du gyur pa dang / bram ze de dad par gyur nas des smras pa/btsun pa 'char ka ci'i slad du byon/ khyod nyid gdul ③ba'i don du'o/ /btsun pa 'char ka de'i slad du 'di nyid du bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ④der 'dug ste zas kyi bya ba byas pa dang /bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas/ 'di ltar bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs0pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyenakhubatsun pa 'char ka la brten nas/btsun pa 'char gas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasargya/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkumanya/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni 8—120

mthar bgyis/ thogatum ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ②ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdagashebacom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yis④/bdag dge bsnyen du gzung0du gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char gsakyiji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / tshun bza' dang / gnas mal dang / bsnyungasaba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/ bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du ma blangs so/ /de na tshe dang ldan pa 'char skas mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim drug pa gnyi ga nas btul cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bsams pa/ gang gdulasheba'i dus yin snyam na/ mnyan yod na bram ze zhig 'dug pa de'i chung ma gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/mdzes pa yin te/ bram ze de me tog dang / yam sreg shing gi phyir phyi rol du byung ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ bram ze de gdul ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ de bram ze'i khyim du song ba dang / de'i chung ma des tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka sgo khang du mthong nas/ de nang du zhugs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yang khyim gyi nang du zhugs so/ /de gnas khang du zhugs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yang de'i phyi bzhin gnas khang du zhugasalge8—121

so/ /de gnas khang nas phyir byung ste skas las khang steng du 'dzeg par brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas kyang de'i phyi bzhin skas las khang steng du 'dzeganyepar brtsams so/ /des skas phul ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka sa la sgyelakunas de 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / des bsams pa ma shi'am snyam nas de babs te bslangasabar brtsams na 'gul bar yang ma nus so/ /bram ze 'ongs nas dris pa/ 'di ci yin/ bram ze mos rgyas par brjod pa dang / des smras pa/ khyod kyisasnyi'adi de ltar phul ba ni ma legs pa byas te/'di ni bram ze mdun na 'don gyi bu las rab tu byung ba/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi chung po grogs/ btsun mo phreng ldan ma'i slob dpon yin te/ 'di dag gis rgyal po las gzhon nu'i yongs su spang ba ༷thob pas bdag cag rgyarme pos phyag sbal du bcug pas 'chi bar bya dgos pa gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur ro/ /bram ze mos tshe dang ldan pa 'char ta'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te/'phags pa khyod kyis mi mkhyen pa dang / mi⑧gzigs pa dang / mi7rig pa dang / rnam par mi mkhyen pa ci yang ma mchis kyis bzod par7gsol zhes bzod pa gsol ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka langs te smras pa/ bzod par bya'o/ /bram ze de ngo mtshar skyes nas des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka ci'i slad du byon/ khyod nyid gdul 0ba'i don du'o/ /btsun pa 'char ka de'i slad du 'di nyid du bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus der 'dug ste zas kyi bya ba byas pa dang / bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang /8—122

rang bzhin khong du chud nas 'di ltar bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du/ 'jig tshogs la lta ①ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas/ btsun pa 'char nas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyisapha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang / mdza' bshes dang rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasal/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ ci sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang yi dgas dag nas ni rkang0pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ ⑧thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisal/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzungasnyedu gsol/ deng slan chad nasasheji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char gas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang / gnas mal dang / bsnyung ba'i 8—123

rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/ bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te/ dang du ma blangs so/ /de nas7tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim bdun pa gnyi ga nas btul cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ gang gdulasheba'i dus yin snyam na③/ mnyan yod na bram ze zhig 'dug pa de'i chung ma gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa yin te/bram ze de me tog dang yam sreg shing gi phyir phyi rol du byung ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bsams pa/ bram ze de gdul ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/de bram ze de'i khyim du song ba dang / bram ze mo de gzugs kyi rgyags pa dang /lang tsho'i0rgyags pa dang / rigs kyi rgyags pa dang / dbang phyug gi rgyags pas rgyags nas tshig kyang mi ster ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas de'i sngon gyi las zad pa las bsams nas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ sring mo rnying pa zadakyibyed cing / /sar pa chungasazad skyed mi byed/ /bag med brgyan pa mthong nas ni/ /mchi7mas brnangs pa'i bzhin gyis ngu / /zhes smras te song ngo / /bram ze mo 7de 'dis bdag spyos so zhes gshe zhing des 8gos dri ma can gyon te khri zhigs pa'i steng du nyal te 'dug go/ /bram ze de 'ongs pa dang / des de mthong nas smras pa/ bram ze mo 'di ci nyes/ bram ze mos gshes te smras pa/gal te khyod la gang sgo na 'greng ba'i mi gcig la yang bza' ba dang / bgo ba sbyin pa'i 'byor pa med na khyod la khyim mi mo blangs pas ⑩ci bya/ dge sbyong 'char ka gang yin pa des kho mo spyos so/ /bram zes smras pa/ bzang mo de ni 8—124

bram ze mdun na 'don gyi bu las rab tu byung ba yin gyis7de la bzod par gyis shig /bram ze mos7smras pa/ gal te de gson na kho mo mi gson no/ /bram zes7smras pa/ bzang mo de0ni ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi chung po grogs/ btsun mo phreng ldan ma'i slob dpon yin te/ de dag gis7rgyal po las gzhon nu'i yongs su spang ba thob pas/ gal te bdag gis de la sdug bsngal cung zad bskyed7par gyur na/ bdag cag rgyal pos phyag sbal du bcugasapas 'chi bar bya dgos pa gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur gyis ⑨bzod par gyis shig /bram ze mos smras pa/ bram ze mang du smras te ci rung /gal te de gson na kho mo mi gson no/ /'dod pa sten pas ni sdig pa'i las mi bya ba ci yang med pas bram ze de ral gri mchan du bcug7ste 'phags pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus thag ring po kho na nas de mthong na / de sems ji lta bus 'ong snyam na/ ji tsam na gsod pa'i sems kyis 'ong bar mthong nas/tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas lo ma ma yin pa'i spyil bu mngon par sprul nas der zhugs te 'dug go/ /bram ze des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka sgo phye shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ khyod skyes bzang pos 'ongs par gyur na/kho bos ci'i phyir sgo mi dbye/ ral gri bor ④cig /bram zes bsams pa/ bgags te gsad do snyam nas des ral gri bor ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ sdig pa'i sems de yang bor cig /bram ze des bsams pa/'di ni bdag nyid chen po zhig ste/ bdag gi sems kyang shes so snyam nas de mngon par dad par gyur pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba de phyir bsdus nas de bzhin du 'dug go/ /bram ze des tshe dang 8—125

ldan pa 'char ma'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir mdun du 'dug pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang rang bzhin khong du chud nas/ 'di ltar bram ze desanyestan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas btsun pa 'char kusakhubadag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang / mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams / rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgophudag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ / btsun bsnyebadag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag0bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang /dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisaX/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzungasnyidu gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu 8—126

dang bas7skyabs su mchi'o/ /de nas bram ze des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka khyod bdag gi sdum par byon tam/ son to/ /btsun pa 'char gas bdag gi bram ze mo la ji skad bka' stsal/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/ kho bosalgede la 'di skad ces/ sring mo rnying pa zadashebyed cing / /sar0pa cung zad skyedasami byed/ /bag med brgyan pa mthong nas ni/ /mchi mas brnangs pa'i bzhin gyis0ngu / /zhes smras so/ /btsun pa tshigs su bcad pa de'i don ci lags/ bram ze sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na ri bragasasheshig tu dus ston byung nas/ de na khyim bdag gi chung ma rab tu mang po dag rang gi rgyan dag gis brgyan te skyedasamos tshal gyi sar dong ba de dag grong sprang mo zhig gis mthong nas/de bdag nyid rgyad pa'i mya ngan byed do/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa'i tshe rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang / bkren7pa la rjes su snying brtse ba bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ bse ru lta bu gcig pu 'jig rten gyi yon gnas su gyur pa dag 'jig rten du byung ngo / /rang sangs rgyas zhig de la phan gdags pa'i phyir phyogs der song ba dang / de'i lus mdzes pa dang / sems mdzes pa grong sprang mo des mthong nas des sprang zan cung zad cig rnyed pa dang /des bsams pa/ bdag gis sbyin gnas 'di lta bu la mchod pa ma byas pas des na gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur gor ma chag gisayi/ gal te bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag las bsod snyoms cung zad len par 'gyur na bdag gis 'di la dbul bar bya'o snyam mo/ /rang sangs rgyas des de la snying brtse ba'i phyir lhung bzed bzed pa dang / des de la phul lo/ /rang sangs rgyas de de la snying brtse byabs ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab byam brkyang ba ltar steng gi nam ⑩mkha' la 8—127

mngon par 'phags nas 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag bya bar brtsams so/ /so so'i skye bo ninyerdzu 'phrul la myur du sems gtod par byed pa yin pas de shing ljon pa rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rang sangs rgyas de'i rkang pa gnyis kyi drung du 'gyel rgyanas/des smon lam 'di skad ceso bdag las 'di'i rnam par smin pas nam yang sdug bsngal bar ma gyur cig ces btab bo/ /bram ze de'i tshe de'i dus na grong sprang mo gang yin pa de ni khyod kyisachung ma de yin te/ des rang sangs rgyas la mchod pa byas pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas da ltar 'di lta bur skyes te kho bos de'i las kyi rnam par smin pa de zad pa las bsams nas 'disaskad ces/ sring mo rnying pa zad0byed cing / /sar pa cung zad skyed mi byed/ /bag med brgyan pa mthong nas ni/ /mchi mas brnangs pa'i bzhin gyis ngu / /zhes smras so/ /btsun pa 'char gas don gyis na bdag gi mchis 'brangasal bskul ba mdzad do/ /btsun pa 'char gas sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bram ze de la cang mi smra0bas dang du blangs so/ /de nas bram ze des tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas cang mi smra bas dang du blangs par rig nas song ngo / /bram ze mo de yang 'gyod pa skyes te bdag gis bram ze 'char ka sod cig ces mngags pa ni ma legs pa byas te bram ze des btsun pa 'char ka bsad7par ma gyur tam snyam mo/ /bram ze de 'ongs pa dang chung mas smras pa/ rje'i sras khyod kyis btsun pa 'char ka ma bkrongs sam/ bram zes smras pa/ de ni bdag nyid chen po yin pas su zhig gis bkrongs 8par nus / chung mas smras pa/ 'o na khyod kyis de spyan ma drangs sam/ bram zes 8—128

smras pa/ kho bos sang khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs kyis7zhal zas sta gon gyis shig /bram ze mo des zhal zas grang cha gang dag yin pa de dag ni de nyid kyisanyin mo sta gon byas/ drod bag gang dag yin pa de dag ni phyi de nyin par sta gon byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char7ka yang phyi de nyin par snga dro sham thabs bgos/ chos gos dang lhung bzed thogs te bram ze de'i khyim ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang / stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas bram ze desachung ma dang bcas pas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bde bar 'dug par rig nas bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byed/ stobs 0par byed tso/ /rnam grangs du mar bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byas shing bstabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ga⑧zan zos shing / lag pa bsnyal lhung bzed bzhag par rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas bram ze mo de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas 'di ltar bram ze mo desashestan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas/ btsun pa 'char mas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong 8—129

dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dngatu/ rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te②/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasargya/rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdagasrebacom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yis⑤/bdag dge bsnyen mar gzung0du gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'ilgebar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char gas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang /gnas mal dang / bsnyungasnyiba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas bram ze gzhan dag la yang 0phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du ma blangs so/ /de na tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim brgyad pa gnyi ga nas btul cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ gang gdul ⑩ba'i dus yin snyam na/mnyan yod na bram ze phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung ⑩ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ ser sna can mig phra ba/ bya rog la yang 8—130

gtor ma mi ster ba/ yo byad kun du 'dzin pa zhig 'dug pa des ri bragasasheshig tu zhing blas kyisamatha' rmor bcug nas/ des bang ba dag rgyas btab ste chung ma la lto rgyags tsam byin nas ri bragasasader song ste rang gis zhal tasabyas nas zhing blas kyi mtha' dag byed du 'jud sto/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ bram ze de gdul0ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ des bsod snyoms brgyus te/ bram ze de'i khyim du song nas des smras pa/ bram ze mo lhung bzed kyi chu bslangasango / /des de la 'bras chan phul ba dang / phru ba de de bzhin du gang bar 'dug go/ /bram ze mos smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gi khyim thab ser sna can/ mig phra ba/ bya rog la yang gtor ma mi ster ba/ yo byad kun du 'dzin pa lags kyis 0slan chad ma byon cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ thabs yin gyis sang kho bo bdag nyid dang gnyis 'ong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka phyi de nyin par bdag nyid dang gnyis der song ba dang / des de la de bzhin du 'bras chan phul lo/ /de bzhin du bdag nyid dang drug bcu'i bar du nyin re lan re song ste bram ze'i khyim der bsod snyoms zos pa dang / ngos kyi sdum tshes dag shes ldan dag ltos shig /bram ze des lag pas bcal ba brgya dag gis longs spyod dag bsgrubs na/ de dag bram ze mo des shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong dag dang lhan cig za bar byed do zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed do/ /bram ze'i khye'u zhig bya ba 'ga' zhig la mnyan yod nas ri brags der song ba dang / bram ze des bram ze'i khye'u de thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas des bram ze'i khye'u de la dris pa/ bram ze'i khye'u khyod ga las 'dir 'ongs/ des smras pa/ mnyan 8—131

yod nas so/ /khyod kyis kho bo'i khyim gyi gtam thos sam/ thos te/ mnyan yod na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim ni shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong dag ginyekhyim dang po lags so/ /mkhan7po'i khyim ni shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong dag gi khyim gnyis pa lags te/ shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong drug bcu nyin reshelan re mchis te bsod snyoms 'tshal lo/ /bram ze des bsams pa/ 'dis kho bo ser sna can la tho0'tsham par byed kyis0gzhan la yang dri bar bya'o snyam nas/ de lam gar0song ste bsdad pa dang / ji tsam na bram ze'i khye'u gzhan zhig bya ba 'ga' zhig la mnyan yod nas ri brags der song ba dngas/ bram ze des bram ze'i khye'u de thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas/ des bram ze'i khye'u de la dris pa/ bram ze'i khye'u khyod ga las 'dir 'ongs/ des smras pa/ mnyan yod nas so/ /khyod kyis kho bo'i khyim gyi gtam thos sam/ thos te/ mnyan yod na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim ni shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong dag gi khyim dang po lags sol/ /mkhan po'i khyim ni shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong dag gi khyim gnyis pa lags te/shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong drug bcu nyin reshelan re mchis te/ bsod snyoms 'tshal lo/ /bram ze des bsams pa/ de dang 'di mthun pas de ltar gyur gyis bram ze mo des longs spyod dag zos par gyur na mi rung gis 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas bram ze de phyir 'ongs te bram ze mo de la smras pa/ bram ze mo ngan pa kho bos lag pas gzhal bsnyebargya dag gis longs spyod dag bsgrubs nas/ khyod de dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong dag dang lhan cig za bar byed dam/ khyod kyis bram ze rig byed gsum dang ldan pa dag ma mthong ngam ci na/ dge sbyong mgo reg de dag la sbyin par byed ces des de brdeg par brtsams pa dang / des smras pa/8—132

bram ze khyod kyis kho mo la gtad pa'i bang ba dag kho mos rgya nyams par byas sam/ci7je so sor rtogs shig /bram ze des bang ba dag so sor brtags pa dang /ji tsam na de bzhin du rgya ma nyams par 'dug pa dag mthong nas/ des chung ma la smras pa/ khyod kyis〈zas de snyed ga las rnyed/ des smras pa/ bdag gi phru ba 'dir 'bras chanasnyedang / sran tshod btsos na 'bras chan0des dge slongasnyedrug bcu rjodang bdag kyang 'grangs ⑦par gyur to/ /bram ze des smras pa/ci'i phyir de ltar ⑧gyur/ des smras pa/ bdag gis 0khyod kyi ⑩mngon sum du 'gyur bar bya'o zhes des phyi de nyin par tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bdag nyid dang drug bcu7der 'ongs pa la de bzhin du bsod snyoms phul nas des smras pa/bram ze khyod kyis mthong ngam/ bram ze de mngon par dad par gyur nas/ des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char kus sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ bram ze ci 'di 'dra bas sam/ 'on te zas yang dag pasalgemagron du 'bod/ bshos yang dag pas spyan 'dren to/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bram ze de la cang mi smra bas dang du blangs te song ngo / /de nas bram ze des tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas cang mi smra bar dang du blangs par rig nas/ de nyid kyi mtshan mo bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pa dag sta gon byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yang phyi de nyin par snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ bram ze'i khyim ga la ba der song ste phyin nas stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas bram ze des tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bde bar 'dug par rig nas bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod 4) pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byed/8—133

stobs0par byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod7pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byas shing bstabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka zan zos shing lag pa bsnyal lhung bzed bzhag par rig nas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te tshe dang ldan pa 'char na'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas 'di ltar bram ze de chung ma dang bcas pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas btsun pa 'char nas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasal/ rus pa'i ri dag ④las ni bsgral/ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung /lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs 8—134

pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang zha dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yis②/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzungasnyedu gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char kus ji srid 'cho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang / gnas mal dang / bsnyung ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhanasal phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du ma blangs so/ /de na 0tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas mnyan yod du bram ze'i rgyakhyim dgu pa gnyi ga nas btul cing bzhag go// //'dul ba rnamasapar 'byed pa/ bam po drug bcu rtsa bdun pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ gang gdul tho)ba'i dus yin snyam na(spre/mnyan yod na bram ze zhig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las 8chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de la bu zhig byung nas de bsrings shing bskyed de chen por gyur to/ /de'i chung ma de gtum pa/ brlang ba/ rtsub pa/ rgya ba/ gshe ba/spyo ba zhig yin pas rtag tu ngos kyi sdum tshes dag dang lhan cig 'thab krol byed nas/ de'i ming gtum mo gtum mo zhes bya bar gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na mnyan yod du dus ston byung nas bram ze des bu la smras pa/ bu khyod kyi ma 'di gtum pas gzhan dag dang lhan cig 'thab krol byed pas/ bdag cag khri mon du bcug pas 'chi bar bya dgos pa gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 8—135

gyis①/ re zhig dus ston thal gyi bar du ri bragasalgegazhan⑧du 'dong0zhing 'khod la/ de'i 'og tu phyir 'ong bar byas⑤/ khyod song la ma la dris shig /bu des ma la smras pa/ yum bdag bgyi ba chung0zhig gi slad du ri brags ga ge mo zhig tu mchi'o/ /gtum mos smras pa/ gang du kho mo'i dang po'i gos song ba der song shig /bram zes kyang smras pa/ kho bo yang 'gro'o/ /gtum mos smras pa/ gang nas yang phyir ⑧mi 'ong ba der song shig /de gnyis dong ba dang / gtum mos bu mo'umangag gzhug ma la smras pa/ bu mo khur slang tshugs shig dang / je snog zan bya'o/ /des khur slang btsugs te khurasnyeb dag bya bar brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ gtum mo de gdul ba'i dus yin no snyam nas de snga dro sham thabs bgos/ /lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas/ de mthar gyis bsod snyoms la rgyu ba na gtum mo'i khyim du 'jug par brtsams pa dang /de 'jug pa gtum mos mthong nas des bu mo mngag gzhug ma la smras pa/ bu mo dge sbyong tso'adi skyod ⑩cig /des bskrad pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ches dang por nang du zhugs shing bu mo mngag gzhug ma phyis zhugs so/ /de gtum mos yang mthong nas des bu mo mngag gzhug ma la smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis dge sbyong 'di ma bskrad dmanya/ des smras pa/ bskrad do/ / 'o na 'di ga las zhugs / yang sgrod la sgo chod cig /des de bskrad de sgo bcad nas zhugs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ches dang por zhugs so/ /de gtum mos yang mthong nas des bu mo mngag gzhug ma la smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis dge sbyong 'di bskrad0 de sgo ma bcad dam/ des smras pa/ bskrad de sgo bcad do/ /'o na 8—136

'di gang ①nas zhugs/ de nas gtum mos smras pa/ dge sbyong ci slong /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ khur ②ba'o/ /gtum mos smras pa/khyod bu thu bor gyur te 'ongs na khyod la khur ③ba ci'i phyir mi dusbyin/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bu thu bor sprul te 'ongs pa dang / gtum mos smras pa/gal te lag pa dang rkang pa dag ser por byas kyang khyod la khurasnyib mi sbyin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas lag pa dang rkang pa dag ser por sprul pa dang /gtum mos smras pa/ gal te mig gnyis khar phor lta bur lta0na yang khyod la khur ba mi sbyin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas mig gnyis khar7phor lta bur sprul pa dang / gtum mos smras pa/ gal te nam mkha' la dril bu bzhin du khra la la 'khrol7zhing 'dug na yang khyod la khur ba mi sbyin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas nam mkha' la dril bu bzhin du khra la la 'khrol zhing 'dug pa dang /gtum mos smras pa/ gal te khyod phyed byed du dum bu gnyis su gas kyang khyod la khur ba mi sbyin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bdag nyid phyed phyed du dum bu gnyis su gas par sprul te sa la sgyel ba dang / bu mo mngag gzhug mas7smras pa/ jo mo khyod kyis gdung bar bgyid pa mang po dag bsgrubs pa de dag gi nang na 'di ni ches gdung bar bgyid pa lags te/ dge sbyong 'di ni ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi chung po grogs/ btsun mo phreng ldan ma'i slob dpon lags pas/ bdag ni shin tu thag ring por mchis kyang bran mo nyid du bas kyi/ jo mos ni gser gyi chu bum gyis rgyal po'i pho brang du chab bcu 'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /gtum mo skrag stenebasams pa/ de ltar 'gyur ro snyam nas des smras pa/ bu mo dong rkos shig dang sba'o zhes/ des dong rkos te sba bar 8—137

brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka 'gog pa la snyoms par7zhugs nas des bsgul bar yang ma nus so/ /de nas gtum mos tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyis mi mkhyen pa dang mkhugazigs pa dang / ma rig pa dang / rnam par mi mkhyen pa ci yang ma mchis kyis②/ bdag la bzod pa mdzod cig dang khyod la khur ba gsol lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka langs te cha lugs tha mal pasabastan pa dang / gtum mos bsams pa/ 'di la khur ba sbyin no zhes khas blangs na/ khur ba 'di dag ni ha cang che ches pas phangs kyisal/ 'di'i phyir khurasheb chung ngu gzhan zhig bya'o snyam nas/ des khur ba chung ngu zhig sreg par brtsams pa dang /khur 8ba des khur bslang 8thams cad yog par gyur nas/ gtum mos bsams pa/ bdag gis skyikhur ba 'di mi sbyin par khur byab snga ma las gcig sbyin no snyam nas/ des khur ba gcig drang bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na khur ba thams cad 'ongs nas/ gtum mos smras pa/ ci 'phags pa khur ba thams cad bzhed dam/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ 'dod do/ /gtum mos smras pa/ bzhes su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/sring mo gal te yongs su btang tson/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis/deng sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs kyisabya/ der dong la rang gi lag nas brims shig /gtum mos smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gtum mo zhes thams cad du rig pas/ bdag der 'jug tu ga la chud/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ sring mo kho bos khyod 'jug tu gzhug go/ /de nas gtum mos khur ba de dag thogs te/ khyim 8—138

bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyinyekhyim du 'jug par brtsams pa dang / sgo bsakhusmras pa/ gtum ①mo don ci'i phyir 'dir 'ongs/ ma 'jug shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ bzhin bzangs 0'jug tu chug shig /sgo bas gtumakhumo nang du btang ba dang / des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun mang po mthong nas/ khur0ba de dag gtub par brtsams pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ ma gtubasapar rangs par brims7shig /gtum mos smras pa/ khyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ brims shig dang khyed7par 'gyur ro zhes des 'di ltar sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad la khyed pa'i phyi na lhag kyang byung ba de ltar byin gyis brlabs so/ /gtum mos sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad la khur bas khyed par brims te gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bshad pa mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /gtum mos smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka khyod bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags kyis tshur gshegs/ bdag gi sdum par bzhud la khyod der gdugs tshod gsol cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka gtum mo'i khyim du song ba dang /gtum mos tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la zan byin nas gtum mo tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas/ 'di ltar gtum mos stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des 8—139

bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag gisanyedage ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brtenasnyenas/ btsun pa 'char kus bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang /mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis tel/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasaX/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgra'aji/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisaX/ bdag dge bsnyen mar gzung ⑦du gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag⑧pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas de la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug⑨ /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byas nas stan las langs te song ngo / /de nas gtum mos rang gi khyim phyag dar legs par byas/ chag chag legs par btab/ byug pas legs par byugs te me tog 8—140

dag dgram paratubyas nas/ spyod lam zhi bas 'dug go/ /bram ze de yang dus ston thal nas phyir 'ongs te skyedakumos tshal du bsdad nas/ des bu la smras pa/bu khyod song la khyod kyi ma khri mon gang du bcug cing 'dug pa ltos shig dang dbyung bar bya'o/ /bu de khyim du song ba dang gtum mos thag ring mosakho na nas bu mthong nas/ des smras pa/ bu 'ongs pa legs so 'ongs pa legs so/ /tshur shog ngal sos shig /khyod kyi pha de 'ongs sam/ bus smras pa/ mchis te/skyedakyimos tshal na sdod cing mchis so/ /bu de zan zos nas pa'i gan du song ba dang / phas dris pa/ bu khyim bde'am/ bus smras pa/ yab yum gyi spyodasalam de lta bu ni sngon lan 'ga' yang ma mthong ste/ 'di ltar spyod lam zhi bas mchis so/ /bram ze de khyim du zhugs pa dang gtum mos thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas/ des smras pa/ rje'i sras byon pa legs so byon pa legs so/ /bzhugs su gsol/ de 'dug nas bsams pa/ bye brag 'di lta bu ni sngon ma byung ci las gyur snyam nas/ des tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ 'di ltar sngon dang mi 'dra bar/ /log pa nyid du khyod snangasan/ /khyod ni smyo byed ldan gyur tam/ /'on te myos par gyur tam ci/ /gtum mos tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ jo bo bdag ni smyos pa min/ /myosalgepar gyur pa'ang ma lags te/ /bdag gis byasangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /'phags pa'i bden pa mthong bar bgyis/ /rje'i sras bdag la 'phags pa 'char gas 'di ltar bdag slan chad 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe nyon mongs pa de lta bu dag kun du spyod par mi 'gyur ba de ltar chos bstan pa mdzad do/ /bram ze de ngo mtshar skyes te bsams pa/bdag gis bdeg pa dang / bcing ba dang 9 smad pas dul bar ma nus 8—141

pa gang yin pa de/ btsun pa 'char gas chos bstan pas btulatubs/ gang gi phyir chos bstan pas 'di btul ba ni 'phags pa 'char gas bdag la phan pa mang du mdzad do/ /'phags pa 'char nas bdag la legs pa mang du mdzad kyis②/ bdag song la 'phags pa 'char ka sangakhukhyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drang ngo snyam nas/ de0tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kusasabram ze de la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par byed/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'judakyipar byed/ yang dag par gzengs stod par byed/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi smra'o/ /de nas bram ze de stan las langs te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la 'di skad ces smras sonya/ /btsun pa 'char kus sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bram ze de la cang mi smra bas ⑧dang du blangs so/ /de nas bram ze des tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas cang mi smra bas dang du blangs par rig nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te song ngo / /de nas bram ze des de nyid kyi mtshan mo bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pa dag sta'ugon byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ga'ang phyi de nyin7par snga dro sham thabs bgos/8—142

lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ bram ze de'i khyim ga la ba der song ste phyin nas stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas bram ze des tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bde bar 'dug par rig nas/ bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byed/ stobs7par byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar bca' ba dang bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas rang gi lag nas tshim par byas shing bstabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka zan zos shing /lag pa bsnyal lhung bzed bzhag par rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas derme bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang /rang bzhin khong du chud nas 'di ltar bram ze des stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /des bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag gisasnyedage ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brten nas/ btsun pa 'char nas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasal/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi 8—143

rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni ①mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jigashetshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ zhabatsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdagashebacom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yis⑤/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pa 'char kus ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bsod snyoms dang / na bza' dang / gnas mal dang zha bsnyung ba'i rkyen dang /sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas smras pa/rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/bram ze gzhan dag la yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du ma 7blangs sol/ /bram ze des smras pa/ gal te btsun pa 'char kus dang du mi bzhes na/bdag gis drang srong gi gdan bsham 8par bgyi yisaX/ btsun pa 'char ka gshegs te longs spyad par gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bram ze de la cang mi smra bas dang du blangs so/ zhatshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byas nas stan las langs te song ngo / /de na tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim bcu pa gnyi ga nas btul cing bzhag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bsams pa/ gang gdul ba'i dus yin snyam na/ mnyan yod na bram ze 8—144

gzhon nu dga' 'dun lnga brgyanyetsam chung ma dang bcas pa dag bca' ba dang /bza' ba dngas/ dri dang / phreng ba rgyu mang po thogs te/ rtse ba'i phyir skyedakhumos tshal gyi sar byung ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bsams pa 'di dgasregadulasaba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ de de dag gi gan du song ba dang /de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka khyod bram ze mdun na 'don gyi bu yin na/ ci'i phyir shākya'i bu'i dge sbyongashe'adi dag thams cad za ba dag gi nang du rab tu byung / tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas〈'di ltar/ de dag gi7phreng ba gang dag yin pa de dag ni kun dong gi phreng bar gyur/ khur ba gang dag yin pa de dag ni ba lang gi ko bar gyur/ sha gang dag yin pa de dag ni ba lang gi shar gyur/ btung ba gang dag yin pa de dag ni chang du gyur pa de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de dag la lhung bzed bstan te smras pa/ shes ldan dag ltos shig /kho bo'i lhung bzed na kun dong dang /ba lang gi ko ba dang / ba lang gi sha dang / chang yod snyam mamadzo/ ci khyed cag ni mgo la yang kun dong gi phreng ba thogs/ zas su yang ba lang gi ko ba dang / ba lang gi sha za'/ btung bar yang chang 'thung bas khyed cag thams cad za ba yin no'u/ /de dag gis gcig la gcig bltas na ⑩ji tsam na ⑥bdag cag thams cad kyi mgo la kun dong gi phreng ba thogs pa dang / /khur ba thams cad ba lang gi ko'u bar gyur pa dang / sha thams cad ba lang gi shar gyur pa dang / btung ba thams cad chang du gyur par mthong nas/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka khyod kyis bdag cag la dmod pa bor gyis0/bdag cag la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/8—145

bzod par7bya'o/ /de nas de dag snga ma kho bzhin du gyur pa dang / de dag ngo mtshar skyes nas de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka ci'i slad du byon/khyodakhucag nyid gdul ba'i don du 'ongs kyisal/ 'khod cig dang chos bstan par bya'o/ /de dag tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khod pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de dag chung ma dang bcas pa'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas 'di ltar/ bram ze0de dag chung ma dang bcas pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas pa de ltar chos bstan to/ /de dag gis bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag cag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsun pa 'char ka la brtenasnyenas/ btsun pa 'char gas bdag cag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag cag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/sngon gyi pha mes rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang / mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasal/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgralanya/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi'i ⑩nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar ⑪bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras 8wa 146

bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag cag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags7so/ /btsun pa bdag cag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag cag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yisal/ bdag cag dge bsnyen du gzungakhudu gsol/ deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'isrebar du glo ba thag⑧pa nas rab tu dang bas skyabs su mchi'oX/ /btsun pa 'char nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag cag gi ⑦bsod snyoms dang /na bza' dang / gnas mal dang / bsnyung ba'i rkyenasadang / sman gyi yo byad dag bzhes par ci gnang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ rab tu byung ba ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin pa la zhugs pa yin pas/ bram ze gzhan dgashel yang phan pa bya dgos so zhes smras te dang du ma blangs so/ /bram ze de dag gis smras pa/ gal te btsun pa 'char gas dang du mi bzhes na/bdag cag gis drang srong gi gdan bsham par bgyisayi/ btsun pa 'char ka gshegs te longs spyad par gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bram ze de dag la cang mi smra bas tsodang du blangs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de dag la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan / yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byas nas stan las langs te song ngo / /de na tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas mnyan yod du bram ze'i khyim lnga brgya lhag tsam gnyi ga nas btul zhing bzhag go//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong khyim dad par byed pa rnams kyi nang na mchog ni 'di lta ste/ dge slong 'char ka nag po0'di yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa 8—147

'char gas bsams pa/ gang gdul7ba'i dus yin snyamakhun/ mnyan yod na bram ze zhig gsang sngags dag gis7mi ma yin pa dbang du byas nas/ shing rta bcas te 'dren du 'judabapar byed nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas bsams pa/ bram ze desnyigadul ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kukhubram ze de gdul ba'i phyir 'phags pa dang / ji tsam na/ bram ze deshegasang sngags dag gis7mi ma yin pa dbang du byas nas/ shing rta bcas te 'dren du bcug nas mnyan yod kyi phyi rol du song ba na/ bram ze de shing rta las babs nas gcin gci bar brtsamasalgepa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas 'di ltar bram ze de'i gcin rgyun mi 'chad pa de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas gsang sngags kyi phur bu phyung ba dang / mi ma yin pa de bros te song ngo / /ji tsam na/ bram ze de langs pa dang mi ma yin pa bros par mthong nas/ des smras pa/ sus kho bo'i mi ma yin pa'i phur bu phyung / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ kho bos so/ /ci'i phyir khyod bram zer gyur nas mi ma yin pa0spyod dam/ des smras pa/ su zhig bdag gi bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de la lhung bzed bstan nas smras pa/ 'di khyod kyi bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ 'dis ci 'grub par 'gyur/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/ gang sems pa dang / gang 'dod pa de dag thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ji tsam na/bram ze de gang sems pa dang / gang 'dod pa de dag thams cad lhung bzed de las grub par gyur pa dang / bram ze de ngo mtshar skyes te des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ku ci'i slad du 'di ltar 'gyur/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus smras pa/8—148

kho bos lhung bzed kyi rig pa shes so/ /des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka lhung bzed kyi rig pa de bdag la stsal cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ rig pa su la'ang sbyin mi bya/ /rigatudang bcas te 'chi bar bya/ /rig pa rig dang gus pa dang / /nor gyi phyir ni sbyin par bya/ /bram zes smras pa/ bdag khyod la gus par bgyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ kho brokhukhyim pa las bsnyen bkur bdag gir mi byed kyi/ kho bo ni rab tu byung ba las ③bsnyen bkur bdag gir byed do/ /des smras pa/bdag rab tu 'byung dungo / /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas smras pa/ rab tu phyung ⑤shig ces des de rab tu phyung / rdzogs par bsnyen par byas te gdamasasnyengag byin no/ /de de ltar rab tu byung nas gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa/brtun7pa dang ldan pa bdag nyid btang bar gnas so/ /gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa/ brtun (sprepa dang ldan pa bdag nyid btang bar gnas pa na/rigs kyi bu dag gang gi phyir skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig dag bgos nas/ yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar byed pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i mtha' bla na med pa/ de0tshe de nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas te bsgrubs nas bdag gi skye ba zad do/ / tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar byed cing / dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan bzhag pa lta bur rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs dral bar gyur cing / rig pa dang / mngon par shes 8—149

pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa①/ srid pa dang 'dod pa'i rnyed pa dang / bkur ste ②la rgyab kyis ③phyogs paX/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjed ⑤par bya ba dang /mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bsams pa/gang gdul ba'i dus yin snyam na/ yul mi'i gyad gcigashegis yul dag tu gyad rnams brdabs nas mnyan yod du 'ongs te⑤/ mnyan yod na sgo khar rkang pa brkyang ste'u'adug cing / de gang la la 'ong ba de la 'di skad ces/ yang na ni kho bo la stobs rgol cig /yang na ni kho bo'i rlig bar du song shig ces zer ro/ /de na skye bo phal po che'i tshogs 'du ba dag las/ 'ga' yang de la stobs kyang mi rgol/ de'i rlig bar du yang mi 'gro'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas bsams pa/ gyad de gdul ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char na phyogs der song ste smras pa/ 'di su zhig yin/ skye bo phal po che'i tshogs kyis smras pa/ gyad 'di'i mchid tsonas 'di skad ces/ yang na ni kho bo la stobs rgol cigatso /yang na ni kho bo'i rlig bar du song shig ces mchi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de la smras pa/ ci je kho bo dang lhan cig stobs bya'amanya/ 'on te kho bos brdabs pa'i gyad gsum po gang dag yin pa de dag dang lhan cig stobs 'gyed/ des smras pa/ khyod kyis tsobardabs pa'i gyad gsum po gang dag yin pa de dag dang lhan cig stobs bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas smras pa/ kho bos 'dod chags kyi gyad brdabs/ zhe snang gi gyad brdabs/ gti mug gi gyad brdabs kyis/ khyod de dag dang lhan cig stobs khye shig ces/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus de btul nas des de rab tu 8—150

phyung / rdzogs par bsnyen par byas te gdamasatungag byin no/ /de de ltar rab tu byung nas gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa/ brtun ②pa dang ldan pa bdag nyid btang bar gnas so/ /gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa/ brtunasapa dang ldan pa bdag nyid btang bar gnas pa na/ rigs kyi bu dag gang gi phyir skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig skyidag bgos dunas/ yang rjodag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ⑦bar byed pa/tshangs par ⑧spyod pa'i mtha' bla na ⑨med pa de tshe de nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas te bsgrubs nas/ bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar byed cing / dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan bzhag pa lta bu rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs 0dral bar gyur cing / skyerig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang /so so yang dag par tsorig pa thob pa/ srid pa dang 'dod pa'i rnyed pa dang / bkur ste la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang / nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /gtum mo des bu'i chung ma blangs nas/ dus gzhan zhig na gtum mo yang dus la bab⑩/ de'i khyim thab kyang dus la bab bo /gtum mo'i bu de kha ton gyi zhor chal yul gzhan 0du song ngo / /gtum mo'i mna' ma de gos dang zas bzang (7zhing zhim pa la longs 6)spyod spyod sgo pas/nyon mongs pa dag gis gdungs par gyur nas/ des bu mo mngag gzhug ma la 8—151
