smras pa/ bu mo song la skyes pa lus brtan pa/ mkhrangatub/ dam paku'aga' ci snang tshol cig dang de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par bya'o/ /bu mo mngag gzhug mas smras pa/ jo mo khyod kyi gyos po dang sgyug mo gnyis ni bden pa mthong ba lags na/ khyod drang srong gi khyim 'di lta bur byon na nyes par spyod pa de lta bu ji ltar bgyir rung / drang srong gi khyim gyi mi snyan pa skyed par mdzadashedam ci/ des smras pa/ kwa'i khyod la bsam pa des ci byaX/ je song la khridakyide shog shig /gal ⑦te khrid de ma 'ongs na khyod la mtshams chen po gcad ⑧par bya'o/ /bu mos bsams pa/ bu zan ma'i ①bu mo 'dis drang srong gi khyim btsog gis dgang bar chad de/ bdag la dka' ba med kyis dgug go snyam nas/ de srang du song ba dang / des de na chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon lus brtan pa/ mkhrang ba dam pa zhig mthong nas/ des de la smras pa/ kye btsun po khyod kho mo'i jo mo dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod phod dam/ des smras pa/phod do/ /des de0khrid de jo mo dang sprad nas/ de de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka der dus dang dus su 'gro bas de mthong nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bsams pa/ bud med kyi yul 'di ni 'dod chags spyod pa zhig yin no snyam nas/ des de la 'dod chags kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod do/ /des bsams pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka ni gzhan gyi sems shes pa la mkhas pa yin pas des bdag 'phrigs kyisabya/ gal te de ma bsad na des bdag gi khyim thab la byas shing / de bdag la gnod pa byed par 'gyur du 'ong gis / bdag gis de bsad stedo snyam nas/ des chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon la smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka 8—152

ni gzhan7gyi sems shes pa la mkhas pa yin pas/ des bdag cag 'phrigs kyis②/ gal te de ma bsad na bdag gi khyim thab la byas shing / de bdag cag la gnod pa byed par 'gyur du 'ong gis②/ khyod kyis de sod cig /chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon gyis smras pa/ kho bo de mi gsod de/ de ni ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi ni7chung po grogs/ btsun mo phreng ldan ma'i ni slob dpon yin gyisal/ kho bos de bsad par gyur na kho bo rgyal pos rgya skyegs kyi khang par bcug ste/ bsregs pas 'chi bar bya dgos pa gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ gal te khyod de gsod na de lta na legs/ gal te mi gsod na khyod phyin chad kho mo'i khyim du 'jug par mi bya'o/ /'dod pa sten pa dag gis ni sdig pa'i chos mi bya ba ci yang med pas chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon des smras pa/ gal te de gzhan gyi sems shes pa la mkhas pa yin na kho bos ji ltar gsad par bya/ des smras pa/thabs kyi rnam pa zhig bya'o zhes des dus ma yin par tshe dang ldan pa 'char ga'i gan du mngag pa btang ste/ btsun pa 'char ka bdag bro 'tshal bar gyur na khyod kyis bdag gzigs par ci gnang zhes spring ngo / /dgra bcom pa dag ni ma bsams par shes pa dang mthong ba mi 'jug pas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yang dus ma yin par zhugs te/ de la chos bstan pa 0byas nas de phyir 'byung bar brtsamasalgepa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag khyod mthong na glo ba dga' bas yiyud tsam zhig bzhugs ⑥su gsol zhes/ des tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka (nyeji srid kyis shin tu (nyenam sros par gyur pa sde srid du bzung nas/com rkun pa'i dmag dpon yang ral gri shubs nas phyung ste sgo na sdod do/ /de 8—153

nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka phyir byunganyeb dang / chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon snying rje med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten pha rol btang ②ba des tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i mgo drung ba rgyanas bcad de sa la bskyel to/ /de ④'phags pa gsodakhucing 'dug pa bud med rgan mo zhig gis mthong nas/ des0smras pa/ gzu lums ⑦byed pa 'di su zhig yin⑧/ chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon gyis smras pa/ su la yang ma zer cig /kho bos khyod kyang 'di'i gnas skabs lta bur byas par gyur ta re/ de skrag nas 'phral du smra ma phod de⑩/bdag nyid chen po 'di'i rjes gcod tho)pa 'ga' zhig phyis 'ong grang snyam nas/de nyi da na cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /snying rje med pa'i sems dang ldan pa 'jig rten pha rol btang ba de gnyis kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i lus de phyag dar gyi phung po zhig tu sbas te bzhag go/ /de'i nyin mo gso sbyong gi zhal ta ba rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste smras pa/ 'ga' zhig gis btsun pa 'char ma'i 'dun pa blangs sam/ btsun pa 'char ka med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim dad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog de bsad kyis0/ chos gos dag long shig dang de'i lus la mchod pa bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa dang ji tsam na mnyan yod kyi sgo chod nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tsogaser gyi 'od lta bu'i 'od btang ba mdzad pa dang / des mnyan yod thams cad gser btso ma'i 'od lta bus snang bar gyur to/ /ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bsams pa/ci'i phyir mnyan yod thams cad gser btso ma'i 'od lta bus snang bar gyur snyam nas/ des yang bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs par bzhed gor ma 8—154

chag snyam nas/ de btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pas mnyan yod kyi lde mig khyer te/ sgo phye ba dang bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs so/ /ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bsams pa/ ci'i phyir bcom ldan 'das dus ma yin par mnyan yod du gshegs7snyam na②/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsnyen par dka' ba dang / bzod par dka' ba yin pas des ③sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhu bar ma nus0so/ /bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mdun du gshegasasnyenas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa bcom sgroldan 'das kyi slad bzhin slad bzhin⑧du rjes su 'brang zhing song ba dang / ji tsam na/ phyag dar gyi phung po'i phyogs der byon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag yikhyim pa chadad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog de 'dir sbas kyis phyung shig /de phyung ba dang de na gang dag tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la brten nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dag mthong ba de dag gis gsol pa/ 'di ()bdag cag gi dge ba'i bshes ()gnyen lags na/bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag 'di'i lus la mchod pa bgyid par ci ⑫ gnang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis gsol pa/ 'di bdag gi chung po grogs lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag 'di'i lus la mchod pa bgyid par ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /btsun mo phreng ldan mas gsol pa/ 'di bdag gi slob dpon lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag 'di'i lus la mchod pa bgyid ⑩par ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ngo / /de 8—155

nas btsun mo phreng ldan mas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ma'i lus de sa dkar gyis drilaphyi byed du bcug nas/ spos chus 'khruratubacug stenya/ ras kha dog sna tshogs dag gisashekhyogs spyi la brgyanasrenas/ der bcug ste bzhag go/ /de nasasnyibacom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mdun du gshegs nas/ rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa de'i phyi bzhin phyi bzhin du rjes su 'brang zhing song ste/ sa phyogs go skabs yangs pa zhig tu bzhag nas/btsun mo phreng ldan mas spos kyi shing thams cad kyis phung por bcer te bsregs nas/ phung po de 'o mas zhi bar byas te/ rus pa de dag gser gyi bum par bcug nas lam po che'i bzhi mdor lus kyi mchod rten rtsig tu bcug ste/gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng zhing / dri dang / phreng ba rgyu dang / bdug spos dang / phye ma dang / sil snyan dag gis mchod pa byas/ rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bshad pa mdzad de gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang du byon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nyes dmigs 'di dang gzhan dag kyang / dge slong dag⑧dus ma yin par grong du 'jug pa las gyur pas/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas/ 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhirkyubaca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyisarwa)'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dus ma yin par grong du 'jug na nyung byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 8—156

'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi de ltar bca' btumadzad do/ /dge slong nad ngan can dag 'khod pa dag gis yun ring du 'dug⑧par mi nus pa nasal/ dge slong nad g.yog dag gis kyang nad pa dag gi0bya ba nyams par byed/ dge slong zhal ta byed pa dag gis kyang dge 'dun gyi bya ba nyams par byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol rjopa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta ༷bas na dge slong 'dug pa la smras te 'gro bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong 'dug pa la smra bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nasal/ dge slong zhig gis khyim gzhan du lhung bzed dang chos gos bzhag nas/ ji tsam na der me shor nas dge slong des der 'gro bar brtsams te/ de lam gyi phyed du son pa dang / bdag gis dge slong 'dug pa la ma smras so snyam pa'i dran pa skyes nas de phyir log ste/ ji srid du dge slong 'dug pa la smra bar byed pa de srid du de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos tshig nas des der song ba dang / khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod ci'i slad du khyod 'phyis 7te byon/ des na khyod kyi 7lhung bzed dang chos gos tshig gyi/ gal te khyod myur du byon par gyur na khyod kyi lhung bzed dang chos gos tshig par mi 'gyur ro zhes zer zhing / dge slong de yang phongs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa dang / bslab pa la gus pa dang / bslab pa la yo byad bsnyungs pa'i 8bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la de dang mthun pa dang / de'i shas che ba dang / de dang 'tsham pa'i 8—157

chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid mdzad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de lta bas na snga ma ni bcas pa yin la/ 'di ni gnang ba yin te①/ nga'i nyan thosasakyisashe'adul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dus ma yin par grong du ④'jug cing dge slong 'dug pa la mi smra na de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs te nyung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhesashebya ba ni chos 'di pa'am/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dus ma yin par zhes bya ba ni dus ma yin pa gnyis su ste/ skya rengs0ma shar ba dang phyed yol bar ro/ /grong du zhes bya ba ni gang na srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dag yod par ro/ /'jug cing zhes bya ba ni 'gro zhing ngo / /dge slong 'dug pa la mi smra na zhes bya ba ni de na dge slong gang 'dug pa la'o/ /de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs te zhes bya ba ni de 'dra ba'i rkyen bzhag ste'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang / ngan 'grosalog par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/ 'tshod par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du nyung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ des na lhung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la lhung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis dus ma yin pa la dus ma yin par 'du shes pas grong du 'jug na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin pa la yid gnyis za bas grong du 'jug na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dus la dus ma yin par 'du shes pas/ grong du 'jug na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dus la yid gnyis za bas grong du 'jug na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 8—158

'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /btsun mo phreng ldan mas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la smras pa/ lhas dge slong rnams la ni gzhon nu'i yongs su spang ba ཿstsal/ dge slong ma rnams la ni btsun mo'i 'khor gyi yongs su spang ba stsalakhucing / 'phags pa 'charasheka lha'i ni chung po grogs lags/ bdag gi ni slob0dpon lags te/ dge slong rab tu grags pa de lta bu yang btsan thongarkyudu bkum na dge slong rab tu ma grags pa gzhan dgakyil bka' mchid kyang su7med par 'gyur/ lhas 'phags pa 'char ka de sus 'gums susastsal ba dang sus bkum pa bkas rma bar ci gnang / ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis zho shas 'tsho ba dag la bsgosheb/ shes ldan dag deng la 'phags pa 'char ka de sus gsod du bcug pa dang / sus bsad pa smras shig /de dag de rmed cing phyogs der dong bsnyedang / de dag gis de na bud med rgan mo de mthong zhing / des ni de dag ma mthong ba na/ bud med rgan mo des byung rgyal du smras ⑩pa/ phyogs 'dir khyim tsodad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog de sbas pa ni de dang de dag gis bsad do/ /de dag gis de thos nas smras pa/ rgan mo ci zer/ rgan mo des smrasalgepa/ cang mi zer ro/ /de dag gis de bzung ste bsdigs nas/ de sus bsad smros shig ces byas pa dang / des smras pa/ bram ze'i bu mo 'dis gsod du bcug go/ /com rkun pa'i dmag dpon 'dis bsad do/ /de dag gis kyang bsdigs te/ci de gnyis kho nar zad dam zhes rmas dupa dang / des smras pa/cha gzhan yang dugayon can lnga brgya yod do/ /rgyal po'i mi de dag gis 0bram ze'i bu mo de dang / chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon de dang / g.yon can lnga brgya po de dag 8—159

bzung ste rgyal po la phul nas smras pa/ lha 'phags pa 'char ka ni bram ze'i bu mo 'dis 'gums su stsalanyete/ chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon 'dis bkumakhumo/ /g.yon can lnga brgya po 'di dag gi dmag dpon ni 'di lags sonya/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag dengakhul bram ze'i bu mo 'disarte'u dmu rgod kyi rkang pa gnyis la thogs shig⑦ /chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon 'di ni rgya skyegs kyi khang par chug la sregasasashig /g.yon can lnga brgya po 'di dag ni lag pa dang rkang pa dag7chod cig /de dag gis bram ze'i bu mo de ni rte'u dmu rgod kyi rkang pa gnyis la btags so/ /chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon de ni rgya skyegs kyi khang par bcug ste bsregs so/ /g.yon can lnga brgya po de dag ni lag pa dang rkang pa dag bcad do/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas/ the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas las ci bgyis na/ las 8de'i rnam par smin pas sdang ba ma mchis pa dang / gnod pa ma bgyis bzhin du de gnyis kyis bkum par gyur cing / de gnyis kyang bkum par gyur/ g.yon can lnga brgya po dag kyang lag pa dang rkang pa dag bkum par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de dag nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas/ de dag nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi0/ 'di ltar 8—160

las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang /khams dang skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po tshangs ①byin zhes bya bas rgyal srid byed du bcug pa'i tshe nyam nga ba dang bcas pa'i dus byung ba na mu stegs can dag gis lo bcu gnyis su than pa 'byungasango zhes lung bstan nas/ rgyal po tshangs byinakhugyis dril bsgrag pa byed du bcug ste/ gang la7lo bcu gnyis kyi zan yod pa de ni 'dug shig /gang la med pa de ni song shig ces bsgo'o/ /de'i mdun dun 'don de bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam bram ze'i gsang tshig klog tu 'judashepa de la bram ze'i khye'u desnyedag gis smras pa/ mkhan po bdag cag la lo bcu gnyis kyi 'tshal ma ma mchis kyis bdag cag mchi'o⑩/ /des smras pa/ bu dag 'khod cig dang kho bos khyed la mkhochab bstabs par bya'o/ /rgyal po tshangs byin gyi rmi lam na bdag gi rgyu tsom dag gis grong khyer thams cad dkris ⑩par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de gzhi 'dis bdag rgyal srid las nyams pa'am/tshe'i bar chad 'byung ba'am/ gcig tu mi 'gyur grang 0snyam du 'jigs pa ⑫skyes par gyur nas/ des rmi lam de mdun na 'don de la bzlas yipa dang /mdun na 'don des bsams pa/ lhas rmi tshulam bzang po zhig gzigs mod kyi/ 'on kyang bram ze'i khye'u dag gi rnyed pa'i bar chad du gyur na mi rung gis0/ngan par bsnyad par bya'o snyam nas/ des rgyal po la smras pa/ lhas mi0lam ngan pa zhig gzigs pas/ gzhi 'dis rgyal srid las nyams pa'am/ sku che'i 8—161

bar chad 'byung ba'am gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'di la ci zhig bya/ des smras pa/ lha ba lang gi mchod sbyin stsal bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de ltar bya'o/ /des ba lang stong phrag du ma dag bsogs pa dang /rgyal po phyir byung nas rgyal pos ba lang de dag mthong ba dang / ba lang de dag gis ba ①lang gi 'u ③sgra chen po byung ngo ③/ /rgyal pos de dag mthong zhing thos nas/ de0snying rje skyes te0mdun na 'don la smras pa/ 'di dag thams cad gsad0par bya'am/ mdun na 'don gyis bsams pa/ rgyal po 'di dag thams cad bsad par mi 'dod do snyam nas/ des smras pa/ lha thams cad dgumasapar mi bgyi'o/ /de'i tshe nashernga bran zhig rnga bran mo zhig la rgyab rgal byed nas mdun na 'don gyis smras pa/ lha rnga bran dang rnga bran mo 'di gnyis dgum par bgyi'o/ /bram (7ze'i khye'u de dag gis kyang lag pa brkyang ()ste/'di gnyis lags so zhes bstan nas/ de gnyis bshas pa na sems g.yos pa/ bdag cag gnyis snang ba med pa dang / gnod pa ma byas bzhin du bsad pa gang yin pa de thams cad ni mdun na 'don 'di dang / bram ze'i bu lnga brgya po 'di dag gi le lan yin gyisatsho/ bdag cag gnyis gang dang gang du skyes pa na/ bdag cag chaganyis 0kyis mdun na 'don 'di sdang ba med pa dang / gnod pa ma byas bzhin du gsod pa dang / bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya po 'di dag kyang lag pa dang rkang pa dag gcod du 'jud ⑥par gyur cig ces ⑥snyam du dam bcas so/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po tshangs byin gang yin pa de ni da ltar ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po tshangs byin gyi btsun mo gang yin pa de ni da ltar btsun 8—162

mo phreng ldan ma yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na mdun na ①'don gang yin pa de ni dasaltar dge slong 'char ka yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgyasapo gang dag yin pa de dag ni da ltar g.yon can lnga brgya posredag yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na rnga bran gang yin pa de ni da ltar chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na rnga bran mo gang yin pa de ni da ltar bram ze'i bu mo yin te/ mdun na 'don de dang bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya po debadag gis rnga bran dang rnga bran mo de gnyis snang ba med pa dang / chaganod7pa ma byas bzhin du gsod du bcug⑧pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas da ltar yang chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon 'di dang / bram ze'i bu mo ⑨'di gnyis kyis 'char ka dang /g.yon can lnga brgya 0po dag snang ba med pa dang /zayi gnod pa ma byas bzhin du gsod du bcug go/ /btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas las ci zhig bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba'i khyim du skyes/ las ci bgyis na des bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis/ las ci zhig bgyis na des dgra bcom pa nyid thob kyang mtshon gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag rigs kyi bu 'char ka nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas/ 'char ka nyid kyis 0byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/8—163

chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyinyu/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba ②byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa'i tshe/rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang bkren pa la rjes su snying brtse ba bas mtha'i⑧gnas mal la dga' ba/ bse ru lta bu gcig pu 'jig rten gyi yonasreganas su gyur pa ⑤'jig rten du byung dungo / /ji tsam na ri brags shig na tshurngon pa zhig 'dug ste/ ri bragasasnyede dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig na ri dgas dang bya mang po dag gi rten du gyur pa mtshe'u zhig yod pa der rngon pa de nyi ma re re zhing ri dgas dang / bya mang po dag drungs dbyung ba'i phyir dang / nyams par bya ba'i phyir dang / tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal ⑩bar bya ba'i phyir rngon 8spyad dang / rnyi dang rnyong mang po dag 'dzugs par byed do/ /de'i rngon spyad dang /rnyi dang rnyong de dag kyang don yod pa yin no/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rang sangs rgyas shig ljongs rgyu zhing song ba na ri brags7der phyin nas/ lha'i gnas shig tu mtshan mo gnas par khas blangs nas/ de snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te ri brags der bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /der bsod snyoms brgyus nas bsams pa/ lha'i gnas 'di nyin mo rgyun lugs mang ba yin gyis/ ri brags kyi phyi roche gyi gnas zhi ba zhig tu bsod snyoms bza'o snyam nas/ de ri brags nas byung ste/ 'di ni zhi ba'o 8—164

'di ni zhi ba'o zhes mtshe'unyede ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ lhung bzed dang chu tshags mtha' gcig tu bzhag stelta/ rkang pa gnyis bkrus nas lag pa gnyisasnyebasnyal te0chu btsagasasnyenas/ lo ma lhags pa dag blangs te 'dug nas zas kyi bya ba byas te lag pa gnyis bsnyal nas/ kha bkrus te lhung bzed dang chu tshags gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bzhag nas/ rkang pa gnyis bkrus te shing drung zhig tu brten nas/ brang 'gro'i rgyal po nyal ba'i lus bskyil ba ltar skyil0mo krung bcas te spyod lam zhi bar 'dug pa dang / de'i nyin mo mi'i dris ri dgas gcig kyang ma zin to/ /de nas rngon pa de nang par sngar langs te/ mtshe'u de ga la ba der song nas des rngon spyadasnyedang / rnyi dang / rtong de dag byul bar brtsams pa dang / ri dgas gcig kyang ma mthong nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi rngon spyad dang / rnyi dang / rnyong 'di dag don yod pa yin na/ gang gi phyir der ri dgas gcig kyang ma zin pa 'di'i rgyu gang yin snyam nas/ des mtshe'u de'i than kor byul bar brtsams pa dang / mi'i rjes mthong nas de rjes de'i phyi bzhin du song ba dang / rang sangs rgyas spyod lam zhi bas 'dug pa de mthong nas des bsams pa/ rab tu byung ba sems zhi ba 'di dag gnas 'di lta bu dag tu mngon par dga' bar byed pas/ gal te bdag gis 'di'i srog bcad par tsom byas na/ 'di dag gis nges par bdag gi 'tsho ba gcod par byed kyisayi/ rnam pa thams cad du 'di gsad par bya'o snyam nas/ snying rje med pa'i sems dang ldan pa 'jig rten pha rol btang ba des mda' dug can gyis gzhu rnga'i dbyibs 'dra bar rna drung du thug par bkang ste rang sangs rgyas de'i gnad dudu bsnun to/ /rang sangs rgyas 8—165

bdag nyid chen po des bsams pa/ rngon pa nyon mongs pa 'di ha cang smasatupa dang nyams par gyur na mi rung gis②/ dasa'adi la lag nas drang ba zhig bya'o0snyam nas/ des ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dabasnyem brkyang ba ltar steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag bya bar brtsams0so so so'i skye bo ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du sems gtod par byed pa yin pas/ rngon pa de shing ljon pa rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rang sangs rgyas de'i rkang pa gnyis kyi drung du 'gyel nas smras pa/ yon gnas yang dag par gyur pa mar gshegs su gsol/ mar gshegs su gsol/ nyon mongs pa'i 'dam du bying ba bdag gi bug pa nas drang ba stsalashedu gsol/ rang sangs rgyas de rngon pa de la rjes su snying brtse0ba'i phyir/ steng gi nam mkha' las shod du babs so/ /de nas rngon pa des zug rngu med par byas te/ rma lhan gyis glan nas smras pa/ 'phags pa sdum par gshegs su gsol/ gal te 'dir gser gyi lhan pas glan ⑩par mdzad na/ de yang bdag gis sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /rang sangs rgyas kyis bsams pa/ bdag gis rnag gi lus 'dis thob par bya ba gang yin pa thob zin pas/ de'i phyir da ni phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 'jug par bya'o snyam nas/ de rngon pa de nyid kyi mdun du yang nam mkha'i dkyil du 'phags te/ cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs dag rnam par bstan nas/ phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /rngon pa de nor dang ldan pa yin pas/ des spos kyi shing thams cad kyis phung por bcer te bsregs nas/ phung po de 'o mas zhi 8—166

bar byas te/ rus pa de dag gser gyi bum par bcug nas/ lam po che'i bzhitumador lus kyi mchod rten rtsig tu bcug ste/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag bsgreng zhing / dri dang / phreng ba rgyu dang / bdug spos dang / phye ma dang / sil snyan dag gis mchod pa byas nas/ rkangakhupa gnyis la phyag 'tshal tekhusmon lam 'di skad ces/ bdag yon gnas yang dag par gyur pa 'di lta bu la gnod pa byas pa gang yin pa'i las de'i cha dang mthun par ma gyur par mchod pa 0byas pa gang yin pa'i dge ⑤ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/bdag phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba'i khyim du skye bar gyur cig ces btabalgebo/ /dge slong dag de la de'ikhutshe de'i dus na/ rngon pa gang yin pa de ni 'char ka 'di yin te/ des rang sangs rgyas kyi gnad du mda' dug can gyis bsnun pa gang yin pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas/ bskal par sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par gdungs nas/ las de nyid kyi lhag ma/sa tshe rabs lnga brgyar mtshe'u tho)'gram de nyid du ri dgas su skyes shing /mtshon gyis dus la bab ste/ da ltar gyi bar du yang dgra bcom pa thob kyang de mtshon gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /mchod pa byas nas7smon lam btabalgepa gang yin pa des ni da ltar phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba'i khyim du skyes so/ /btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus las ci bgyis na/las de'i rnam par smin pas 'disnyedus la bab pa'i lus phyag dar gyi phung por sbas pa dang / 'dis ston pa mnyes par bgyis shing / thugs byung bar ma bgyis pa dang / 'di dus la bab pa'i lus la ston pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang / rgyal po'i btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pas lus kyi 8—167

mchod pa bgyis pa de lta bu'i yon tan gyi tshogs thob par gyur①/ dge slong dag 'char ka nyid kyisakhulas tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyurakhub/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas/ 'char ka nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni/ phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyil/'di ltar las dge ba dang / mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon 'byung ba 'das pa'i dus na sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa'i tshe/rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang / bkren pa la rjes su snying brtse'ub bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ bse ru lta bu gcig pu 'jig rten gyi yon gnas su gyur pa dag 'jig rten du byung ngo / /gangs kyi sul zhig na rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya gnas te/ de na rang sangs rgyas gcig cig na bar gyur nas gzhan dag gis de la smras pa/ khyod bzhud la sman pa la rmos te cho ga ⑨mdzod cig /de ri brags gzhan zhig tu song nas mtshan mo rdza mkhan gyi ra ba zhig tu gnas par khas blangs pa dang / de mtshan mo na bar gyur nas dus la bab bo/ /rdza mkhan des de mthong nas des bsams pa/ rab tu byung ba 'di rdza 7so btang ba dang / ma btang ba dag gi nang du dus la bab pas 'jig rten ni 8—168

gtsang sbra0'dod pa yin pas/ gal te skye bo dag gisakhutshor bar gyur na 'ga' yang snod nyo bar mi 'gyur ro snyam nas/ des rang sangs rgyas kyisalus de phyag dar gyi phung po zhig tu sbas te bzhag go/ /rang sangs rgyas gzhan dag gis bsams pa/ bdag cag gi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa0de gar song snyamasnyenas bltas pa dang / ji tsam na yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mthong nas de dag gis de nyid nas spos kyi shing dag steng gi nam mkha' las khyer ༷te 'ongs nas rdza mkhan gyi ra bar babs pa dang / rdza mkhan gyisashede dag mthong nas/des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gar gshegs/ de dag gis smras pa/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la mchod pa byed du'o/ /rdza mkhan gyis smras pa/'dis kyang khyod ⑤kyi yon tan gyi tshogs 0lta bu dag ⑩thob bam/ de dag gis smras pa/ thob bo7/ /rdza mkhan gyis smras pa/ bdag gis 'di la bkur sti ma lags pa bgyis pas/ da bkur ste bgyi ba'i bar du yud tsam zhig gzhes su gsol/ de song ste rgyal po la smras pa/ lha bdag gi ra bar rab tu byung ba brtul zhugs grub pa zhig dus la bab kyis8/ lhas de la bkur sti mdzad du gsol/ rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa phyir byung nas/ des rang sangs rgyas kyi lus de spos kyi shing thams cad kyis phung por bcer te bsregs nas phung po de 'o mas zhi bar byas te rus pa de dag gser gyi bum par bcug nas lam po che'i bzhi mdor lus kyi mchod rten rtsig tu bcug ste/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng zhing / dri dang / phreng ba rgyu dang /bdug spos dang / phye ma dang / sil snyan dag gis mchod pa byas so/ /rdza mkhan des rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te smon lam 'di skad ces/ bdag yon 8—169

gnas yang dag par gyur pa 'di lta bu la gnod pa byas pa gang yin pa'i las de'i cha dang mthun par ma gyur par mchod pa byas pa gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag 'di bas ches khyad7par du 'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes par byed cing thugs byung bar byed par mi 'gyur ba dang / bdag dus la bab pa'i lus la yang ston pa nyan thos kyisnyedage 'dun dang bcas pa dang / rgyal po'ishebatsun mo'i⑧'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa mdzad par gyur cig cesasnyibatab bo//dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na rdza mkhan gang yin pa de ni da ltar dge slong 'char ka 'di yin te/ 'dis de'i tshe rang sangs rgyas de dus la bab pa'i lus de phyag dar gyi phung por sbas pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni da ltar 'di dus la bab pa'i lus phyag dar gyi phung por sbas so/ /'dis de'i tshe rang sangs rgyas kyi lus de la mchod pa byas te smon lam de skad btab pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas7ni da ltar 'dis rang sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum pas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa nga mnyes par byas shing thugs byung bar ma byas te/'di dus la bab pa'i lus la ston pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang /rgyal po'i btsun moshe'akhor dang bcas pas lus kyi mchod pa byas par gyur to/ /btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus las ci bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyimanyedad par bgyid pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan de ni smon lam gyi dbang gis te/ gang du smon lam btab ce na/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa chen po bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/8—170

'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyurasheb bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 'jig rten dukhubyung ste/ de bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ②ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar brten0cing bzhugs so/ /de'i bstan pa la 'di rab tu byung nas0dge slong gang gis de rab tu phyung0ba'i dge slong de de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gisakhukhyimanyedad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /de na 'dis tshe ⑩ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob nas de'i 'og tu 'chi ba'i tshe smon lam 'di skad ces/bdag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yiyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon gnas bla na med pa 'od srung kyil tshe ji srid par tshangs ⑩par spyod pa spyad kyang yon tan 'ga' yang ma thob ste/ bdag gis tshe ji srid par tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ⑩yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis 'bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la bram ze'i khye'u khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de'i bstan pa la bdag rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byed cing / ji ltar mkhan po 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ⑥yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 8—171

'od srung gisarkyukhyimasridad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de bzhin du bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ shākya'i⑧song ge/ shākya'i rgyal po'i gtso bo des khyimakhudad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan par gyur cig ces gdab ⑤par brtsams pasaX/ smon lam de'i dbang gis da ⑦ltar de bzhin gshegs pas khyimasnyedad par byed pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan to/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu gnagashepa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu gnag ⑩pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu tsodakar ba yinaX/ las 'dren ma rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang 'dren ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams dang / 'dren ma rnams spangs te las gcig tu dkar ba rnams la brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /dus ma yin par 'gro ba'i ltung byed de brgyad bcu pa rdzogs sgo'// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po drug bcu rtsalobargyad pa/ sdom la/zas bcas skya rengs da gdod dang / /khab ral dang ni khri rkang dang / /bdal dang gding ba g.yan pa dang / /ras chen bde gshegs chos gos so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag cig 'dug pa de'i khyim du nye dga' dus dang dus su 'gro zhing des de skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag la bzhag go/ /dus gzhan zhig na des de la rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi bdun po dag gi bsngags pa rgya ⑫8—172

cher brjod pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis kyang rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi cung zad bgyi'o/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ legs kyisanyede bzhin gyis shig ci zhig byed/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol lo/ /khyim bdag khyod kyis sems rgya chen po bskyed kyis ②gdugs tshod gsol cig /'phags pa khyod kyis bdag gi ming gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod la spyan drang ba'i⑧migs so/ /des dang du blangs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa nye dga'as khyim bdag de la a rog rgyabazhes byas te0song nas de gtsug lag khang du song ste/ des khyim bdag de'i ming gis sangs rgyas la rjosogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nye dga'asarkyukhyim bdag de ma dad pa yin na khyod kyis ji ltar rjes su 'jug par byas/ nye dga'asashesmras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag nye dga' la de tsam yang mi gnas sam/ rjes su 'jug par byas pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi7dag la yang bzhag go/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ legs par byas kyis 'dong la bza' bar bya'o/ /chos nyid kyis na gang gi ngor dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drangs pa de dus sngar 'gro ba yin pas tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' dus sngar 8der song nas des khyim bdag de la smras pa/ khyim bdag kho bo byakhyim du 'gro ba'i khyim dag lta'i byabar du khyod re zhig zhal zas sta gon gyis shig /kho bo ma 'ongs kyi bar du yang khyod kyis re zhig brim par mi bya'o zhes smras te song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 8—173

la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la khyim bdag de rgyus mi shes pa yin pas des spyan 'dren gtong bar mi byed kyis ①dus sngar sheg ②shig dang 'dong ngo zhes sgo ②zhig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas dge slong rnams la bsgo ba dang / dge slong rnams chas te lhags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis0mdun du bdar nas khyim bdag de'i khyim ga la ba der gshegs te sgo drung na gzhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo song la khyim bdag de la sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun sgo drung na gzhes kyis ci bdesagyis shig ces sgo0shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas nang du song ste/ khyim bdag de la khyim bdag sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun sgo drung na gzhes kyis ci bde gyis7shig /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis khyed cag gisaci bde7ci lags ni ma 'tshal gyi/ 'di ltar khyed cag kho na'i slad du gdan dag bshams kyis bzhugs su gsol / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag de'i mchid nas bdag gis khyed cag gi ci bde ci lags ni ma 'tshal gyi/ 'di ltar khyed cagatsokho na'i slad du gdan bshams kyis bzhugs su gsol zhes mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te de skad zer na khyed cag kho na'i phyir stan dag bshams pas ci bde byas par brjod par bya ste/ 'dug par bya zhing 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /sangs 8—174

rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bzhugs pa dang ji tsam na gdugs tshod la bab tu nye bas①/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la khyim bdag la gdugs tshod la ②bab tu nye bsasazhal zas brims0shig /zas 'dis khyod la ci zhig⑧bya zhes gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas khyim bdag la bsgo0ba dang / des smras pa/'phags pa nye dga' mchis sam/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/khyim bdag ma 'ongs so/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa de mchi'i bar du yud tsam zhig gzhesakyisu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag de'i mchid nas nye dga' mchis sam zhes mchi nas bdag gisalgem mchis so zhes bgyis pa dang / de'i mchid nas de mchi'i bar du yud tsam zhig gzhes7su gsol zhes mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yud tsam zhig gzhes ⑩nas yang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la khyim bdag la gdugs tshod la bab kyis zhal zas brims 8shig /zas rul bar gyur pa 'dis khyod la ci 'bya zhes gyis ④shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas khyim bdag la bsgo ba dang / des smras pa/'phags pa nye dga' mchis sam/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/khyim bdag ma 'ongs so/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa de mchi'i bar du yud tsam zhig gzhes7su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag de'i mchid nas nye dga' mchis 8—175

sam zhes mchisanyenas/ bdag gis ma mchis so zhes bgyis pa dang / de'ikhumachid nas de mchi'i bar du yud tsam zhig gzhesashes gsol zhes mchi'o④/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyodashesong la khyim bdag la nye dga' 'ongs par ma gyur na zan sbyin par mi byed dam zhes gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas khyim bdag la de skad smras pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa mi gsol lo/ /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das mi gsol lo zhes mchi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 0tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal pa/ gzhan dbang thams cad sdug bsngal te/ zhabadag dbang thams cad bde ba yin/ /thun mong dag gis gnod byed de/ /'brel pa shin tu 'da'akhubar dka'/ /ji tsam na gdugs tshod kyi mtha' la bab pa na nye dga' 'ongs nas des smras pa/ khyim bdag mi 'brim par ci ①sdod/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyi zhal nas kho bo ma 'ongs kyi bar du re zhig brim par mi bya'o zhes byung la da 'di skad ces gsung ngam/ nye dga' shags med nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de nas khyim bdag des brim par brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na gdugs tshod yol nas dge slong kha cig gis ni zan thob nas zan bcad pa byas/ kha cig gis ni zan ma thob pa kho nar 0zan bcad pa byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bshad pa mdzad de gshegs 8so/ /nye dga' ngo tsha bar gyur pa'i snying gis de nyid du 'dug go/ /de'i nyin mo gso sbyong gi zhal ta pa rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste/ dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo7zhing smras pa/ btsun pa nye dga' 8—176

matumachis sam/ 'ga' zhig gis de'i 'dun⑧pa blangs sam/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ de ma 'ongs te sus kyang de'i 'dun pa yang ma blangs so/ /dge slong gzhan dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag nye dga'as bdag cag snga dro ②zang zing gi ched la ches tho btsams ༷la/ da ni chos kyi ched la tho ⑤'tsham par byed do/ /dge slong don chung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag zas dang bcas pa'i khyim du mgron du bos nas snga dro dang / phyi dro khyim dag tu rgyu bar byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nye dga' la rmas7pa/ nye dga' khyod zas dang bcas pa'i khyim du mgron du bos nas snga dro dang / phyi dro khyim dag tu rgyu bar byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mdakudo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba tsom yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i0nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba 8—177

la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang zas dang bcas pa'i khyim du mgron du bos nas snga dro dang / phyi dro khyim dag tu rgyu natultung byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnamasashekyi bslab pa'i gzhi de ltar bca' bsnyemadzad do// —//dge slong nad ngan can dag 'khod pa dgasagis yun ring du 'dug mi nus nas dge slong nad g.yog rnams kyis nad pa'i bya ba nyams par byed cing /dge slong zhal ta byed pa dag gis kyang dge 'dun gyi bya ba nyams par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim pa 'dug pa la bsgo bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim pa 'dug pa la bsgo bar bya'o/ /zhes bka' stsal nas / dge slong zhig gis khyim gzhan du lhung bzed dang chos gos bzhag0nas ji tsam na der me shor nas/ dge slong des der 'gro bar brtsams te/ de lam gyi phyed du son pa dang / bdag gis0khyim pa 'dug pa la ma bsgo'o snyam pa'i dran pa skyes nas de phyir log ste/ ji srid du khyim pa 'dug pa la bsgosabar byed pa de srid du de'i lhung bzed dang / chos gos tshig nas de der song ba dang khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod ci'i slad du 'phyis7te byon/ des na khyod kyi lhung bzed dang chos gos tshig gi/ gal te khyod myur du byon par gyur na khyod kyi lhung bzed dang chos gos tshig par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer zhing dge slong de yang phongs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa dang / bslab pa la gus pa dang / bslab pa la yo byad bsnyungs pa'i 8—178

bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la de dang mthun pa dang / de'i shas che ba dang / de dang 'tsham pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid mdzadatunas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na snga ma ni bcas pa yin la/ 'di ni gnang ba yin te/ nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang zas dang bcas pa'i khyim du mgron du bos nas snga dro dang phyi drokhukhyim dag tu rgyu zhing khyim pa 'dug pa la mi sgo na de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs te ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni shākya'i bu nye dga' 'am/ gzhan yang desalta bu gang yin pa'o/ /zas dang bcas pa'i 0zhes bya ba ni mgron du bos pa dang bcas pa'i'o0/ /khyim du0zhes bya ba ni bram ze dang khyim bdag gi khyim du'o/ /mgron du bos nas zhes bya ba ni bsod snyoms kyi sgyer ro/ /snga dro zhes bya ba ni snga dro nyid de khyim gnyis las lhag par rgyu na'o/ /phyi dro zhes bya ba ni phyi dro nyid detukhyim gsum las lhag par rgyu na'o/ /khyim dag tu zhes bya ba ni bram ze dang / lakhyim bdagashegi khyim dag tu'o/ /rgyu zhing zhes bya ba ni 'gro zhing ngo / /khyim pa 'dug pa la mi sgo na zhes bya ba ni de na khyim pa gang 'dug pa la'o/ /de 'dra ba'i rkyen ma gtogs te zhes bya ba ni de 'dra ba'i rkyen bzhag ste'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang yi dgas ngan song dang ngan 'gro dang / log par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/ 'tshod par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du lhung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na/ dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ des na lhung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong ji tsam 8—179

cung zad zas dang bcas pa'i khyim du mgron du bos nas7snga dro khyim gnyis las lhag par rgyu zhing phyi dro yang khyim gsum las lhag par rgyu na thams cad dushesang byed du 'gyur ro/ /de'i ngor mgron du bos pa ma yin na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang sems 'khrugasalgepa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /grong rgyu ba'i ltung byed de brgyad bcu rtsa0gcig pa rdzogs lha'i// //sgo gtan gyi bslab pa'i gzhi'i bar sdom la/ dga' bo nye dga' zhag bdun dang / /bzang byin sdums byed tshul khrims dang / /nag po tshigs bcad 'char ka dang / /bcu dang bslab gzhi'i7rim pa dang / /grong khyer gnyis dang g.yul gzhi dang / /lha mo kharashephor 'phyang ba dang / /sngo bsangs rgyal srid pog ka na/ /ma la kharanyeb byin pa dang / /lham gyi dbang phyug mnyan yod dang / /sngon gyi tshul dang nor bzangs dang / /drang srong rnams dang gtsug lag khang / /mgu byed dang ni gzungs 0byed dang / /stong thub dang ni 'brog gnas dang / /lag brgyud dang ni sngo bsangs can/ /mi gdung rnams su skyes pa dang / /dpa' chen dang ni skur mchog dang / /dpe med ma dang lcags mgar dang / /sing ga la dang shar pa dang / /snyan smra dang ni tshig pa dang / /skur dang thos pa 'dzin pa dang / / bran mo dang ni bram ze mo/ /mgu byed dpal ldan gyur pa dang / /shā ri'i bu ni zhugs pa dag /sgo gtan yang dag bsdus pa yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 8—180

'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dgatudagon pa dang shing drung dang / khyim gyis stong pa dang / ri bul dang / ri phug dang / rtswasaspyil dang / bla gab med pa dang / dur khrod dang / nags khrod dang / ri drung dang / bsasnyematha'i gnas mal 'di dag tu bsam gtan gyis shig /dge slong dag bag yod par bsgrubs la phyis 'gyod par mi 'gyur bar gyis shig /'di ni nga'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong rnams dgon pa dang / shing drung dang / khyim gyis stong pa dang / ri sul dang / ri phug dang / rtswa spyil dang / bla gab med pa dang / dur khrod dang / nags khrod dang / ri drung dang / bas mtha'i gnas malasadag tu zhugasashete/ kha cig ni ri rab kyi bang rim na bsam gtan byed/ kha cig ni gser gyi ri bdun po dag la/ kha cig ni mtsho chen po ma dros pa na/ kha cig ni rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab pa na/ kha cig ni rnal 'byor pa'i skye bo dang rjes su mthun pa'i grong dang / grong rdal dang / yul dang yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang gi phyogs de dang de dag na bsam gtan byed do/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i nang du nub/ dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu las mngon par 'phags te de la dpag tshad 'bum drug khri yod do/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi ngos re re la dpag tshad brgyad khri brgyad khri yod de⑩/ de dag la dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri yod do/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa yin te⑩/ der klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' gnyis skyes nas de gnyis kyi 8lus kyis de lan 8—181

gsum dkris7te 'khod cing bskal par gnas pakhus 'dzin pa/ 'dab chags kyi rgyal po 'dab bzangs kyis dbyung b.rakhumi nus pa yin no/ /de gnyis 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag gnyis kyi bsod nams kyi0gnas 'di byung ngo snyam nas de gnyis ser snas kun nas dkris pas nyin mo lan gsum mi mthun pa'i rlung gtong ste/ des ri rab kyi bang rim la gnas pa'i ri dgas dang /bya mang po dag tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /de na dge slong gang dag ri rab kyi bang rim na bsam gtan byed pa de dag kyang mi mthun pa'i rlung des skya bo bseng bseng por gyur cing / rid pa dang nyam chung ba dang / rke ba dang lus ma thob par gyur nas de dag dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po dag 'das nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du mnyan yod du lhags pa dang /dge slong rnams kyis de dag mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so/ /khyed cag ga las 'dir 'ongs/ khyed cag dbyar gang du gnas par khas blangs/ de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag ri rab kyi bang rim nas 'dir 'ongs so/ /bdag cag ri rab kyi bang rim du dbyar gnas par khas blangs so/ /dge slong rnams kyisasasmras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag ci'i phyir skya ⑨bo bseng bseng por gyur cing / rid pa dang nyam chung ba dang / rke ba dang lus ma thob par gyur/de dag gis smras pa tshe dang ldan pa dag ri rab kyi bang rim du klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis skyes nas de gnyis kyi lus kyis de lan gsum dkris te 'khod cing bskal par gnas pa'/ sa 'dzin pa/ 'dab chags kyi rgyal po 'dab bzangs kyis dbyung bar mi nus pa yin no/ /de gnyis 'di snyam du 8—182

sems te/ bdag cag gnyis kyi bsod nams kyisheganas 'di byung ngo snyam nas de gnyis ser〈snas kun nas dkris pas nyin mo lan gsum mi mthun pa'i rlung gtong ste/ des ri rab kyi bang rim la gnas pa'i ri dgas dang / bya mang po dag tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /bdag cag kyang mi mthun pa'i rlung des skya bo bseng bsengasapor gyur cing / rid pa dang nyam chung ba dang /rke ba dang lus ma thob par gyur to/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed kyis de gnyis gdul bar mi nus sam/ de dag gis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag re zhig de gnyis bdag cag gis gdul ba ma yin no/ /'o na sus gdul ba yin/ nyan thos chen pos gdul ba yin no zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ⑤bcom ldan 'das dul gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ de gnyis gang gis gdul ba yin snyam na⑦/dge slong mod galakhugyi bu chen pos gdul ba yin par gzigs shing mkhyen nas/tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu ri rab kyi bang rim na klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga'algeganyis la soms shig /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas 'di lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te0/ ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na mnyan yod nas mi snang bar gyur cing / ri rab kyi bang rim du son par gyur pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs 8so/ /de'i tshe na 0klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis gnyid log par gyur nas des se gol gyis sad par bya bar brtsams na de gnyis ma sad do/ /des de gnyis kyi steng du bcag par brtsams na de lta na 8—183

yang de gnyis ma sad do/ /des de gnyis kyi stor zhugs te sprin chen ponyebazhin du 'brug bsgrags ②par brtsams na de lta na yang de gnyis ma sad do/ /des klu chen po'i lus kyis ③ri'i rgyal po ri rab la lan bdun dkris ④te steng du gdengs ka chen po byas te 'dug pa dang / de gnyis khur lci bas mnan pas sad de ji tsam na klu chen po zhig gis bdag cag gnyis mnan par mthong nas de gnyis kyis bsams pa/ klu rdzu 'phrul chen po zhig byung ste bdag cag gnyis gnas 'di nas nyams par gyur gyis7bros te 'dong ngo snyam du rig nas skrag ste/bram ze'i khye'u'i kha dog tu bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas 'bros par brtsams sol/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba de phyir bsdus nas/ de gnyis kyi mdun du 'dug ste smras pa/ klu'i dbang po gnyis gar 'dong / de gnyis kyis0smras pa/ klu rdzu 'phrul chen po zhig byung ste / bdag cag gnyis 'di nas nyams par gyur gyis 'brosaXsu 'gro'o/ /des smras pa/ tshur shog klu de ci 'dra ba blta'o/ /de gnyis de dang lhan cig phyir log pa dang / ji tsam na mi snang nas de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pas bdag cag gnyis la ku re ma bgyis sam/ des smras pa/ de yin no 'o na bdag cag gnyis kyis nongs pa ci bgyis/ rga ba'i chos can khyed gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyi pho nya 'ongs pa la ma bsams thonye/ /'phags pa khyod sangs rgyas kyi pho nya lags sam/ sangs rgyas kyi pho nya yin no/ /'phags pa gal te khyod sangs rgyas kyi pho nya lags na bdag cag gnyis kyis ci bgyi banyestsal du gsol/tshur shog ④bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga kho nar 'dong ngo / /'phags pa ma nongs te de bzhin bgyis bzhud do/ / de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi 8—184

bu chen pos klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' gnyis khrid nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi slad du bdag la bka' stsal pa'i klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' de gnyis ni 'di lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i dbang po khyed gnyis sngon gyi nyes par spyad pas klu'i skye gnas ngan par skyes shing khyed gnyis da ltar drag shul can/ lag pa khrag gis7gos pa/nyams pa dang / rab tu nyams pa la zhen pa/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrogasalgepa/gzhan gyi srog bcadashepas 'tsho bar byed de/ 'di nas shi 'phos na khyed gnyis kyi 'gro ba ni0cir 'gyur/ skye ba ni cir 'gyur/ tshe phyi ma0ni cir 'gyur/de gnyis kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gnyis kyis ci zhig bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ klu'i dbang po gnyis tshul shogatunga'i drung du skyabs su 'gro ba dang/ bslab pa'i gzhi dag long tshul ri rab kyi bang rim la gnas pa'i ri dgas dang / bya rnams la mi 'jigs pa byin cig /de gnyis kyis gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag cag gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar skyabs su mchi ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag len cing ri rab kyi bang rim la gnas pa'i ri dgas dang / bya rnams la mi 'jigs pa stsol to/ /de gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag blangs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 8—185

gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngashenas dong ngo / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas/ the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis kyis las ci bgyis na las ②de'i rnam par smin pas klu'i nang du skyes/las ci bgyis na des rin po che sna bzhi las bgyis pa'i gnas mngon par grubasnyecing lha'i bdud rtsi'i zas dang sbrang rtsi'i0chang gi btung ba dang / re re la yang 'khor nyis stong lnga brgya dang ldan par gyur/ las ci bgyis na des nasnyibaskal par gnas pakyis 'dzin pa/ 'dabashechags kyi rgyal po 'dab bzangs kyisalgedabyung bar rngo mi thog par gyur⑨/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag 'di gnyis kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing / bsags pas 'di gnyis kyisaspelas byas shing / bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/'di ltar las dge ba dang / mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnamatsha la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa chen po bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i 8tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 8—186

sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul ba'i7kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de dge slong nyi khris bskor cing grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar brten ②cing bzhugs ②so/ /de'i tshe na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po kṛ tī ①zhes bya ba 0rgyal srid 'byor pa rgyas pa/bde ba lo legs pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba/ thab mo dang / 'thab pa dang / phyi dgra dang nang 'khrug rab tu zhi ba/ chom rkun dang mu ge dang bral ba/ sā lu dang bu ram shing gi phreng ba dang / ba lang dang ma te phun sum tshogs pa byed du bcug ste/ chos dang ldan pasachos kyi rgyal pos chos kyi rgyal srid byed du bcug go/ /rgyal po kṛ khris7de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 'jig rten du byung ste/ de dge slong nyi khris bskor cing grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar brten cing bzhugs zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i mthu chen pos yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ga la ba der song ste/ rgyal po kṛ khrisalgeyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis sku legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcusacasku rnam par mdzes pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis gzugs can brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong 8—187

bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i ri bo kun du 'gro ba ltar bzang btumathong ngo / /mthong ma dag ②tu rgyal po kṛ tī ③bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la shin tu dad pa skyes nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ga la ba der song ste phyin nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rgyal po kṛ tī'isnyibasam pa dang / bag la nyalasnyedang / khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas gang thos naX/ rgyal po kṛ khris stan de7nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de lta bur 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yang dag par so sor rtogs par byed pa'i chos bstan pa mdzad do/ /des bden pa mthong nas btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams0/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag go zhes lan gsum ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /yang smras pa/ khyod mthus rab drag nyes pa mang ldan pa'i/ /ngan song shul bkag bsod nams rab ldan pa'i/ /mtho ris 8—188

'gro ba phye zhing bdag gis ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i shul yang thob par gyur①/ /shin tu rnam dag khyod brten bdag gis ni/ /de ring skyon bral dag pa'i mig thob cing / /go 'phang zhi ba 'phags pa dgyes thob ste/ /sdug bsngal rgya mcho'ilgepha rol rgalakhubar gyur/ /'gro bar0lha min mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang na 'chi bral ba po/ /srid pa stong du mthong ba rab dkon pa/ /thub pa de ring khyod mthong 'bras bu mchis/ /zhes smras te stan las langs nas yang dag parasnyerdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la lan gsum bskor ba byas te zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas song ngo / /gang gi tshe rgyal po kṛ khris yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar bden pa dag mthong ba de'i tshe na de don gyi gnas su 'dug ste/ blon po dang grong khyer pa dang / yul mi rnams la smras pa/ kwa'i blon po dang / grong khyer pa dang / yul mi dag nyon cig /ngas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar bden pa dag mthong bas da ngas ④chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du 'jug mi nus kyis7de'i phyir khyed7kyis gzhon nu legs skyes rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug gi bdag por zhog shigatso /nga yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar skra dang / kha spu dag bregs te gos ngur smrig dag bgos nas yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /de la blon po'i mchog dga' bo dang / nye dga' zhes bya ba gnyis shig yod pa de gnyis kyis de'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lhas mtshan ma tsam 'ba' zhig mdzod cig dang bdag cag gnyis kyis chos kyis lha'i rgyal srid bgyid du stsal tsoto/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de lta tson byed du chug shig /8—189

de gnyis kyis ji srid pa de srid du chos kyis7rgyal srid byed du bcug nas yang richos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du gzhug par brtsams ②pa dang / de gnyis kyi nye du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba de dag de gnyis kyi gan du 'ongs te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gnyis chos kyis ③rgyal srid byed du chug shig /chos dang chos ma yin pas byed du ma gzhug shigadu /sems can dmyal ba la gzhol bar 'gyur b.rasnyem byed cig /de gnyis kyis de dag las thos nas ji srid pa de srid 0du chos kyis ⑦rgyal srid byed du bcug nas yang chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du gzhug par brtsams pa dang / de dag yang de gnyis kyisnyegan du 'ongs te7smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gnyis chos kyis ⑩rgyal srid byed du chug shig /chos dang chos ma yin pas byed du ma gzhug shig /sems can dmyal ba la gzhol bar 'gyur bar ma byed cig /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag blon po dag ni rgyal srid bgyid du stsol yib gsang tshig mthun pas 'tsho ba lags pas gcig tu chos kyis ⑩rgyal srid bgyid du stsol tsoba'i rngo mi thog stekhya/ nges par kho nar khyad par can ma lags pa dag ni tshar bcad par bgyi zhing khyad par can dag ni yongs su bskyang bar bgyi 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis smras pa/ gal te de lta na yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i gtsug lag khang byed du chuganyel yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul la/ dge slong rnams la ni gzhon nu'i yongs su spang ba byin cig /dge slong ma rnams la ni btsun mo'i 'khor gyi yongs su spang ba byin cig dang / des khyod gnyis la yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang bde 8—190

bar 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ma nongs kyis7de bzhin bgyi'o zhes de gnyis kyis0yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i gtsug lag khang byed du bcug⑧ste yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul zhing / dge slong rnams la ni gzhon nu'i yongs su spang ba0byin/ dge slong ma rnams la ni btsun mo'i 'khor gyi yongs su spang bsabyin no/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po kṛ khri'i0blon po'i mchog dga' bo dang / nye dga' zhes bya ba desheganyis ni da ltar klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' 'di gnyis yin te/ de gnyis kyis chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du bcug⑧pa gang yin pa des ni klu rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i gtsug lag khang byed du bcug ste yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul ba gang yin pa des ni rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i gnas mngon par grub cing lha'i bdud rtsi'i7zas dang / sbrang rtsi'i chang gi btung ba dang / re re la yang 'khor nyis stong lnga brgya dang ldan par gyur te⑩/dge slong rnams la gzhon nu'i yongs su spang ba byin pa dang / dge slong ma rnams la btsun mo'i 'khor gyi yongs su spang ba 'byin pa gang yin pa des 0ni bskal par gnas patso/ sa 'dzin pa 'dab7chags kyi rgyal po 'dab bzangs kyis dbyung bar mi nus par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de ltar na las gcig tu gnaganepa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi rnam par smin dzu )pa yang gcig tu dkar ba yin( spre/las 'dren ma rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang 'dren ma yin no/ /dge slong 8—191

dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnaganyepa rnams dang 'dren ma rnams spangs te/las gcig tu dkar ba rnams la brtsalasabar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag la bkod pa de'i tshe na de gnyis tshes brgyad dang / tshes bcu bzhi dang / tshes bcosalnga la ri rab kyi bang rim du 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byed do/ /de gnyis gang gi tshe mtshan mo bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byed pa de'i tshe na ni gzhal med khang pa'i cha lugs kyis bsnyen bkur byed cing / gang gi tshe nyin mo bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byed pa de'i tshe na ni khyim bdag gi cha lugs kyis bsnyen bkur byed do/ /dus gzhan zhig na de gnyis nyin mo khyim bdag gi cha lugs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ngo / /ji tsam na ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal yang rgyal byed kyi tshal ga la ba der song ngo / /rgyal rigs ni mngon pa'i nga rgyal can yin pas rgyal po de gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gro ba de'i tshe na bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ba na du'aga' zhig bdag la mngon sum ⑦du ldang bar mi 'gyur ba med grang snyam nas mi dag pa'i mtha' can gtong bar byed pa yin⑧pas de nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgor bsdad de mi dag pa'i mtha' can zhig la smras pa/ kwa'ishenang rje song la bcom ldan 'das la su dag bsnyen bkur byed pa 0ltos shig /mi dag pa'i ⑩mtha' can des lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal las mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ba dang / ji tsam na khyim bdag gnyis shig bcom ldan 8—192

'das la bsnyen bkur byed pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyanganyeko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ga la ba der song ste phyin nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyalasal 'di skad ces gsol to①/ /lha khyim bdag gnyis shig bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur bgyid de de gnyis lha'i yul na gnas pa dag lags gor ma bkum mo/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/ khyim bdag de gnyis bdag gi yul na gnas pa yin pas de gnyis kyis bdag mthong na mngon du ldang bar 'gyur grang snyam nas de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga'0gnyis kyis ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa ci lags re zhig dam pa'i chos la bsnyen bkur bgyi'am/ 'on te rgyal po la bsnyen bkur bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ klu'i dbang po gnyis re zhig dam pa'i chos la bsnyen bkur gyis shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rjodam pa'i chos la gus par mdzad de dgra bcom pa dag kyang chos bla mar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di la tshigs su bcad pa dag bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas gang dag 'das pa dang / /sangs rgyas gang dag ma byon dang / /sangs rgyas mya ngan selatsamadzad pa/ /da ltar mang po gang bzhugs dag /thams cad dam pa'i chos la ni/ /gus par gnas gyur gnas 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin gus par gnas mdzad de/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos nyid yin/ /de phyir bdag la legs 'dod cing / /bdag nyid chen po mngon 'dod pal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dran byed na/ /'di la dam chos gus par bya/ /de gnyis kyis ko sa 8—193

lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la mngon du ldang b.ratum byas pa dang / rgyal po khros te bsams pa/ khyim bdag 'di gnyis bdag gi yul na gnas pa dag yin na bdag la mngon du ldang b.rakhumi byed do snyam nas de khro bsashekun nas dkris dubazhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di khro bas kun nas dkrisasnyeso snyam nas bka' mchid gzhan dag mdzad par brtsams 0te chos ston par mi mdzad pa dang / des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos bstan du gsol/ /bde bar gshegs pa chos bstan du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa dag bka' stsal pa/ rab tu dang sems med pa dang / /zhe sdang can dang 'khrugs pa yis/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs bstan pa yi/ /dam chos kun shes bya mi nus/ /gang gis nyes rtsom btul byas shing / /rab dang med pa'i sems bsal te/ /kun nas mnar sems 'di spong ba/ /des ni legs gsungs shes par 'gyur/ /rgyal po rgya cher de gnyis la khros te bsams pa/ 'di gnyis la brten nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyachos mnyan pa yang rgyun bkum mo snyam du rig nas sdod cig ces byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gzhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas ⑨stan las langs te song ngo / /gang gi tshe klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' gnyis nyin mo bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byed pa de'i tshe na de gnyis kyi zho shas7'tsho ba dag gis ri rab kyi bang rim nas mnyan yod kyi bar gyi lam ji srid pa'i lam gyi ngos gnyis su rtsig pa dngar te 'khod par byed do/ /ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan 8—194

dag gang gi tshe khyim bdag 'di gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas phyir byung bar gyur pa de'i tshe na 'di gnyis kyi mgo bo drungasatunas chod la sa la sgyel bar gyis shig /tshig de skad ces smras pa/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' gnyis kyi〈zho shas 'tsho ba dag gis thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag 'khrugs nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi steng du rdo rje rtse gcig pa chadang /'khor lo dang mda' bo che dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dul sogs pa'i mtshon dag 'phang bar brtsams so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos can yin pas de nas rjobacom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la soms shig /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las bka' mnyan nas/ byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de la snyoms par zhugs pa'i bye brag gis0rdo rje rtse gcig pashedang / 'khor lo dang / mda' bo che dang / mtshon rtse gcigasal sogs pa'i mtshon de dag lha'i me tog utpa la dang / pad ma dang /ku mu da7dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man rā ra ba dag tu gyur te/ ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi steng du 'bab par brtsams so/ /de lha'i me tog utpa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu dgyedang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dra ra ba dag gis gang bzhin du khyim du zhugs nas des btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang blon po dang khrom gyi ru sna dang / grong rdal gyi mi dang /yul mi dang / bram ze dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga rgyal byed kyi tshal du 8—195

zhugs0tshun chad nas lha'i me tog utpa la dang / pad ma dang 9 ku mu dashe— dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man tā0ra ba dag gis gang bzhin du khyim du zhugs pa 'di ci yin su yisnyimathu yin/ de na gang dag snyan pa dang 'jam par smra ba la mkhas pa de dag gis smras pa/ lha gzhan su zhig gis 'di 'tshal bar 'gyur/ 'di gzhan su zhig gi0mthu lags/ 'di ltar lha nyid chos kyis rgyal srid bgyid du stsolasnyibs 'di lha nyid kyi mthu lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/shes ldan dag de bden te/ da chos kyis 0rgyal srid byed du 'jug pas 'di gor ma chag par nga'i mthu yin no/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis smras pa/ bdag cag lha las gzhan pa'i skyes pa'i gan du mi mchi zhing bdag po las mi 'phyo bas 'di ni bdag cag gi mthu lags so/ /gzhon nu rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag yab yum la gus shing sri zhu che bas 'di ni bdag cag gi mthu lags so/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag chos kyis lha'i rgyal srid bgyid du stsol bas ⑩'di ni bdag cag gi mthu lags so/ /khrom gyi ru sna dag gis smras pa/bdag cag lha'i bka' chos dang ldan par sgrub par bgyid pas 'di ni bdag cag gi mthu lags sgos/ /grong rdal gyi mi dang yul gyi mi dag gis smras pa/bdag cag lha la chos dang ldan par dpya 'bul bas 'di ni bdag cag gi mthu lags so/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/ 'di dag so so nas bdag caganyegi mthu'o//bdag gi mthu'o zhes zer na su'i mthu yin pa mi shes kyisayi/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa/mkhyen pa dang shes bya la bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes pa yin gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhur 'gro'o snyam du rig nas lha'i me tog utpa la dang /8—196

pad ma dang / ku mu datudang / pad ma dkar po dang / man rākhur ba de dag gis thu ba bkang nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis skabs de bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po de ni khyod kyi mthu yangasam yin/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyi yang ma yin/ gzhon nu rnams kyi yangakhum yin/ blon po rnams kyi yang0ma yin/ khrom gyi ru sna'i yang ma yin/ grong rdal gyi mi dang /ljongs kyi mi rnams kyi yang ⑦ma yin/ bram ze rnams kyi yang ⑧ma yin te/'di ltar de ni dge slong med gal gyi bu chen po'i mthu yin te/ gal te dge slong mod gal gyi bu chen pos khyod btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang grong rdal gyi mi dang / yul gyi mi dang bcas pa la ma bsams su zin na deng7nyid du mnyan yod spyod yul du mi 'gyur ba zhig na/ de ni dge slong mod gal gyi bu des khyod btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong rdal gyi mi dang / yul mi dang bcas pa la0bsams pa'i mthu yin gyis〈nyede la sems mngon par dad par gyis shig /rgyal pos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ltar dge slong mod gal gyi bu'i mthu lags shing bcom ldan 'das kyi yang ma lags nyan thos chen po gzhan dag gi yanganyem lags par ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ rgyal po chen po de ni nga'i mthu yang ma yin/ nyan thos chen po gzhan dag gi yangakhum yin te/ 'di ltar de ni dge slong mod gal gyi bu'i mthu yin no/ /gal te khyod som nyi dang yid gnyis za na lha'i me 8—197

tog utpa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu danyedang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā phyir ba 'di dag sa la bor ①zhig /des de dag sa la bor ba dang /rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / 'khor lo dang / mda' bo che dang / mtshon rtse gcigakyil sogs pa'i mtshon sha stag tu gyur to/ /des de dag mthong nas nyam nga bar gyur te gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang /nye dga' gnyis la rab tu snang ba'i sems bskyed pas de las 'di byung ngo / /rgyal pos gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag gis klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga'algeganyis mthong bar yang mi dran na rab tu snang ba'i sems bskyed par lta ga la 'gyural/ rgyal po chen po ngas khyod la dran par bya'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dran par mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis nga'i mdun dukhukhyim bdag gnyis shig chos nyan pa gang yin pa de gnyis kyis7khyod la mngon du ldang ba ma byas pa de dran nam/ bcom ldan 'das de dran no/ /rgyal po chen po khyim bdag de gnyis ni klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' gnyis yin no/ /des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de gnyis 'khrugs par ma gyur tam/ rgyal po chen po de gnyis ni 'khrugs par ma gyur te/ de gnyis kyi zho shas 'tsho ba dag 'khrugs par gyur to8/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de gnyis la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ rgyal po chen po bzod pa gsol bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de gnyis ni ri rab kyi bang rim na mchis la/ bdag ni 'di na mchis na bdag gis ji ltar de gnyis la bzod pa gsol bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po de gnyis tshes brgyad dang /8—198

tshes bcu bzhi dang / tshes bco lnga la nga'i rkang pa7la phyag⑧'tshal du 'dir 'ong gis7khyod kyang tshes brgyad dang0bcu bzhi dang / tshes bco lnga la 'dir shog shig dang ngas khyod la de gnyis bstan par bya'i khyod kyis bzod pa gsol cig / des gsol pazha btsun pa ci lags bdag gis de gnyis kyi rkang pa gnyis la gtugashepar bgyi'am/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis7de gnyis kyi rkang pa gnyis la gtug par mi bya ste/ 'di ltar mi ma rabs dag gi 7rkang pa la phyag 'tshal ba gang yin pa de ni mi gtso bo dag gis tshulag pa nas bzung ba yin gyis 'khyod kyis lag pa g.yas pa skyong skyil klu'i dbang po gnyis bzod pa mdzod cig ces bzod pa gsol cig dang de gnyis bzod par 'gyur ro/ /des gsol pa/ btsun pa ma nongs te de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes gsol nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te song ngo / /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang /nye dga' gnyis ri rab kyi bang rim dune'ongs nas bdag nyidakhekhyim bdag gi cha lugs su mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong yinas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'khod do/ /ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal yang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la brda mdzad do/ /de nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu byas nas yilag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste ⑦smras pa/ klu'i dbang po gnyis bzod pa mdzod cig /de gnyis kyis smras pa/8—199

rgyal po chen po bzod par bgyi'o/ /de nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dngatu/ nye dga' gnyis la bzod pasnyegasol nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba desalogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nasaphubacom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gisasnyi'aphags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la0mchod pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pas bdag gi sdum par dgung bdun gyi bar du gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsalakhurgyal la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo //de nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyisnyezhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te song nas des blon po rnams la bsgo ba shes ldan dag ngas 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po mchod pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zhag bdun du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs kyis khyedashekyis grong khyer mdzes par gyis la gdugs tshod sta gon gyis shig /rgyal po rnams ni tshig gis 'grub pa yin la/ lha rnams ni sems kyis 'grub pa yin/ rnal 'byor pa rnams ni sems bskyed pa tsam gyis thams cad 'grub pa yin pas blon po rnams kyis yilha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal las mnyan nas rgyal byed kyi tshal dang mnyan yod kyi bar gyi lam ji srid pa dag mchog tu mdzes par byas shing mnyan yod kyang rdo ba dang gsog ma dang /gyo mo med par rnam par gnas par byas te/ tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab cing bdug 0spos dri zhim po'i snod nye bar bzhag ste dar gyi chun po'i 8—200

tshogs dpyangasanyeshing rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ste'ume tog sna tshogs bkram zhing lha rnams kyi lha'i 'dun dus chos bzangs ④ltar nyams dga' bar byas so/ /zhal zas kyang kha dog dang / dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ skyu rum sna tshogs dang bcas pa/ spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa bshams nas 'byor pa de lta bu 'dis nyi ma re re zhing sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rgyal po'i pho brang du gdugs tshod gsol to/ /de dun mtshan mo khur ba 'tshodakhupa dag tu me shor nas des ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi glang po che yan lag mchog dang ldan pa mang po dag tshig par gyur to/ /de nas gdugs tshod zhag bdun thal nas ko sashelar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis mnyan yod du dril bsgrag pa7byed du bcug nas mnyan yod du sus kyang mtshan mo me sbar bar mi bya'o⑩/ /gang me sbar bar byed na de kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu'i chad pas bcad par bya ba'am/ phyag sbal du bcug ste 'chi bar bya dgos so zhes bsgo'o/ /de'i tshe na mnyan yod na khyim bdag bzang byin zhes bya ba phyug pa/ nor mang ba longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran pa zhig 'dug ste/ des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de dus gzhan zhig na bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug boX/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag bzang byin gyal chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis ldang dag par ston 8—201
