'dod chagasanyedang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan bzhag pa lta bu rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs dral —bar gyur cing / rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa dang / 'dod pa'i rnyedasapa dang / bkur stesal rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang / nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par ༷bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang /mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /de gnyis kyis 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bab pa dang / glogasa'abyin pa'i cho 'phrul dag byas nas phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de gnyis kyi nye du dag gis lus la lus kyi mchod pa byas nas mchod rten gnyis byed du bcug ste rgyagacig ni rgyal gyi'o/ /cig shos ni skar rgyal gyi'o/ /rgyal po u tra ya na nyin re nyin re zhing tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā ya na chen po'i drung du song nas chos mnyan te btsun mo'i 'khor la 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po chos dngar ba dngar ba ston par byed de8/ sbrang bu sbrang rtsi 'byin pa bzhin no zhes rjod par byed do/ /de dag gis smras pa/ lha sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni 'bras bu dang bcas pa lags so/ci /ji ltar gang gi slad du khyod chos gsan pas so/ /gal te de lta na khyed cag kyang ci'i phyir chos mi nyan/lha bdag cag ni ngo tsha dang ldan pa lags pas ji ltar der mchis te chos mnyan par bgyi/ gal te 'phags pa kā kyā ya na chen po 'di nyid du mchis te chos ston par bgyid na de lta na bdag cag kyang chos nyan to/ /rgyal po u tra ya nas tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā ya na chen po la smras pa/ 'phags pa btsun mo'i 'khor chos 8—260

nyan par 'tshal lo/ /des smras pa/ rgyal po chen po dge slong dag ni btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du zhugs shing chos mi ston to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du 'jug pa bkag ①go/ /'phags pa 'o na su zhig btsun mo'i 'khor la chos ston par bgyid/ rgyal po chen po dge slong ma'o/ /rgyal po u tra ya nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po la phrin yig 'di skad ces shed mthun dgyes pa bdag gi btsun mo'i 'khor chos nyan par 'tshal na de'i slad du dge slong ma 'ga' zhig gtangakhuba'i rigs so zhes bris te bskur ro/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos ⑥phrin yig de bklags dunas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug ②go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa rgyal bo u tra ya nas phrin yig spring ste dubatsun mo'i 'khor chos nyan par 'tshal gyis ⑦de'i slad du dge slong ma 'ga' zhig gtang ba'i rigs so zhes mchi na ⑧de'i slad du 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/rgyal po u tra ya na'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi bud med dang grong khyer sgra sgrogs na gnas pa'i bud med rnams dge slong ma gang gis gdul ba yin snyam du dgongs na/ dge slong ma ri ma'i gdul ba yin par gzigs nas de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong ma ri ma la bka' stsal pa/ ri ma grong khyer sgra sgrogs na rgyal po u tra ya na'i btsun mo'i 'khor gyi bud med dang / sgra sgrogs na gnas pa'i bud med rnams la soms shig /dge slong ma ri mas btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis 8—261

la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngashenas song ngo / /de nas dge slong ma ri ma de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms brgyusalgenas zas kyi bya ba byas te phyi ma'i zas kyi bsod snyoms las phyir log pas ji ltar longs spyad ③pa'i gnas mal mkhos su phab ste/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas 'khor lnga brgya dang grong khyer sgra sgrogs0ga la ba der song ngo / /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos kyang rgyal po u tra ya na la phrin yig 'di skad ces shed mthun dgyes pa khyod kyi phyir bdag gis nyan thos ma chen mo ston pas bsngags pa 'di 'khor lnga brgya dang gtang gis rgyakhyod kyis kyang dpag tshad phyed dang gsum du lam dang grong khyer mdzes par bya zhing bdag nyid dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang ldan pas bsu bar bya ste/ grong khyer gyi nang du dbyar khang lnga brgya yang byed du gzhug par bya/ khri dang khri'u dang /stan nang tshangs can dang / la ba dang sngas dang / gor〈bu lnga brgya yang 'bul bar bya/ bsod snyoms lnga brgya yang sbyor du gzhug par bya stedzo/ des na khyod kyis bsod nams chen po 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes bris te bskur ro/ /rgyal po u tra ya nas phrin yig de bklagasalgenas dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba skyes te0/ des dpag tshad phyed dang gsum du lam dang grong khyer mdzes par byed du bcug nas bdag nyid dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang / skye bo 'bum phrag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas pas bsu nas bkur ste chen pos grong khyer du 'jug tu bcug cing / grong khyer gyi nang du dbyar khang lnga brgya byed du bcug ste/ khri dang khri'u dang / stan nang tshangs can dang la ba dang sngas 8—262

dang gor bu lnga brgya yang 'bul du bcuganyu /bsod snyoms lnga brgya yang sbyor du bcug go/ /dge slong ma ri ma nyin re ②zhing rgyal po u tra ya na'i btsun mo'i 'khor dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs ②na gnas pa'i bud med rnams kyi nang du zhugs0te chos ston par byed do/ /rgyal po u tra ya na ni pi bangasnyimakhas pa yin la/ btsun mo zla 'od ni gar mkhas pa yin pas ji tsam du dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po u tra ya nas pi bang sbrings7te btsun mo zla 'od gar byed do/ /des de gar byed pa na chud za ba'i mtshan ma mthong nas des de la mgo mjug ①tu brtags te bsams na 7zhag bdun 'das na 'di dus byed par 'gyur ro snyam nas de'i lag nas pi bang shor te sa la lhung ba dang / btsun mo zla 'od kyis smras pa/ lha bdag gis gar ma legs sam ci nongs/ zla 'od khyod kyis gar ma legs pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar ngas khyod gar byed pa na chud za ba'i mtshan ma mthong bas nyi ma bdun pa la khyod dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /btsun mo zla 'od kyis rgyal po'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs 8te smras pa/ lha gal te de lta ⑩na bdag gis lha la bsnyen bkur ⑩ni bgyis lags na/ gal te lhas gnang na bdag rab tu 'byung ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ zla 'od dus yin gyisalgeganang ngo / /gal te khyod rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum ⑩du byed na ni de nyid dukhyod kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /gal te kun tu sbyor ba lhag ma dang bcas pas dus byas te lha rnams kyi nang du skyes par gyur na ni khyod lhar gyur pas nga la blta bar bya'o/ /des smras pa/ lha bka'0bzhin 'tshal/ rgyal po u tra ya nas btsun mo zla 'od dge slong ma ri ma la gtad de smras pa/ 'phags ma btsun mo zla 'od legs par 8—263

gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang rdzogs par bsnyen pa dge slong ma'i dngos po 'tshal gyis7de'i slad du 'phags mas 'di rab tu 'byung ba dang / rdzogs par bsnyen⑧par mdzad pa'i rigs so/ /dge slong ma ri mas smras pa/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes des desarab tu phyung zhing rdzogs par bsnyen par byas so/ /dge slong ma ri mas bsams pas④/ de la 'chi ba'i 'du shes sgoms shig ces gdams khrungag byin no/ /btsun mo zla 'od kyis 'chi ba'i 'du shes bsgom ①par brtsams nas de nyi ma bdun pa la dus la ⑦bab nas ⑧rgyal chen bzhi'i ris7kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo'i chos nyid ni skyes nas ring po ma lon pa la sems gsum skye ste/ gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis skyes pa'o/ /lha'i bu mo zla 'od kyis bsams pa/ bdag gang nas shi 'phos snyam na/ mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes snyam na rgyal chen bzhi pa'i nang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis skyes snyam na bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa nyid kyis skyes par mthong ngo / /de nas lha'i bu mo zla 'od 'di snyam du sems te/ gang gi ⑤phyir bdag yongs su gnas pa bsten 0te bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro ba ni bdag gi tshul dang mthun pa ma yin gyis bdag yongs su gnas pa ma bsten pa kho nar bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas lha'i bu mo zla 'od rna chasnyegadub 'khor g.yo zhing dri ma med pa thogs te do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa'i lus kyis lha'i utpa la dang /pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dag gis thu ba bkang ste kha 8—264

dog shin tu 'das7pas mtshan mo la bab pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog dag gis mngon par gtor te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal rgyanas mtha' gcig tu 'dug pa dang / 'di ltar lha'i bu mo zla 'od kyi kha dog gi mthus 'od ma'i tshal ka lan dasheka'i gnas thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu mo zla 'od kyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas gang thos nas0lha'i bu mo zla 'od kyis stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de lta bur 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yang dag par so sor rtogs par byed pa'i chos bstan pa mdzad do/ /des bden pa mthong nas btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑥bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la pas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ kyi sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasargya/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyungashe/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag sne zhes lan gsum dusheched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /yang smras pa/ khyod mthus rab drag nyes pa mang ldan pa'i/ /ngan song shul bkag bsod nams rab ldan pa'i/ /mtho 8—265

ris 'gro ba phye ①zhing bdag gis ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i shul yang thob par gyur②/ /shin tu rnam dgashekhyod brten bdag gis ni/ /de ring skyon bral dag pa'i mig thob cing / /go 'phang zhi ba 'phags pa dgyes thob ste/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'ilgepa rol rgal bar gyur/ /'gro ba0lha min mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rgashedang na 'chisabral ba po0/ /srid pa stong du mthong ba rab dkon pa/ /thub pa de ring khyod mthong 'bras bu mchis/ /de nas gdud byas do shal rab 'phyang bas/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal rangs pa skyes gyur nas/ /dgra thul g.yas nas yongs su bskor byas te/ /lha yi 'jig rten mngon phyogs mkha' la song / /de nas lha'i bu mo zla 'od tshong pa khe 8sgogs rnyed 0pa lta bu dang / zhing pa lo tog 'byor pa lta bu dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba lta bu dang / nad pa nad thams cad las yongs su thar ba lta bur gyur te cha lugs gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'ongs pa'i cha lugs de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis rgyal po u tra ya na la khas blangs pas da de blta ba'i dus yin no snyam nas/ de nas lha'i bu mo zla 'od rgyal po u tra ya na ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe na rgyal po u tra ya na gcig pu steng gi khang bzangs kyilogazhir gtogs pa na nyal zhing 'dug nas des de snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par byas te se gol gyi sgras bslang ba dang / de gnyid kyis non pa'i mig dang rnam par shes pa mi gsal bas smras pa/khyod su/ des smras pa/ bdag zla 'od do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ tshur shog dga' mgur spyad par bya'o/ /des smras pa lha bdag shi zhing dus la bab nas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ gal te bdag dang lhan cig 8—266

mjal ①bzhed na bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rab tu byung zhig dang / gal te tshe 'di nyid la nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas rgyadagra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du mdzad na ni de nyid khyod kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtha' lags so/ /gal te kun du sbyor ba lhag mkhudang bcas pas dus bgyis te rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi dunang du skyes par gyur na ni der dukhyod bdag dang mjal dubar 'gyur ro zhes smras te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to// // 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bdun bcu rtsa ⑧gcig pa/ rgyal po u tra ya nas mtshan thog thag 0tu rab tu 'byung ba rjes su bsams nas nang par sngar langs te blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag btsun mo zla 'od ga la 'dug ltos shig /de dag gis smras pa/ lha dus la bab bo/ /rgyal po u tra ya nas bsams pa/ gang gi phyir bdag la lha mos bskul nas bdag khyim pa khyim gyi nang na gnas shing sogs7'jog gi longs spyod deng 'dod pa la yongs su spyod pa ni bdag gi tshul dang mthun pa ma yin gyis4)/ bdag gis gzhon nu gtsug pud 0can rgyal srid la dbang bskur te bdag skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrigasnyedag bgos te/ yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ngo snyam nas/ des blon po'i ⑩mchog ho ru ka ⑩dang /bhi ru ka gnyis mngag pas bos te smras pa/ shes ldan gnyis bu gzhon nu gtsug pud can nga la ci 'dra ba de kho na bzhin du khyed gnyis la yang de 'dra ba yin gyis7khyed gnyis kyis de gnod pa las bzlog par bya zhing phan pa la nges par sbyar bar gyis shig /nga ni legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ngo / /de gnyis kyis thos nas mchi mas brnangs te 'khod do/ /rgyal 8—267

pos gzhon nu gtsug pud can la smras pa/ bu khyod ji lta nyunga'i tshig mnyan pa dang bya bar sems pa de bzhin du/ khyod kyis〈blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang bhi ru ka 'di gnyis kyi tshig mnyan pa dang bya bar soms shig /nga ni legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ngo / /des kyang thos nas mchi mas brnangs te 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po u tra ya nas7grong khyer sgra sgrogs su dril bsgrag pa0byed du bcug ste/ grong khyer sgra sgrogasalgen gnas pa dag dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi dag dang / yul tha dad pa nas lhags dupa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams la shes ldan dag nyon cig /nga ni skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrigashedag bgos nas yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung gis klungs rgyal srid byed du bcug pa na gang la gnod pa cung ⑨zad ci byas pa de bzod par gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /grong khyer sgra sgrogs na gnas pa rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams dang / yul tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams rgyal po la rjes su chags pa yin pas de dag gis thos nas thams cad mchi mas brnangs te 'khod do/ /de nas rgyal po u tra ya nas gzhon nu gtsug ④bud can rgyal srid la bzhag nas rtsa lag gi skye bo rnams la bzod pa gsol te/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / bkren pa dang /sdug phongs pa rnams la sbyin pa dag byin/ bsod nams dag byas te mi bsnyen bkur ba cig dang / rgyal po'i khab logs su phyogs te 0'phags so/ /de nas rgyal po gtsug pud can btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang yul tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams phyi bzhin phyi bzhin du 'brang stetsho/ srog 8—268

chags 'bum phrag du ma dag gis bskyal bzhin du grong khyer sgra sgrogasanyenas phyir byung ste/ skyedakumos tshal shing ljon pa'i tshal sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ me tog dang 'bras bu dang / chu rgyun sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso dang / ri skogs dang / khu byugasnyedang /shang shang te'u sgra 'byin pa zhig tu yud tsam zhig bsdadakyinas grong khyer sgra sgrogasasnyilogs su rnam par bltas te rgyal po gtsug pud can la smras pa/ bu ngas chos kyi rgyal srid byed du bcug pas de'i phyir srog chags 'bum phrag 'di snyed nga'i phyi bzhin du0'brang bar gyur gyisaX/ khyod kyis kyang chos kyisakhurgyal srid byed du gzhugashepar bya'o/ /skye bo'i tshogs de la yang bag phab ste smras pa/ shes ldan dag ngas khyed kyi rgyal por ⑩'di bskos kyis 7phyir deng rtsal bde bar sgrubs ⑫shig ces smras te song ngo / /rgyal po gtsug pud can btsun mo'i 'khor dang /gzhon nu dang / blon po dang pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang bcas pa dang yul tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams mchi mas dkrugs pa'i mig gis yud tsam yud tsam phyi bzhin rtog cing rtog cing grong khyer sgra sgrogs burnyuphyir log go/ /de nas rgyal po u tra ya na mthar gyis grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu phyin nas des skyed mos tshal du bsdad de/ mi de la smras pa/ kwa'i nang rje rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i gan du song la rgyal po u tra ya na skyed mos tshal na sdod do zhes sgron cig /mi de song ste rgyal po gzugs can snying po la lha rgyal po u tra ya na skyed mos tshal na sdod do zhes sbran to/ /des thos nas 'phral kho na la langs te zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po de dpung chen po dang ldan pa yin na des ma spran pa kho nar 'ongs pa khyed cag sus 8—269

kyang ma shes so/ /des7smras pa/ lha de la dpung ga la mchis te dpon g.yog gnyis pusazhig mchis so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bsams pa/ gang gi phyir bdag gis ②rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bor dbang bskur ba bgyis ④na de bzhin du grong khyer du gzhug 0pa ni bdag gi tshul dang mthun pa ma yin gyisaX/bdag gis ⑦bkur ste lachen pos 'jug tu gzhug go snyam du rig nas/ lam mdzes pa dang grong khyer mdzes par byed du bcug nas dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pas bsu'o/ /de nas gnya' ba sprad de glang po che'i rgyab tu zhon nas grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu ⑨bcug ste/ spos sna tshogs dang sbyar ba'i chus khrus byed du bcug nas rgyal po la 'os pa'i gos dag dang / spos dang / phreng ba rgyu dang / byug pa sna tshogs dag gis legs par brgyan nas zan byin te lam gyis dub pa'i ngal bsos nas smras pa/ shed mthun dgyes pas rgyal srid rgyas pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams spang te 'dir ci la byon/ sa gzhan gyi rgyal po 'ga' zhig gis yul 'khor gzhom par bgyis pa'am/ gzhon nu rgyal srid la mngon par dga' ba blon po skyon chags pas bslus pa7'ga' zhig gis brtul ba'am gcig tu ma gyur tam/ des smras pa/ shed mthun dgyes pa de ltar ma gyur te/ bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang rdzogs par bsnyen pa dge slong gi dngos po 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos thos nas yid dga' zhing ⑩dga' ste/ ro stod bsrang tsonas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang stetsho/ kye ma sangs rgyas/ kye ma chos/ kye ma dge 'dun/ kye ma chos kyi legs par gsungs0pa nyid 'di ltar skyes bu gtso bo 'di lta bu dag gis rgyal 8—270

srid rgyas pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor rgyas pa dang / mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs rgyanyechen po dang / mdzod dang / bang ba dang / khyim rgya chen po dag spangs te legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang rdzogs par bsnyen pa dge slong gi dngos po 'dod pa ngo mtshar che'o zhes lan gsum ched du brjodakhupa ched du brjodasapa smras nas0rgyal po u tra ya na khrid de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'bum phrag du ma'i gong na bzhugs shing chos ston parasnyimadzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga sgyur byung ba'i rgyal po bzo sbyangasashegazugs can snying po thagasnyering po kho na nas gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di ni rgyal po gzugs can snying po7yin te/ de skyes dang bcas pas nga'i gan du 'ong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes ni 'di lta ste/gdul ba'i skyes lta bu gzhan med do zhes bka' stsal nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa rgyal po u tra ya na 'di legs par gsungs ⑩pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang rdzogs par bsnyen pa dge slong gi dngos po 'tshal na bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du 'di rab tu dbyung du gsol/ rdzogs par bsnyen par mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la dge slong tshur shog ces pas rab tu phyung zhing / dge slong tshur shog tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / de bcom ldan 'das kyi bka'i 8—271

mjug kho nar spa byi ba dang / snamatusbyar gyon par gyur te/ skra dang kha spu zhag bdun skyes pa tsam dang / lag pa lhung bzed dang / bya ma bum gyis 'brel pasadang / dge slong rdzogs par bsnyen nas lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /yang smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /skra byi snamasasbyar gyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /med la dbang po rab zhir gnas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par gyur/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya na snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /de skye bo phal po che'i tshogs kyis mthong nas grong khyer rgyal po'i khab thams cad du bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po u tra ya na rab tu phyung rdzogs par bsnyen par mdzad nas de bsod snyoms la rgyal po'i khab tu zhugs so zhes de lta bu'i sgra sgrogasalgepar gyur to//de skad thos nas srog chags 'bum phrag du ma dag 'dus par gyur cing / khyim gyi nang na gnas pa'i bud med dag kyang skar khung dang / skar khung dra ba can dang / lan kun dag gi0drung du 'khod de lta bar byed do/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po la blon po rnams kyis ⑤smras pa/ lha rgyal po u tra ya na rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs te srog chags 'bum phrag du ma dag gis bskorashecing mchis so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos de thos nas dge slong u tra ya na ga la ba der song ste phyin nas dge slong u tra ya na la tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces smras so/ /mi dbang grong khyer stong dang ni/ /sgra sgrogs kyang ni spyad byas nas/ /bor ba'i bsod snyoms tshol byed pa/ /ji lta yongs su mi gdung ngam/ /gser dang de bzhin dngul gyi snod/ /srang tshad brgya pa spyad byas nas/ /8—272

sa yi lhung bzed spyod byed pa/ /ji lta7yongs su mi gdung ngam/ /sā7lu'i 'bras chanasagatsang ma dag /sha yis brlan pasakhuspyad byas nas/ /zan dron khengasasnyepa spyod byed pa/ /ji lta0yongs su mi gdung ngam/ /srin bal rasarkyubal zar ma dang / /ko tam ka shi'i gos spangs nas/ /phyag dar khrod dag srelasabyed pa//ji lta7yongs su mi gdung ngam/ /rlung med sgo gtan bsdams pa yi/ /khang pa brtsegs par khyod nyal nas8/ /shing ljon drung du gnas gyur pa/ /ji lta yongs su mi gdung ngamanya/ /'jam zhing ras bal 'dra ba yi/ /mal khri dag la khyod nyal nas/ / rtswa yi stan la nyal gyur pa/ /ji lta7yongs su mi gdung ngam/ /btsun mo mtshungs pa yid 'ong btso/ /gus par nyal cing snyan smras payi/ /du ma khyod kyis rnam spangs pa/ /ji lta0yongs su mi gdung ngam/ /glang chen gnya' dang shing rta dang / /rta yi bzhin pas khyod song nas/ /rkang pas sa la rgyu byed pa/ /ji lta nyeyongs su mi gdung ngam/ /nor mang ldan pa'i mdzod dang ni/ / khang pa dag kyang rnam spangs te/ /ci yang med pa thob gyur pa/ /ji lta yongs su mi gdung ngam/ /u tra ya nas smras pa/ rgyal po gal te gdul dka' ba/ /gzhan gyi zas kyis 'tsho byed na/ /ma grub pas ni de 'dul te/ /gnya' shing ba lang 'dul ba bzhin/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos smras pa/ /rgyal po khyod yid mi bde 'am/ / ci phyir dman pa bzhin du smra/ /rgyal srid phyed ni sbyin bya yisatso/ /khyod ni sngon bzhin longs spyod kyis/ /rgyal po khyod yid mi bde 'am/ /ci phyir dman pa bzhin du smra/ /yid kyis gang dang gang 'dod pa'i/ /longs spyod rab mchog sbyin par bya/ /u tra ya nas smras pa/rgyal po gang zhig 'jig rten na/ /lus kyi chos reg bkren pa med / /de ni 8—273

nges7par lha nyid dang / /yang na mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur②/ /mi dbang gang zhig chos spangasasnyizhing / /'di la chos min dga' byed pa/ /rgyal po de bkren shes par bya/ /mun nas mun par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /khyod la chos ni bstan bya yisaX/ /rgyal po chen po bdag la nyon/ /chos thos 'og tu rgyal po ni/ /gang du 'dod par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /yon tan med pa'i lus la ni/ /gcig nyid yon tan chen po ste/ /ji lta ji ltar gzungasabyas pa/ /de lta de ltar rjes 'jug 'gyur/ /rgyal po bcu pa'i bcu po 'di/ /skyes bu'i cher0ni brjod par bya/ /bu dang chung ma nor de la/ /rtsed mo dga' ba ci zhig yod/ /bu yis dga' ba ston byed de/ /chung mas khengs pa rjodashepar byed/ /chom rkun nor ni sgrubashebyed de/ /rgyal po dgasheni bcings las grol/ /mthar byed pa las sman dag dang / /nor dang nye dus skyob mi nus/ /rig sngags kun dang dpung dag dang / /dpa' brtul gyis kyang skyob nus min/ /'di na mthu chen gnas mtho la/ /gnas pa'i lha tshe ring po yang / /de yang tshe zad nyams 'gyur bas/ /'chi las de ring su zhig 'thar0/ /mthu chen nor ldan grags 'bar ba/ /rgyal srid byas pa khyab 'jug dang / /mun byed sgra ngan skya bseng bu/ /des kyang 'chi ba bzlog ma nus/ /rgyal po sdom brtson dka' thub dang / /las dang brtson 'grus rtul ba dang / /'khor tshogs rgya chen nor dag gis/ /'chi las ji ltar thar mi nus/ /bar snang rgya mtsho'i nang dang ni/ / ri yi sul du zhugs pa 'am/ /gang du gnas na 'chi bdag gis/ /mi tshugs 'gyur ba'i sa phyogs med/ /bar snang rgya mtsho0nang dang ni/ /ri yi sul du zhugs pa 'am/ /gang du gnas na las rnams kyis/ /mi tshugs 'gyur ba'i sa phyogs med/ /8—274

rus pa thi ba'i mdog 'dra ba/ /bor zhing phyogs phyogs rnam 'thor7ba/ /gang dang gang yin de dag ni/ /mthong na 'di la su zhig dga'/ /thod pa dung gi mdog 'dra ba/ /bor zhing ku bsalhung lta bu/ /gang dang gang yin de dag ni/ /mthong na 'disnyel su zhig dga'/ /rgyal po tsha na sgrib byed cing / /grang na g.yog0par byed pa yi/ /khyod kyi bdag nyid ces bya ba/ /gang yin de yang 'chisabs 'joms mi yis ji tsam zas zos shing / /gyon nam yang na byin pa dergya/ /de yi rang girakhushes bya ste/ /gzhan ni bor te 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mi yi7rkyan pos mi 'phrogs dang / /gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /gter ni sbyin pa'am yangacan ni/ /legs byas gzhan gyis sba bar bya/ /stag gis ri dgas bsad 'dren ltar/ /na rga 'chi7bas khyod myur 'dren/ /mdza' bshes blon tshogs kun 'dus pa0/ /khyod kyi nad ni sel mi nus/ /de la spyad lhag nor 'bru dang / /gser dngul gang dag yod pa la/ /bu dang chung ma 'khor bcas dag /bgo7skal nyid du sems par byed/ /gal te pha shi bu lon chags/ /bu sdug de la me mi khyeraX/ /shi na 'chi0bzhin mi ngu zhing / /bdag gi pa'am rjer mi smra/ /phyug shes bdag gi pha zer zhing / /skra bshig mchi ma'i bzhin gyis ngu / /me yang mdun du khyer byed cing / /kye ma 'di ni lhar 'gyur zer/ /gos kyis bkab bzhin khyer byed cing / /me btang de nas sreg par byed/ /nye du ngu zhing gos gcig gis/ /de sregs spangs te longs spyod byed/ /de gcig skye zhing skye tshe gcig /de bzhin gcig 'chi 'chi tshe gcig /skye 'dir gcig pus sdug bsngal myong / /'khor bar0'gyur la grogs med do/ /de mthong 'di la dam pa rnams/ /rab 'byung khyim na ‘ 〉 8—275

'dug mi byed/ /de dag chags pa kun bral nas/ /phyin chad mngal nakhu'ajug mi 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po dge slong u tra ya nas gong nas gong du spobs pas lan glan⑧pas cang mi smra zhing spobs pa med par gyur te song ngo / /de nas rgyal po gtsug ①bud can gyis re zhig ji srid du chos kyi ④rgyal srid byed du bcug nas chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du gzhug ⑤par brtsams pa dang / de la blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang gi0ru ka gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha chos kyis ⑦rgyal srid bgyid du 465 la/ chos ma lags pas bgyid du ma stsal cig /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ lha yul gyi mi dag ni me tog gi shing ljon pa dang /'bras bu'i shing sngon pa dag dang 'dra ba'i slad du ste/ lhaku'adi lta ste/ dper bgyi na me tog gi shing ljon ⑨pa dang / 'bras bu'i shing ljon pa dag ni dus dang dus su legs par yongs su bskyangs pa ⑩na bar chad ma mchis pa'i sbyor bas dus ji lta ba yibazhin du me tog dang / 'bras bu dag 'byin par bgyid do/ /lha de bzhin du yul gyi mi dag kyang dus dang dus su legs par yongs su bskyangs pa yin bar chad ma mchis pa'i sbyor bas dus ji lta ba bzhin du dpya dang lo thang dag 'bul bar bgyid do/ /de de gnyis kyis bzlog pa na re zhig ji srid du chos kyis rgyal srid byed du bcug nas yang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du gzhug par brtsams pa dang / de la de gnyis kyis lan gsum gyi bar du yang smras ⑫na srid ⑩pa 'phos ⑩pa dang ldan pas bzlog kyang mi sdod de de khros nas blon po gzhan dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang gis 8rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bor dbang bskur ba'i bka' lan gsum gyi bar du yang gcog pa de'i chad pa ji lta bu yin/ de na blon po skyon chags pa kha cig gis smras pa/ lha 'di la rma ci 8—276

'tshal te/ de'i chad pa ni dgum pa lags so/ /tshigs su bcad pa dag kyang smras pa/ blon po skyon ni chags pa dang / /'gulatubar gyur pa'i so dang ni/ /zas la skyon ni chags pa dag /phyungasab 'ba' zhig bde bar gyur / /blon po blo dang ldan gyur cing / /shes rab dang ni 'dul la mkhas/ /mdzod nas go 'phang gnas pa ni/ /gang gis mi gsod de gsod 'gyur④/ /rgyal po gtsugashepud can gyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di gnyis ni0nga'i yab kyis bskos pa yin pas nga 'di gnyis gsodakhupar mi byed kyisani/ 'di ltar 'di gnyis kyis nga'i mig sngar 'dug par mi bya'o zhes de gnyis kyi sgo bzlog nas skyon chags pa gzhan gnyis shig blon por bskos pa dang / de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha til ma brdungs pa dang / ma stsal ba dang / ma bsros pa dang / ma btsir ba dag gis til mar mi 'byin te/ mi'i dbang po skye bo dag kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyed gnyis kyis byas pa gang yin pa de ni mchog tu brtson pa yin no/ /de gnyis kyis yul gyi mi dgatsol gnod pa bya bar brtsams7so/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na tshong pa zhig zong thogs te grong khyer sgra sgrogs ⑩nas rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya nas de mthong nas ngo shes te smras pa/ ji lta sgra sgrogs dag na gtsug pud can/ /'khor dang tshogs bcas 0stobs ldan nad med dam/ /de la phas kyi sdo 'ab 'ga' med cing / /rang gi rgyal srid chos kyis byed 'jug gam/ /des0smras pa/ lha de bzhin sgra sgrogs dag na gtsug pud can/ /'khor dang tshogs bcas stobs ldan bro ma 'tshal/ /de la phas kyi sdo nyeb ma mchis te/ /rgyal srid rtag tu chos ma lags pas bgyid/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya nas mthar gyis dri bar tsho 8—277

brtsams pas①/ de na blon po gang ni gtso bo yin/ / gang ni gtso bo ma yinasagang gi dbang gis ni gtsug rgyasad can yul gyi mi dag la gnod pa 0byed/des smras pa/ lha blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang sgyi ru ka gnyis kyi sgo0ni bzlog /skyon chags pa gzhan gnyis shig ni blon por bskos te/ de gnyis kyi0dbang gis gtsug ⑦phud can yul gyi mi dag la gnod pa ⑧bgyid do/ /u tra ya nas smras pa/ kwa'i ⑨nang rje khyod song la sgra sgrogs yin gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs legs par dbugs phyung shig dang / ⑩yang der bzlog 8tu 'ong ste/ nga nyid kyis tsogatsug pud can ci nas kyang yul gyi mi rnams la gnod pa ④mi byed pa de ltar gnod pa las bzlog par bya zhing phan pa la nges par sbyar bar bya'o/ /tshong pa des zong bsgyur te zong rin khyer nas 'phags te mthar gyis sgra sgrogs su nyephyin nas des nye du rnams la gsang ste smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bos zong thogs te rgyal po'i khab tu son nas kho bos der rgyal po bgres po mthong nas / de'i zhal nas kwa'i0nang rje khyod song la sgra sgrogs na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs legs par dbugs phyung shig dang / ciyang der bzlog ⑦tu 'ong ste/nga nyid kyis gtsug pud 9can ci nas kyang yul gyi mi rnams la gnod pa ⑥mi byed pa de ltar gnod pa las bzlog par bya zhing phan pa la nges par sbyar bar bya'o zhes byung ngo / /de dag gis kyang gzhan dag la brjod cing de dag gis kyang gzhan dag la brjod pas de ltar sgra de rna btsogacig nas gcig tu brgyud pas blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyi rnar son nas de gnyis kyis bsams pa/gal te rgyal po rgan po 'ong bar gyur na 6)des gdon mi za bar he ru ka dang /bhi ru ka gnyis yang blon po'i mchog tu sko 9zhing bdag cag gnyis la gnod pa 8—278

byed par 'gyur gyis①/ de'i phyir gang gis de lam kur gsod du 'jug par 'gyur ba'i thabs kyi ②rnam pa zhig bya'o snyam nas de gnyis kyis rgyal po gtsugashepud can la smras pa/ lha rgyal po bgres po byon par 'gyur rosnyizhes gda'oX/ /des smras pa/ de rab tu byung bas de ci'i phyir 'dir 'ong bar 'gyur/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha gang gis gdugasashegacig rgyal srid bgyid du stsalasnyeb de ni ①rgyal srid ma mchis pas dga' bar ga la 'gyur te/ de yang rgyal srid bgyid du stsol bar 'tshal lodzo/ /gtsug pud can gyis smras pa/ gal te de rgyal por gyur na nga nyid kyis 8gzhon nu byas te0/ 'di la 'gal ba ci yod/de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha de ni tshul dang mthun pa ma lags te gzhon nu dang /blon po dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang yul gyi mi dag gis thal mo stong dag gis phyag bgyis pas rgyal srid bgyid du stsal nas yang ji ltar gzhon nu'i gnas su gnas par mdzad yul 'khor tsoyongs su btang byab ni mi sdo yi gzhon nu'i ⑩ gnas su gnas pa ni mi rung ste/ 'di lta ste dper bgyi na mi zhig glang po che'i gnya' bar mchis nas rta'i rgyab tu mchi 8ba dang / rta'i rgyab tu mchis nas shing rtas mchi ba dang / shing rtas mchisalgenas rkang pa0gnyis kho nas mchi ba bzhin du/ rgyal srid bgyid du stsal nas yang gzhon nu'i gnas na gnas pa yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de gnyis kyis bslus nas des smras pa/ 'o na 'di la gang rigs/ 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha de 'gums su ⑥stsal bar bgyi'o/ /gal te 'gums su ④ma stsal dugor ma bkum par blon po skyon chags pa dag dang bsdongs te lha nyid dgrongasalgepar bgyid do/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / de bzhin gyur cing nyams te yud tsam zhig cang mi tsho ’ / 8—279

smra bar 'dug nas mchi mas brnangs pa'i snying gis snying rje bzhin zhumanyepa dang /thogs pa'i yidasadag gis smras pa/ shes ldan gnyis ji ltar yab dgrongasasnyesu rung / de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lhas/ pha 'am yang na spun dag gam/ /rang las skyes pa'i bu yang rung / /gal te dgra khrod zhugs gyur na/ /sa phung 'phelasab nyid du bya/ /zhes bgyi ba ma gsan0tam/ yang smras pa/ lhas gang la bu pho stong bdog cing / thams cad gru gcig⑧zhugs gyur pal/ /der ni dgra bo gcig tu byung / /de yi don du de nub bya/ /zhes bgyi ba ma gsan7tam/lhas gzhan dag nas8/ khyim gyi phyir ni gcig gtang bya/ /grong phyir khyim ni gtangasnyibar bya/ /ljongs phyir grong ni gtanganebya ste/ /bdag nyid phyir ni sa gtang bya/ /zhes 'byung ba yang ma gsan tam/ lha 'di la dgongs par bgyi ba ci yang ma mchis te/ de ni dgumanyepar bgyi lags pas 'gums su stsal bar bgyi'o/ /gal te lha 'di la phyi shol dumadzad nas dulha la rjes su chags pa'i gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang yul gyi mi gang dag lags pa de dag 'khrugs par gyur na gor ma bkum par lha la gnod pa bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa dag la bsten pas ni sdig pa'i las mi bya ba ci yang med pas des de ltar gyis shig ces khas blangs so/ /de nas blon po skyon chags pa ⑥de gnyis dga' ba dang mgu ba dang mchog tu dga' ba skyes nas mi gshed ma pa dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag deng la rgyal po rgan po sod cig dang khyed cag la longs spyod dag gis bgo bsha' bya'o/ /rgyal po de la pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang yul dumi thams cad rjes su chags pas de gsod byapar spro ba 'ga' ⑥yang med do/ /de gnyis kyis de dag la lan gsum gyi bar du yang 8—280

dbyig dang / gser dang grong sbyin pa la sogs pas spro bar byed na spro ①ba 'ga' yang ma byung nas/ de nas de gnyis khro bas kun nas dkrisalgepas phyag sbal srung ②ba rnams la bsgo dub/ shes ldan dag deng ⑤la mi de dag bu dang /chung ma dang rtsa lag dang mdza' bshes dang / nye du'i tshogs dang bcas pa chings lasachug shig /de dag gis thos nas skrag par gyur te smras pa/ lha nyag mi bzhes su gsol/ bdag cag ni phyag rjed bka' nyan pa dag lags kyis mchi'o / /zhes de dag gis ral gri rnon po mchan du bcuganeste 'phags so/ /tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya na dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po dag 'das nas chos gos byas pa dang ldan/ chos gos zin pa dang ldan pas lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag grong khyer sgra sgrogs su ljongs rgyu zhing mchi bar 'tshal 8lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ u tra ya na song la khyod kyis las bdag gir bya ba yid la bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya na de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms brgyusalgenas zas kyi bya ba byas te phyi ma'i zas kyi bsod snyoms las phyir log par0/ ji ltar longs spyod pa'i gnas mal mkhos su phab ste lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas las kyi stobs kyis bdas te5)song ngo / /las kyis ring du 'dren tsho 5 8—281

byed de①/ /ring las ②las kyis ③'dren par byed/ /gang du las rnams smin 'gyur ba/ /der ni las kyis durab tu 'drenadu/ /de grong khyer sgra sgrogs dug la ba der song nas mthar gyis rgyu zhing 'gro ba na lam ka na ri brags 0shig yod pa der bsod snyoms la zhugs nas de de nas bsod snyoms brgyus7te song ba dang /mi gshed ma pa7de dag dang phrad nas de dag gis de mthong ngo / /des kyang de dag ngo shes nas de dag dang lhan cig skyed7mos tshal zhig tu mtshan mo gnas par khas blangs nas des de dag la dri bar brtsams pa/ ji lta sgra sgrogasacadag na gtsug pud can/ /'khor dang tshogs bcas stobs ldan nad med dam/ /de la phas kyi sdo 8ba 'ga' med cing / /rang gi rgyal srid chos kyis byed 'dzug gam/ /de dag gis smras pa/ lha de bzhin sgra sgrogs dag na gtsug pud can//'khor dang tshogs bcas stobs ldan bro ma 'tshal/ /de la phas kyi sdo tsob ma mchis te/ /rgyal srid rtag tu chos ma lags pas bgyid/ /mi mchog khyod kyi tshul dang mthun pa yi/ /'phags dngos mngon brtags gang lags khyod kyis mdzod/ /zhi ba de yi 8tshul mthun gang lags pa/ /de ni de ring nye bar gzigs par 'gyurayi/ /tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci deng der 'ong ba la mngon par7mi dga' 'am/ de dag gis smras pa/ lha mngon par mi dga'o/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na mi 'gros phyir ldog par bya'o/ /de dag gis tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ skyes bu dpa' khyod slar ni gang du gshegs/ /sras ni khyod gson mngon pa mi dga' ste/ /bdag cag byur ngan rgyal pos bskos rnams kyis/ /'dir ni khyod dgrongs slad du mchid kyis 'tshal/ /tshe dang ldan pa tshu tra ya nas smras pa/ shes ldan 8—282

dag khyed cag nga gsod7pa'i mi⑧gshed ma pa dag yin nam/ lha bdag cag khyod dgrongasalgepa'i gshed ma pasredag lags so/ /tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya nas bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la u tra ya na song la khyod kyis las bdag0gir bya ba yid la bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa gang yin pa de ni 'di yin pa lta ste/ 'khor ba ni rnam pa thams cad du ngan pa snying po med pa 'jig ༷pa'i chos can yin no snyam du rigakhunas/ de dag la smras pa/ bzhin bzangasashedag nga7don gang gi phyir rab tu byung ba'i don de ngas da dung ma thob kyis re zhig nga rang gi don rjes su sgrub kyi bar du yud tsam zhig sdod cig /de dag gis phan tshun gros byas te smras pa/ lha de ltar mdzod cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya na shing ljon pa zhig gi drung du brten nas brang 'gro'i rgyal po gnyid log pa'i lus bskyil ba ltar skyil mo krung bcas te spyod lam zhi bas 'dug go//bcom ldan 'das kyis mang du thos pa la phan yon lnga yod de/ phung po la mkhas pa dang / khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mched la mkhas pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang / de'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa gzhan la rag ma las pa yin no zhes gsungs pas des brtson 'grus brtsams pas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba 'di nyid rig ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad nyams pa dang / ltung ba dang rnam par 'thor ba dang /rnam par 'jig pa'i chos nyid kyis 0zil gyis mnan nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas rigs kyi bu dag gang gi phyir skra dang kha spu dag 'bregs te gos ngur smrig yidag bgos dunas yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar byed pa tshangs par spyod pa'i mtha' bla na med pa de tshe tsho 3 8—283

'di nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas te bsgrubs ①nas bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar byed cing / dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan bzhag pa lta bu/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs dral bar gyur cing / rig pa dang /mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa dang 'dod pa'i rnyed pa dang / bkur steshel rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar7gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya nas dgra bcom pa nyid thob nas rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba so so yang dag par rig pa na de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ dge slong u tra ya na ni/ /mdud pa sbyor ba zug rngu dang / /de bzhin sgribakyilas thar gyur kyang //rgyal po'i chos las deng ma thar/ /ces smras nas mi gshed ma de dag la smras pa/bzhin bzangs ⑦dag ngas thob par bya ba gang yin pa de thob zin gyis ⑧da ni khyed cag don gang gi phyir 'ongs pa'i don de thob par bya'o/ /de dag gis smras pa / lha gal te rgyal po gtsug phud can bdag cag la rgyal po rgan ①pos 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe ci zhig smras zhes med na/ bdag cag gis de la ji skad brjod par bgyi/ bzhin bzangs dag de la 'di skad ces/ rgyal srid phyir ni pha bsad pas/ /bsod nams ma yin mang po bskyed/ /nga ni yongs su mya ngan 'da' / /khyod ni mnar med 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /8wa 284

gzhan yang 'di skad ces/ khyod kyis mtshams med pa gnyis byas te/ pha srog dang phral7ba gang yin pa dang / dge slong dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa srog dang phralakhub gang yin pa de gnyis kyis khyod yun ring por7sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par gnas par bya dgos kyis dusdig pa sna tshogs rgyalas shogs shig dang / de lta las bsrabasalgepa nyid dang / yongs su zad pa dang zhayongs su mthar7thug par 'gyur ro zhes brjod par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya nas yang bsams pa/ sems can de sems can dmyal ba chen po las gzhol bar gyur na mi rung gis rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro'o snyam nas/ des rdzu 'phrul gyi thabs gang dang gang yin brtsams na de'i las kyis non pas rdzu zhes bya ba tsam yang snang bar ma gyur na rdzu 'phrul 8lta smos kyang ci dgosatso/ de nas mi gshed ma pa de dag las mi snying rje med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten pha rol btang ba gcig gis ral gri shubs nas phyung ste/ de'i mgo drungs ⑫nas bcad nas sa la bsgyel to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'dzum7pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis na gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe na nyezhal nas 'od zer isngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar dupo dang / dkar po dang / btsod ka dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung nas kha cig ni 'og logs su 'dong / kha cig ni steng logs su 'dong bas gang dag 'og logs su 'dong ba de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus gzhom dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / ṭa bur rdol dang / so thams thams tsho 8—285

dang / kyi hud zerashedang / a cusazerashedang / utpal ltar gas pa dang /pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por dong ste/ sems can dmyal ba tsha ba gang dag yin pa de dag tu ni bsil0bar gyur te 'bab par byed la / sems can dmyal ba grang ba gang dag yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab par byed do/ /des sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i bye brag dag rgyun gcod par byed cing de dag 'di snyam du/ shes ldan dag ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phosaXsam/ 'on te gzhan du skyes snyam du sems so/ /de dag dad pa bskyed0par bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sprul pa gtong bar mdzad de/de dag gis dusprul pa mthong nas ⑨'di snyam du shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa ma yin la/ gzhan du skyes pa yang ma yin te/ 'di ltar sems can sngon ma mthong ba 'di'irnyumathus bdag cag gi⑥gnod pa'i bye brag rgyun chad par gyur to snyam du sems so/ /de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dad par gyur nas/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad par byas nas gang du bden pa dag gi snod du gyur par 'gyur ba'i lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyor ba len par byed do/ /gang dag steng logs su 'dong ba de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi pa dang / sum bcu 8rtsa gsum pa dang /'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang kha 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang /tshangs chen dang / 'od chung dang tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang /dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang / sprin med dang /bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung bane8—286

dang / gya rnam snang dang / shin tu mthong dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi nang du dong nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang /bdag med pa zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs7par byed cing tshigs su bcad pa gnyis po//brtsamasapar bya zhing 'byungakhubar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la0glang chen bzhin/ /'chikhubadag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba yang smras so/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen 0po'i 'jig rten gyi khams byul nas bcom ldan 'das ⑦kyi slad bzhin slad bzhin du rjes su 'dong ste/ de la gal te bcom ldan 'das 'das pa'i las lung ston ⑧par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam 0logs su nub par 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs ⑩pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun yilogs su nub par 'gyur/sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston 8par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du nub par 'gyur/dud 'gror skye ba 8lung ston par ④bzhed na ni zhabs kyi 8long bur nub par 'gyur/ yi dgas su skye ba lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor nub par 'gyur/ mir 8skye ba yilung ston ⑥ par bzhed na ni pus mor nub par 'gyur/ stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid lung ston0 par bzhed na ni phyag mthil g.yon par nub par 'gyur/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid du )lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag mthil g.yas par nub par 'gyur/lhar skye ba lung ston ⑦par bzhed na ni lte bar nub par 'gyur/ nyan thos kyi byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du nub par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas rme 8—287

kyi byang chub lung ②ston par bzhed na ni mdzod spur nub par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lung ston ②par bzhed na ni gtsug torashedu nub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis kyi mthil du nub bo de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ kha dog sna tshogs stong gis bkra ba yi/ /tshogs rnams zhal gyi sgo nas byung gyur te/ /de yis phyogs rnams thams cad snang bgyis pa/ /nyi gdugs brdal bar gyur pa cikhubazhin no/ /yang tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/rgod bral zhum dang rgyags pa rab spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas 'gro bsnyemachog gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thul byed rgyu ma mchis pa⑨/ /rtsa lag dung ltar dkar 'dzum ston mi mdzad/ /de slad brten pa rang blos dus mkhyen nas/ /thub pa khyu mchog dge sbyong skye dbang po/ /nyan pa'i skye bo som nyi ldan rnams la//the tshom0skyes pa gsung tshig brtan pa dang / /dam pa dge ba dag gis bsal du gsol/ /tshwa chu ri rgyal lta bur7brtan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas mgon rnams glo bur 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan nas nyeci slad 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams de ni nyan par 'tsha'akho/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de de bzhin no de de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad de/ kun dga' bo 'di ltar/ dge slong u tra ya na ni/ /mdud pa sbyor ba zug rngu dang / /de bzhin sgrib las thar gyur kyang / /rgyal po'i chos las deng ma thar/ /kun dga' bo grong khyer sgra sgrogs 8—288

na gnas pa'i rgyal po gtsug pud can sdig pa'i grogs pos bskor bas dge slong u tra ya na/ dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa srog dang bral bar byas te/ des pha dgra bcom pa srog dang bral bar byas pas nges par sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya na dgra bcom pa nyid thob cing srog dang bral bar gyur tam/ kun dga' bo u tra ya na dgra bcom pa nyid thob cing srog dang bral bar gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos de thos nas mchi mas brnangs te 'dug go/ /de nas gshed ma pa mi de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya na'i lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang khar gsilanyekhyer te grong khyer sgra sgrogs su7phyin nas de dag gis blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis la smras pal/ rgyal po rgan po bsad do/ /de gnyis kyis thos nas dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba skyes te rgyal po gtsug pud can ga la ba der dong nas smras pa/ lha dgyes pa skyedabacig /dkyini lha'i rgyal srid la tsher ma ma mchis so/ /ji ltar gyur lha'i dgra gang lags pa de bkum mo/ /nga'i dgra gang yin/ lha rgyal po rgan po'o/ /de bsad pa ji ltar shes/ de gnyis kyis mi gshedakyim pa dag bstan te smras pa/ lha mi 'di dag ni gshed ma pasalags te 'di dag gis de bkum7mo/ /rgyal po gtsug pud can gyis de dag mthong nas smras pa/ shes 0ldan dag rgyal po rgan po la dbang ⑩ji tsam yod/ lha de la dbang cig la mchis te lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang khar gsil 8'di lags so/ /rgyal po gtsug pud can gyis de mthong nas brgyal te sa la skyel ⑫nas chus btab ste dbugs phyir byung nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po rgan pos 'chi ba'i tshe ci smras/ lha rgyal po rgan po srog dang bral kur 'di skad ces/mo 8—289

rgyal srid phyir ni pha bsad pas/ /bsod nams ma yin mang po bskyed/ /nga ni yongs su mya ngan 'da'/ /khyod ni mnar med 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes mchi'o/ /gzhan yang 'di skad ces/ khyod kyis mtshams med pa'i las gnyis byas te/pha srog dang phralatub gang yin pa dang / dge slong dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa srog dang phralakhub gang yin pa des khyod yun ring por sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med parakhuganas par bya dgos kyisakyisdig pa sdig pa las shogs shig dang / de lta dun las bsrabs ༷pa nyid dang / yongs su zad pa dang /yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes mchi'o/ /de mya ngan gyi zug rngusalgegazir bas 'dam bu sngon por brngas pa bzhin du rnyis ⑧par gyur nas/ des ①blon cipo'i mchog he ru ka dang bhi ru ka gnyis bos te smras pa/ shes ldan gnyis khyed gnyis kyisalong las de lta bu byed pa las ma bzlog go/ /de gnyis kyis smras pa /lhas bdag cag gnyis spyan lam du ma bzhag na ji ltar bzlog par bgyi/ des blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis mig lam du mi snang bar bzhag nas he ru ka dang /bhi ru ka gnyis phyir blon po'i mchog tu bskos pa dang / blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis gsang ste/ tshe dang ldan pa rgyal dang / skar rgyal gyi mchod rten gnyis la khung bu gnyis brkos 8nas der ⑩byi la'i phru byagu gnyis bzhag ste/ de gnyis kyis nyi ma re re zhing sha sri re re byin nas 'di skad ces rgyal dang skar rgyal gnyis bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis khyod gnyis kyis sgyu mas 'jig rten bslus teyi/ dad pas sbyin par bya ba chud gsan0pas byi la'i skye gnas ngan par skyes pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des sha sri long la rang rang gi mchod rten la bskor ba bgyis te/ca rang rang gi khung du zhugs shig ces 8—290

slob par byed do/ /gang gi tshe de gnyis legs par lobs par gyur pa de'i tshe na7blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis u tra ya na'i btsun mo'i gan du song ste smras pa/ lha mo khyod kyisasras rid pa dang / nyamakhuchung ba dang / rke ba dang /lus ma thob par gyur na ci'i slad du khyod btang snyoms mdzad/ des smras pa/khyod duganyis nyid kyis de las de lta bu byed du bcug na da ⑤'o mos ji ltar bya/de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha mo ci gang du bum pa lhung0ba der dpyang thag kyang lhung bar bgyi'am/ des smras pa/ desashes te re zhig de'i pha bsad pa ni kho mos gsang7bar bya na/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa sus gsang bar 'gyur/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha yimo dgra bcom pa bsad pa bdag cag gnyis kyis gsang bar bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ gal te de lta na legs so zhes de7de'i gan du song ste smras pa/ sras ci'i slad du khyod skya bo bseng bseng po rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang / rke ba dang / lus ma thob par gyur/ des smras pa/yum khyod kyang de skad ces ci'i phyir khyod skya0)bo bseng bsenganepo rid pa dang /nyam chung ba dang / rke ba dang / lus ma thob par gyur ces gsung ngam/gang gi slad du bdag blon po skyon chags pa gnyis kyis bslus pas mtshams med pa'i las gnyis bgyis te yab srog dang phral ()ba gang lags pa dang / dge slong dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa srog dang phral tshub gang lags pa des bdag yun ring por sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par gnas par bgyi 'tshal na/ bdag ji ltar skya bo bseng bseng po rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang / rke ba dang / lus ma thob par mi 'gyur du rung / des smras pa/sras ci mi 'jigs pa stsol cig dang / gang med pa de bka' mchid bgyi'o/ /tsho/ 8—291

des smras pa/ yum gsol gyis7ji ltar lags pa gsungs shig /sras de ni khyod kyi yab ma lags te/ 'disaltar bdag gis7zla mtshan bkru ba'i slad du skyes pa gzhan dag dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod0pa de las khyod 'khrungs so/ /des bsams pa/ de lta na pha bsad par ma gyur to snyam du rig nas smras pa/ yum gal te de ltakhun pha bsad pa ni ma mchis na dgra bcom pa bsad pa〈mchis pa de ji ltar mthar thug par bgyi/ des smras pani/ sras 'di la shes pa la mkhas pa dag smra ⑨bar bgyi ste/ de dag gis de mthar thug par bgyid par 'gyur ro⑩/ /zhes smras te song nas/ des blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis bos te smras pa/ kho mos de'i pha bsad pa ni bsal zin gyis da khyod teganyis kyis dgra bcom pa bsad pa sol cig /rgyal po gtsug pud can gyis blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ blon po gang dag shes pa la mkhas pa thams cad sdus shig /de dag gis blon po gang dag shes pa la mkhas pa thams cad bsdus pa dang blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyang der 'dus par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po gtsug pud can gyis de dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag ngas dgra bcom pa bsad pa gang yin pa de ji ltar mthar thug par bya/ de na rgyal pos nye bar 'tsho ba'i mi thams cad kyis ni mi mthun par smra bar brtsams te/ de na kha cig gis smras pa/ lha des dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis par sus mthong / kha cig gis smras pa/ lha dgra bcom pa dag ni thams cad mkhyen pa dang 'dra ste nam mkha' la mchi'o8/ /blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha 'di la thugs ngan bgyir ci mchis/ des smras pa/ khyed gnyis kyang de skad ces 'di la mya ngan byar ci yod zer ram/ khyed gnyis nyid na re dgra bcom pa 8—292

gsodanyedu bcug go zhes mi zer ram/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha dgra bcom pa dag ma mchis na dgra bcom pa dag bkum pasamachis re skan/ des smras pa/ngas mngon sum kho nar dgra bcom pa rgyal dang / skar rgyal gnyis kyis 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bab pa dang / glog⑧'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag byas te phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su0mya ngan las 'das pa mthong bzhin du khyed gnyis kyis de skad ces/ dgra bcom pa dag med na ⑤dgra bcom pa bsad pa yod re skan/ zhes zer ram/de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha ji ltar de gnyis kyis sgyu mas 'jig rten bslus te dad pas sbyin par bgyi ba chud gzan pas byi la'i skye gnas ngan par skyes te/deng sang nyid du yang rang rang gi mchod rten na dumachis pa lha'i mngon sum du bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na tshur shog dang ci yang dag pa'am/ yang dag pa ma yin pa ltaraku'adong ngo / /grong khyer sgra sgrogs thams cad du ji ltar rgyal dang / skar rgyal gnyis byi la'i skye gnas su skyes te rang rang gi mchod rten na 'dug nas rgyal po ltar song ngo zhes bya ba'i sgra des khyab par gyur nas srog chags 'bum phrag du ma dag ltad mo skyes nas rgyal po'i phyi bzhin du7'brang ngo / /de nas blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis rgyal po dang bcas pa'i 'khor 'bum phrag du ma'i mdun du smras pa/rgyal dang skar rgyal gnyis nyon cig bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis khyed gnyis kyis ()sgyu mas 'jig rten bslus te dad pas sbyin par bya ba chud gzan pas byi la'i skye gnas ngan par skyes te rang rang gi mchod rten nane'adug pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des sha sri 'di long la rang rang gi mchod rten la sgyu 8—293

bskor ba bgyis ①te rang rang gi khung du zhugs shig /de skad smras pa dang /de gnyis kyis rang rang gi khungakhunas byung ste sha sri blangs nas rang rang gi mchod rten la bskor ba byas nas rang rang gi khungasadu zhugs pa srog chags 'bum phrag du ma dag gis mthong nas/ blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha gzigs sam/ des smras pa mthong ngo / /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha de ltar na 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa dag ma dumachis te de ni skye bo'i bka' mchid 'ba' zhig tu bas so/ /de nas rgyal po de la 'jig rten dgra bcom pa dag yod do snyam pa'i lta ba yod pa gang yin pa de med par gyur to/ /de na dugang dag ma dad pa de dag la ni med par lta ba skyes par gyur to/ /gang dag bar mar gnas pa de dag ni yid gnyis za bar gyur to/ /gang dag dad pa de dag ni gnongasnyizhing mi dga' ba dang / mi 'jigs pa med par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po gtsugashesad can gyis bsams pa/ gal te 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa dag med na bdag gis ci'i phyir 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po 'khor lnga brgya dang / yidage slong ma ri ma 'khor lnga brgya dang ldan pa la bsod snyoms dbul snyam nas des dge slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams kyi bsod snyoms bcad0nas dge slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams kyang grong khyer sgra sgrogs tsonas dong ngo ⑫/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā 8ya na chen po dang / dge slong ma ri ma ni gdul ba la ltos pas de nyid na 'khod do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po gtsug phud can grong khyer sgra sgrogs nas phyir byung ba na tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po grong khyer sgra sgrogs yisu bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / des rgyal po mthong nas 'di mi dga' bar sems par gyur na mi rung ngo snyam nas mtha' 8—294

gcig tu song ste sdod7do/ /rgyal po gtsug⑧dud can gyis desamatha' gcig tu sdod pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po 'di nga mthong nas mtha' gcig tu song ste0sdod/ de'i phyi bzhin blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang / bhi ru ka gnyis 'gro ba de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po'i thugs lam na lha ga shed du gzigs mo dang dge mtshan la gshegs pas mi dgyes par dgongs par gyur na mi rung ngo snyam pa dang / tshon yigyi las bgyi ba dka' ⑦bas chos gos dag rdul gyis phog par gyur na mi rung ngo snyam du dgongs so/ /rgyal po cang mi smra bar song ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos grong khyer sgra sgrogs susnyebasod snyoms brgyus te byung ba na rgyal po gtsug phud can nang du 'jug nas tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po de bzhin du mtha' gcig tu song ste sdod do/ /rgyal po gtsug pud can gyis de mtha' gcig na sdod pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'phags pa kā tyā ya yin chen po 'dis sngar nga mthong nas mtha' gcig tu song ste 0sdod pa'i rgyu ni de yin na da ⑩ltar yang mtha' gcig tu song ④ste sdod pa'i rgyu ci yin/ de'i phyi bzhin blon po skyon chags pa gnyis 'gro ba de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha 'di'i mchid nas kho bo pha gsod7pa 'di'i rdul gyis mi reg par bya'o zhes mchi'o/ /rgyal po de ni yongs su mi rtog pa yin pas de skad thos nas khro bas kun nas dkris par gyur te 'khor thams cad la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag las gang dang gang nga la dga' ba de dang des dge sbyong mgo reg 'di'i steng du sa spar mo re res gtor cig /skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis sa spar mo re re 7 8—295

gtor to/ /rgyal po de dpung che ba yin pas re res sa spar mo re re ①tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po'i steng du gtor ba dang / de'i steng du sa phungakhuchen po rnam par gnas par gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos kyang de'i dbus su lo ma ma yin pa'i spyil bu mngon par sprul te 'dug go/ /de dag de las 'thor ③ba na ba lang rdzi dang phyugs rdzi dag gis mthong nas de dag smod bzhin du mtha' 'khor ༷zhing sdod pa na blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang / bhi ru ka gnyis phyi bzhin0'brang zhing 'ong ba phyogs der phyin nas de gnyis kyis dris paX/ shes ldan dag 'di ci yin/ de dag gis smras pa/ rgyal po 'thab krol can pha gsodasapa des 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po nyes pa med pa gnod pa mi byed pa sas bkab bosti/ /de gnyis mchi mas brnangs te ngu ba'i bzhin gyis ba lang rdzi dang phyugs rdzi dag dang lhan cig sa phyag ⑩par brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po byung nas de gnyis kyis rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te dris pa/ 'phags pa 'di ci lags/ des smras pa/ las dag yin mod gzhan ci zhig 'byung bar 'gyur8// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bdun bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa gtsug pud can skye bo phal po che dang bcas pas las 'di (nyelta bu bgyis pa gang lags pa de'i rnam par smin pa cir 'gyur/des smras pa/ deng nas nyi ma bdun na grong khyer sgra sgrogs tsosas non par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa rim ⑩pa ji lta bur 'gyur/ tshe dang ldan pa gnyis re zhig nyi ma dang po la rlung mo che byung nas grong khyer sgra sgrogs tho)rdo ba dang /gseg ma dang / gyo mo med par rnam par 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma gnyis 8—296

pa la me tog gi char 'bab ①par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma gsum pa la gos kyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma bzhi pa la dngul gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma lnga pa la gser gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyisanyen kor na gnas pa gang dag gisashelas mthun par byas pa de dag grong khyer sgra sgrogs sukhu'ajug par 'gyur zhing / de dag zhugs pa na nyi ma drug pa la rin po che'i char 'bab par 'gyur ⑧ro/ / nyi ma bdun pa la sa'i char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /20de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci lags/bdag cag gnyis kyang las de'i cha can lags sam/ bzhin bzangs gnyis khyed gnyis ni las de'i cha can ma yin no/ /'phags pa gal te de lta ⑧na bdag cag gnyis kyis grong khyer 'di nas ji ltar 'byung bar bgyi/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ⑨gnyis khyed gnyis kyis rang gi khyim nas chu klung gi bar du phug skor chug la khyim drung du gru bzhag ste sdod la gang gi tshe rin po che'i char 'bab pa de'i tshe na rin po che dag gis7gru 'gongs su chug la bros shig /de gnyis kyis de'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te grong khyer sgra sgrogs su zhugs nas de gnyisacargyal po'i gan du song ste smras pa/ ⑩'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po la cung zhig bgyis sam/ ci na dog sas bkabatunye/ des smras pa/ shes ldan gnyis de gson nam/ lha gson no/ /ci zer/ lha de 'di skad ces deng nas gdugs bdun yin grong 0khyer sgra sgrogs 0dog sas non par 'gyur zhes mchi'o/ /rim pa ji ltar 'gyur/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha de 'di skad ces re zhig nyi ma dang po la rlung mo che byung nas grong khyer sgra sgrogs 6)rdo ba dang /gseg ma dang / gyo mo med par rnam par 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma 8—297

gnyis pa la me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma gsum pa la gos kyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma bzhi pa la dngul gyi0char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma lnga pa la gser gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyisanyen kor na gnas pa gang dag gis las mthun par byas pa de dag grong khyer sgra sgrogs sukhu'ajug par 'gyur zhing de dag zhugs pa na nyi ma drug pa dul rin po che'i char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma bdun pa la sa'i char 'bab par 'gyur ro zhes mchi'o/ /blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis smras pa/lha bram ze gang la slong mo stsal nas yang bcad na de legs pa ci zhig sems teX/lhas de 'khor lnga brgya dang ldan pa la bsod snyoms stsal nas bcad cing sas kyang g.yogs pas de 'di skad mchi ba las gzhan pa ches shis pa'i tshig smra bar ga la 'gyur/ rgyal po gtsug pud can gyis bsams pa/ de bden no snyam pa dang /blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang / bhi ru ka gnyis kyis bzhin bsgyur cing lag pa gnyis yongs su dril te dong ngo / /de na he ru ka la bu sngo bsangs zhes bya ba khye'u zhig yod la/ bhi ru ka la yang ⑦bu mo sngo bsangs can zhes bya ba bu mo zhig yod nas/ he ru kus khye'u sngo bsangs tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po la phulasate smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te 'di la dge ba'i rtsa ba 'ga' zhig mchis na rab tu dbyung du gsol/ gal te ma mchis na 'di khyod nyid kyi zhabs 'bringalteb lags so / /sgyi ru gas kyang bu mo sngo bsangs can dge slong ma ri ma la phul te smras pa/'phags ma gal te 'di la dge ba'i rtsa ba 'ga' zhig mchis na rab tu dbyung du gsol / gal te ma mchis na kau shāsbyi na khyim bdag gdangs can zhes bgyi ba tsobadag gi chung po 4)grogs shig mchis pa de la gtad du gsol/ des khas 8—298

blangs so/ /de nas dge slong ma ri ma bu mo sngo0bsangs can khrid de rdzu 'phrul gyis grong khyer sgra sgrogs ②nas song nas/ des bu mo de kau shāsbyir khyim bdag ②gdangs can la gtadakyinas phrin ji skad spring ba yang bzlas so/ /tshe dang ldan pasnyitā tyā ya na chen po ni de nyid dukhu'adug go/ /blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang bhi ru ka gnyis kyis khyim nas chu klung gi bar du phug skor7bcug ste khyim drung du gru bzhag nas bsdad do/ /ji tsam na nyi ma de la rlung mo che byung nas des7grong khyer sgra sgrogs7de rdo ba dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo med par rnam par bzhag go/ /nyi ma gnyis pa la me tog gi char 'bab7pa dang / blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha rgyal po nga 7las nu la dgung bdun du dbyig gi char bab ces gda' bas lha la yang me tog gi char 'di bab pas ring po mi thogs par gos kyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma gsum pa la gos kyi char bab pa dang / blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha la gos kyi char 'di bab pas ring po mi thogs par dngul gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma bzhi pa la dngul gyi char bab pa dang / blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 8lha la dngul gyi char 'di bab pas ring po mi thogs par gser gyi char du'abab par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma lnga pa la gser gyi char bab pa dang / blon po skyon chags pa de gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha la gser gyi char 'di bab pas ring po mi thogs par rin po che'i char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi ⑥nyen kor na gnas pa gang dag gis las mthun par byas pa de dag grong khyer sgra sgrogs su zhugs shing de dag zhugs pa na nyi ma drug pa la0rin po che'i char bab pa dang / blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang /8—299

bhi ru ka gnyis kyis rin po che dag gis gru 'gengs su7bcug ste bros so/ /de na he ru nas7phyogs gzhan zhig tu he ru ma'i rtsalasazhes bya ba'i grong khyer rtsig tu bcug nas/ de'i ming0he ru ku'i rtsalasahe ru ma'i rtsal0ces bya bar gyur to/ /snyi ru kus kyang phyogs gzhan zhig tu gi ru ma'i rtsal7ces bya ba'i grong khyer rtsig tu bcug nas de'i ming bhi ru ku'i rtsalasagi ru ku'i rtsal7ces bya bar gyur to/ /nyi ma bdun pa la sa'i char 'bab par brtsams pa dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs su sgra mthon po dang / sgra chen po byung nas rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag sgra mthon po dang / sgra chen po de ci blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha sa'i char bab po/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de ltasnyin blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang / sgyi ru ka ga na 'dug tsotshol cig /de dag gis btsal ④bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na de gnyis bros par tshor nas/ de dag gis rgyal po la smras pa/ lha de gnyis bros te ma mchis so/ /de nas rgyal po gtsug pud can 'bros par brtsams pa dang / mi ma yin patsodag gis sgo bcad do/ /khye'u sngo bsangs kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa grong khyer du sgra mthon po dang sgra chen po byung ba 'di ci lags/ tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā ya na chen pos smras pa/ bu skar khung nas khar phor phyir phyung shig /des7skar khung nas khar phor phyir phyung 0ba dang sas phyed tsam gang bar gyur nas tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos bsams pa/ da dung spyod yul lhag ma dang bcas pa yin no0snyam mo/ /ji tsam na yang khar 6)phor phyi rol du phyung ba dang byur bur gang bar gyur nas/tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos bsams pa/ da ni spyod yul med par gyur gyis 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas grong khyer sgra sgrogs na gzhug mar gnas pa'i 8—300

lha mo gang yin pa de tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag kyang mchinyeste 'phags pa'i bsnyenakhubakur bgyi'o/ /des dang dusheblangs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā ya0na chen pos sngo bsangs la smras pa/ bu chos gos kyi gshenas zungakhushig dang 'dong ngo / /des chos gos kyi grwa ⑦nas bzung ba dang des khye'u sngo bsangs khrid de rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' lasasasong ngo / /sgra sgrogs7na gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha mo yang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyis de'i phyi bzhin song ba dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyang sas non par gyur to/ /de dag mthar gyis kha ra ba na zhes bya ba'i ri brags su yiphyin nas de dag de na g.yul gyi gzhi na 'khod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos khye'u sngo bsangs g.yul gyi gzhir bzhag ste bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / lha mo de'i mthus g.yul gyi gzhi der 'bru 'phel 8bar gyur nas de na mi gang 'dug pa des khye'u de mthong nas de'i gan du song ste smras pa/ kye khye'u khyod kyi mthus g.yul gyi gzhir 'bru 'phel bar gyur to/ /des smras pa/ kho bo'i mthus g.yul gyi gzhir 'bru 'phel bar gyur pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar grong khyer sgra sgrogasalgen gzhug mar gnas pa'i lha mo 'dir 'ongs te phyogs ga ge mo zhig na 'dug pa de'i mthus g.yul gyi gzhir 'bru 'phel bar gyur to/ /de de'i gan du song ste rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas smras pa/ lha mo bdag grong du mchi ste slar mchi'i7bar du re zhig lde mig dang /lde mig kyog 0po 'di gzung duzhing khyod kyis bdag ma lags pa gzhan su la yang mi stsal bar gsol/ des dublangs pa dang / mi de yang ri brags su chasong nas ri brags na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs bsdus te smras pa/ shes ldan dag grong 8—301

khyer sgra sgrogasatun gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha mo 'dir 'ongs te g.yul gyi gzhi na 'dug pas de'i mthus g.yul gyi gzhir 'bru 'phel ②bar gyur nas bdag gis de'i lag tu lde mig dang / lde mig kyogashepo byin te bdag gis de la bdagasnyegrong du mchi ste duslar mchi'i bar du ⑦ lde mig dang ⑧/ lde mig kyog po 'di gzung7zhing khyod kyis bdag ma gtogs pa gzhan su la yang stsal bar mi bgyi'o zhes smras kyisayi/ de'i phyir grong mi rnams la gal te bdag gi bu gtso bor dbang bskur na kho bo bdag nyid srog dang 'bral bar gsol ba 'debs te/ de lta na lha mo bdag cag gi gnas nas tsogar yang 'gro bar mi 'gyur bas khyed cag longs spyod dag gis mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur zhing yams kyi nad thams cad kyang nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis de'i bu gtso bor dbang bskur nas des kyang bdag nyid srog dang bral bar byas so/ /de nas de dag byagis gnas de thams cad spos dang me tog gis mdzes par byas shing gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyis brgyan te/ gtor ma thogs nas lha mo de ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lha mo khyod 'di nyid na tsobazhugs par gsol/ /des smras pa/ kho mo ni 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po la bsnyen bkur byed pa yin pas 'di na kho mo'i gnas med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos smras pa0/ lha mo khyod kyis gang las lde mig dang / lde ⑥mig kyog dupo blangs pa dusoms shig /des bsam ④pa la zhugs ⑥pa dang /ji tsam na mi de dus la bab par mthong nas des gnas de na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho mo dam tshig gis gnas par bya ste/ gal te kho mo'i gnas gzhi ji lta bu byed du 'jug pa de lta bur 'phags pa'i gnas 8—302

gzhi ①yang byed du 'jug rgyan kho mo 'dug go/ /de dag gis khas blangs nas/de dag gisashelha mo de'i gnas ji lta bu byed du bcug0pa de lta bur0tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya rne chen po'i gnas kyang byed du bcug dugo/ /lha mo de'i gnas su mar me btsugs ⑦pa gang yin pa de des khyer te tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā ya na chen po'i gnas su 'dzugs par byed do/ /de mar me khyer te 'gro ba rtsig drung na 'dug pa'i mi zhig gis mthong nas des bsams pa/ lha mo 'di 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po'i gan du 'dong bas 'gro'o snyam pa dang / des de'i sems shes nas khros te ri bragasaku'adi na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs 'di ni sdig pa'i sems kun du spyod pa yin te/ 'phags pa kā tyā ⑨ya na chen po 'dod pa'i dri nga ba med pa la brdzun gyis skur pa 'debs par byed do snyam nas/ des ri bragasalgeder mi ngas phyung ste skye bo phal po che shi bar gyur nas skye bo shi ba'i ro phyir 'byin pa na khri dang khri chadag 'dom par gyur to/ /gnas de na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis ltas pa dag bkug ste/ dris pa/ 'di ci las gyur/ de dag gis smras pa/ lha mo 'khrugs so/ /de dag gis de la bzod pa gsol bar brtsams pa dang / des smras pa/ khyed cag 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po 'dod pa'i dri nga ba med pa la brdzun gyis skur pa7'debs par byed do/ /de dag gis yang smras pa/ lha mo bzod pa mdzod cig dang 'ga' yang bsnyen bkur ma lags pa bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ dam tshig gis bzod par bya ste/ gal te khyed cag kho mo la ji ltar bsnyen bkur byed pa de ltar 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po la yang byed na bzod par bya'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ lha mo ches khyad par du 'phags par bgyis bzod par mdzod cig /8—303

des de dag la bzod par byas so/ /de dag gis kyang tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po la ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i bsnyen bkur byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā ya na chen pos de nyid du dbyar gnas par khas blangs nas khye'u sngo bsangs khrid de lha mo la smras nas 'phags pa dang / lha mos smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag la mtshan ma cung ①zhig stsol cig dang bdag de la mchod pa bgyid cing mchis so/ /des de la khar7lor byin nas des de lasakhas phub ste mchod rten du byas nas dus ston byed du bcug nas/ khar phor gyi dus ston khar phor gyi dus ston0zhes bya ba'i ming du gyur te/ deng sang yang dge slong mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba dag phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /khye'u sngo bsangs tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po'i chos gos kyi grwakunas 'jus7te de 'phyang zhing 'gro ba ba lang rdzi dang phyugs rdzi dag gis mthong nas/ de dag gis 'phyang ba pa 'phyang ba pa ⑩zhes bya ba'i sgra chen po phyung ⑩bas yul de'i mi rnams kyi 0ming 'phyang ba pa 'phyang ba pa byazhes bya ba'i ming du gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā ya 8na chen po'i tsori brags ⑩shig tu phyin nas der khye'u sngo bsangs shing ljon pa'i drung du bzhag ste bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /ri brags 8de na rgyal po bu med par ⑪dus la bab nas pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang blon po dang / yul mi dag 'dus te smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang zhig rgyal por dbang bskur bar bya/ de na kha cig gis0smras pa/ gang bsod nams dang dbang che bar grags pa'o/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ de ji ltar shes par bya/ kha cig gis smras pa/ rtog pa dag bsgo bar bya'o/ /de dag gis rtog pa dag bskos nas de dag gis phan tshun btsal bar brtsams pa dang / de dag gis khye'u de shing ljon pa'i drung na 8—304

gnyid log patumathong nas/ de dag gis de'i mtshan ma gzungarkyubar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na shing sngon pa gzhan dag gisagrib ma shar phyogs su gzhol ba dang / shar phyogs su 'bab pa dang / shar phyogs su bab0par gyur na shing ljon pa de'i grib mas khye'u de'i lus mi gtong bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag khye'u 'di bsod nams dang dbang che bar grags pa yin gyis ⑤'di dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de dag gis de sad par byas te smras pa/ khye'u rgyal srid long0shig /khye'us smras pa/ kho bo rgyal srid don du gnyer ba ma yin te/ kho bo ni/ 'phags pa kā tyā yalgen chen po'i bsnyen bkur ba yin no/ /nitshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos thos nas ci khye'u 'di la rgyal srid du 'gyur ba'i las dag yod dam med snyam du bsams nasanyeyod par mthong nas des smras pa/ bu rgyal srid long ⑩la 'di ltar khyod kyis chos kyis byed du chug shig /des mnos te/ de dag gis de dbang bskur nas khye'u sngo bsangs kyis der rgyal srid byed du bcug pas sngo bsangs kyi rgyal srid sngo bsangs kyi rgyal srid ces bya ba'i ming du gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po yul bog ka nar phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po'i ma bog ka nar skyes pa des tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po mthong nas smras pa/bu khyod yun ring zhig lon nas mthong ngo / / bu khyod yun ring zhig lon nas mthong ngo / zhade'i nu ma gnyis las kyang 'o ma'i rgyun 'dzag go/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos de la yum yum zhes bag phab pa dang / des tshe dang ldan pa kā ljo ya tson chen po 0zan byin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal bsridang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong 8—305

du chud nas gang thos nas/ des stan⑥de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la ltakhuba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de lta bur 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhisayang dag par so sor rtogs ④par byed pa'i chos bstan par byas so/ /des bden pa mthong nas btsun pas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gisalgem bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes0dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasal/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro dang yi dgas dag nasasnyeni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag go zhes lan gsum ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /yang smras pa0/ dka'apheb byed pa'i ma la ni/ / bu pho bzang pos gang bya ba/ /de ni khyod kyis bdag la bgyis/ /sems ni mtho ris gzhol bar gyur0/ /ngan song dag nas legs phyung zhing / /khyod kyis mtho ris thar pa la/ /rab tu 'bad pas bdag bzhag ste/ /khyod kyis dka' ba legs par mdzad/ /tshong pas khe spogs rnyed pa ltar/ /mtho ris rnyed pa bdag gis rnyed/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la ni/ /nye bar brten pa bzang ba lags/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos bu mo bzang mo de bden pa dag la bzhag nas smras pa/ yum bltas lags kyis ⑥bdag mchi'o()/ /des smras pa/ bu gal te de lta na bdag la mtshan ma cung 8—306

zhig stsol cig dang bdag de la mchod pa bgyid cing mchis so/ /des de la kharatub byin nas des mchod rten byas te/ derakhubatsugasalgenas khar ba'i mchod rten khar duba'i mchod rten zhes bya ba'i ming du gyur te/ deng sang yang dge slong mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba dag phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po yul dbus su 'gro 'dod nas yul sin dur duphyin pa dang /de nas byang lam na gnas pa'i lha mo gang yin pa des tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag la yang mtshan ma cung zhig stsol cig dang bdag de la mchod pa bgyid cing mchis so/ /des bsams pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis yul dbus su lham sgrog gu can bcang bar mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal pas 'di de la sbyin no snyam nas/ des lham sgrog gu can de de la byin pa dang / des gnas gzhi byed du bcug ste der bzhag pa dang / kha cig gis ni lham gyi dbang phyug ces bya bar shes so/ /kha cig gis lham gyi gzhi zhes bya bar shes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen po mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas dge slong rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so/ /ji ltarasnyebade bar brgyusashesam/ des smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag cung zad ⑩bde bar yang brgyusayi/ cung zad sdug bsngal bar yang brgyus so/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ ji ltar bde bar brgyusaX/ ji ltar sdug bsngal bar brgyus8/ des smras pa/ sems can gyi bya ba byas pa/ gang yin pa de dag ni bde bar brgyus pa yin no/ /rgyal po gtsug pud can dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs ⑩na gnas pa'i skye bo'inyetshogs kyis bdag sas mnan pa gang yin pa dang / blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang /8—307

sgyi ru ka gnyis tshegs7chen pos bros pa gang yin pa de ni sdug bsngal bar brgyusalgepa yin no/ /dge slong don nyung ngu dag gis sman⑧de smras pa/ de ni pha gsodakyipa yin te/ des tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya na dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa nyes gshemed pa gnod pa mi byed pa bsad derjo/ 'di ni de'i me tog tsam yin gyi 'bras bu ni gzhan 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pashesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa u tra ya nas las ci bgyis na des phyug pa nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i khyim du skyes shing / bcom ldan 'das kyisnyebastan pa la rab tu byung nasashenyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon ⑩du bgyis nas mtshon gyis bkum par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong u tra ya na nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba tsodag byas shing bsags pas u tra ya na nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur mi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag /sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa'i tshe 8—308
