rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang / bkren pa la rjes su snying brtse ba bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ bse ①ru lta bu gcig pu 'jig rten gyi yon gnas su gyur pa dag 'jig rten du byung ngo / /ji tsam du ri brags shig na ②rngon pa zhig 'dug ste/ ri brags ③de dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig na ri dgas dang bya mang po dag gi rten du gyur pa mtshe'u zhig yod pa der rngon pa0de nyi ma re re zhing ri dgas dang bya mang po dag drungs rjodabyung ba'i phyir dang / nyams par bya ba'i phyir dang / tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar bya ba'i phyir rngon spyad dang / rnyi0dang rnyong mang po dag 'dzugs par byed do/ /de'i rngon spyad dang /rnyi༅dang rnyong de dag kyang don yod pa yin no/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rang sangs rgyas shig ljongs rgyu zhing song ba na ri brags ⑧der phyin nas lha'i gnas shig tu mtshan mo gnas par khas blangs nas de snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te ri brags7der bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /der bsod snyoms brgyus ⑩nas bsams pa/ lha'i gnas 'di nyin mo rgyun lugs mod pa 7yin gyis/ ri brags kyi 8phyi rol gyi gnas zhi ba zhig tu bsod snyoms bza'o snyam nas de ri brags nas byung ste/ 'di ni zhi ba'o/ /'di ni zhi ba'o//zhes mtshe'u de ga la ba der song steyi/ phyin nas lhung bzed dang chu tshags mtha' gcig tu bzhag ste/ rkang pa gnyis bkrus byanas lag pa gnyis bsnyal te chu btsags nas/ lo ma rnyegs pa dag blangs te 'dug nas zas kyi bya ba byas te/ lag pa gnyis bsnyal nas kha bkrus te lhung bzed dang / chu tshags gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bzhag nas/ rkang pa gnyis bkrus7te shing drung zhig tu brten nas brang 'gro'i rgyal po nyal ba'i lus bskyil ba ltar skyil krung7bcas 8—309

te spyod lam zhi bar 'dug pa dang / de'i nyin mo mi'i dris ri dgas gcig kyang ma zin to/ /de na rngon ①pa de nang par sngar langs te ②mtshe'u de ga la ③ba der song nas/ des rngon 0spyad dang / rnyi ⑤dang rnyong de dag byul bar brtsams0pa dang / ri dgas gcig kyang ma mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi rngonasaspyad dang / rnyishedang rnyong 'di dag don yod pa yin na/gang gi phyir der ri dgas gcig kyang ma zin pa 'di'i rgyu gang yin snyam nas/des mtshe'u ⑩de'i then 0kor byul bar brtsamasalgepa dang mi'i rjes mthonganyenas/de rjes de'i phyi bzhin du 8song ba dang / rang sangs rgyas spyod lam zhi bar 'dug pa de mthong nas des bsams pa/ rab tu byung ba sems zhi ba 'di dag gnas 'di lta bu dag tu mngon par dga' bar byed pas gal te bdag gis 'di'i srog gcad 8pa ma byas na 'di dag gis nges par bdag gi ⑩'tsho ba gcod par byed kyis tho)rnam pa thams cad du 'di gsad par bya'o snyam nas/snying rje med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten pha rol btang ba des mda' dug can gyis gzhu rnga'i yidabyibs 'dra ba rna drung du thug par bkang ste yirang sangs rgyas de'i gnad du bsnun to/ /rang sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po des bsams pa/ rngon pa nyon mongs pa 'di ha cang mas pa dang / nyams par gyur na mi rung gis()/ 'di la lag nas drang ba sbyin no snyam nas des ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dabatsom brkyang ba ltar steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag bya bar brtsams so/ /so so'i skye bo ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du sems gtod par byed pa yin pas rngon pa de shing ljon pa rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du 8—310

rang sangs rgyas de'i rkang pa gnyis kyi drung du sgyelanyenas smras pa/ yon gnas yang dag par gyur pa mar gshegs su gsol/ mar gshegs su gsol/ nyon mongasakhu'adame du bying ba bdag gi sug pa nas drang bsastsal du gsol/ rang sangs rgyas de rngon pa de la rjes su snying brtse ba'i phyir steng gikhumakha' las shod du babs so/ /de nas rngon pa des0zug rngu med par byas te/ rma lhan gyis glan nas smras pa/ 'phags pa sdum par gshegs su gsol/ galashete 'dir gser gyi lhan pas glan7par mdzad na de yang bdag gis sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /rang sangs rgyas kyis bsams pa/ bdag gis rnag gi lus 'dis thob par bya ba gang yin pa thob zin pas de'i phyir da ni phung ponyelhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 'jug par bya'o snyam nas/ de rngon pa de nyid kyi mdun du yang nam mkha'i dkyil du 'phags te/ cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs dag rnam par bstan nas phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das so/ /rngon pa de nor dang ldan pa yin pas des spos kyi shing thams cad kyis phung por bcer 0te bsregs nas phung po de 'o mas tu)zhi bar byas te rus pa de dag gser gyi bum par bcug5nyenas lam po che'i bzhinemador lus kyi mchod rten rtsig tu bcug ste/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag bsgreng zhing dri dang / phreng ba rgyu dang / bdug spos dang / phye ma dang / sil snyan dag gis mchod pa byas nas rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te smon lam 'di skad ces/ bdag yon gnas 0dam ⑥par gyur pa 'di lta bu la gnod pa byas pa gang yin pa'i las de'i cha dang mthun par mi 'gyur bar mchod pa byas pa gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag phyug pa nor mang ba/8—311

longs spyod che bar skye zhing ①'di bas ②ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes par byed cing thugs byung bar mi byed pa'i yon tan gyi rnam pa de lta bu thob par gyur cig ces btab bo/ /dge slong dag de la de'i tshe de'i dus na rngon pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong u tra ya na yin te/ des rang sangs rgyas kyi gnad du mda' dug can gyis bsnun pa gang yin pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas bskal par sems can dmyal ba chen posamanar med par gdungs nas las de nyid kyi lhag mas tshe rabs lnga brgyar mtshe'u de nyid du ri dgas su gyur nas mda' dug can gyis gnad du bsnun cing dus la bab ste/ da ltar gyi bar du yang dgra bcom pa thob kyang de mtshon gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /mchod pa byas nas smon lam btab pa gang yin pa des ni da ltar phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che bar skyes shing nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon ༷du byas shing /'dis rang sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum pas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa nga mnyes par byas shing thugs byung bar ma byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar nasalas gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu dkar ba yin⑧/ las 'dren ma rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang 'dren ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag (sprepa rnams dang 'dren ma tho)rnams spangs te/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams zlo brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /yang tsodage slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/8—312

btsun pa rgyal po gtsug phud can dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogasanyen gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang / tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na chen pos las ci bgyis na des dog sas non⑧par gyur / blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang / bhi ru ka gnyis kyis las ci zhig bgyis na bros par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de dag nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin dukhunye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas de dag nyid kyis las byas shing / bsags pa dge gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'ishekhams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag la rnam par nismin par 'gyur te/las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri brags shig natukhyim bdag zhig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed0/dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur 8spyod par byed pa de la bu khye'u zhig byung ngo / /yang rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa de la bu mo zhig byung nas/de gnyis bsrings shing bskyed de chen por gyur to/ /bu mo de dang na mnyam pa'i bu mo dag slong ba 'ongs na/ bu mo de la slong ba 'ga' yang ma 'ongs so /8—313

sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa'i tshe rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang bkren pa la rjes su snying brtse ba①/ bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba ②bse ru lta bu gcig pu 'jig rten ②gyi yon gnas su gyur pa dag 'jig rten du byung ngo / /ji tsam na rang sangs rgyas zhig ljongs rgyu zhing song ba na ri brags ༷der phyin nas bu mo des khyim phyags dunas phyag dar rib ma'i steng nas bor ba de rang sangs rgyas bsod snyoms la rgyu ba de'i mgo la0phog go/ /bu mo des der phog pa mthong nas 'gyod pa'i sems kyang ma skyes la/ stes dbang gis de nyid kyi nyin mo de slong ba 'ongs nas7ming pos de la dris pa/ deng khyod kyis ci byas na des na khyod slong ba 'ongasal/ des smras pa/ bdag gis deng rab tu byung ba'i steng du phyag dar bor ro/ /des 'dzum phyung ba dang / bu mo des bu mo gzhan dag la sbran cing des kyang gzhan dag la sbran nas/ 'jig rten la bu mo gang dang gang slong ba mi 'ong ba des rang sangs rgyas kyi steng 'du phyag dar bor na de la slong ba 'ong ngo / /zhes sdig pa can gyi lta ba'i rnam pa de lta bu byung ngo ske/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams ni bsnyen bkur ma yin pas 'jigs pas rang sangs rgyas de ri brags de nas song ba dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams kyi steng du dor bar brtsams nas de dag kyang dong ba dang /pha ma dag gi ⑩steng du bor bar ⑩brtsams so/ /ri brags 8de na khyim bdag dge ba'i chos can gnyis shig 'khod pa de gnyis kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag dam pa ma yin pa'i chos 'phel ba 'di bzlog par bya'o/ /zhes de gnyis kyis bzlog cing spangs so/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na bu mo gang gis rang sangs rgyas kyi steng du phyag dar bor ba de ni rgyal po gtsug pud can 'di yin no//8—314

ri brags7de na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs gang yin pa de ni grong khyer sgra sgrogasakhun gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs 'di dag yin te/ 'di dag gis rang sangs rgyas dang / drang srong dang / pha ma dag gi steng du phyag dar bor ba gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin ②pas sas non par gyur to/ /khyim bdag gnyis kyis bzlog pa gang yin pa de ni blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang / sgyi ru ka gnyis yin te/ las de'i rnam par smin pas bros par gyur to/ /bu mo'i ming po gang gis 'dzum phyung ba de ni dge slong kā tyā ya na chen po yin te/ des 'dzum phyung ba gang yin pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas sas g.yogs te/ gal te dge slong kā tyā ya na chen pos yon tan gyi tshogs 'di lta bu rtogs par ma gyur du zin na/ dge slong kā kyā ya na chen po yang dusas non cing tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de ltar dun las gcig tu gnag ⑦pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag ⑧pa yin la/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ⑨rnam par smin ⑩pa yang gcig tu dkar ba yin/ las 'dren ma rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang 'dren ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag (sprepa dang 'dren ma rnams spangs te/ las gcig tu dkar 8ba rnams la brtsal bar bya stekho/ dge slong dag khyod 8kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /kau shāsbyi na khyim bdag nor bzangs 8zhes bya ba phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba zhig 'dug pa de'i khyim rgyal po shar pa'i drung na 'dug cing de nang par sngar langs te las kyi 8—315

mtha' dag la rtog tu 'gro'o/ /de dbyig gi gdangs can yin pas rgyal po shar pas sgra'i gdangs las de la gser bzhag pa 'bum yod par shes so/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po shar pa don gyi gnas na 'dug pas blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyim bdag nor bzangs ①nyi ma re re zhing nang par sngar langs te rang nyid las kyi mtha' dag la rtog tu 'gro stenya/ 'di lasnyegaser bzhag pa 'bum yod ces grag na ci'i phyir0bdag nyid ngal bar byed/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha 'di la gser bzhag pa 'bum ga la mchis te/ gal te 'di la gser bzhag pa 'bum mchis na ci'i slad du bdag nyid ngal ⑤bar bgyid/ rgyal pos0smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te khyed cag yid mi chesasnyin khyim bdag nor bzangasalgebos shig dang dri'o/ /de dag gis khyim bdag nor bzangs ⑩bos nas rgyal pos dris pa/ khyim bdag khyod la gser bzhag pa 'bum yod dam/ lha mchis te/ gal te bzhed na bzhes su gsol/ khyim bdag nga7ni gser don du gnyer ba ma yin gyi/ 'di ltar ngas khyod la ci yod dam med ces dri bar zad do/ /lha mchis te lhas ji ltar mkhyen pa de zhu'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod dbyig gi gdangs can yin pas ngas sgra'i gdangs shes so/ /khyim bdag nor bzangs rgyal pos gdangs las shes pas de'i ming khyim bdag gdangs can khyim bdag gdangs can ⑩zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rgyal pos de la smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod phyug por gyur pa yin na ci'i phyir khyod rang gis zhal ta byas te las kyi mtha' dag byed du 'jug /des smras pa/ lha gal te bdag gis rang gi zhal ta bgyis 0te las kyi mtha' bgyid du ma stsal na/ bdag gi longs spyod dag 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / yangs par yang mi 8—316

'gyur la/ lhas kyang bdag dbyig gi gdangs can lags7par mkhyen par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod ci'i phyir glang po che dang rtashedag gis mi 'gro/ lha bdag khyim khol lags pas glang po che dang rta dag gis mchi ba bdag gi tshul dang mthun pa ma rgyalags so/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/grogs 'di lta bus rgyal srid byed du gzhug par nus kyis④/ 'di blon po kho nar gzhug go snyam du rig nas smras pa/ khyim bdag blon po gyis shig dang /lhan cig tu rgyal srid byed du gzhugashego/ /des smras pa/ lha de skadababaka' stsal pa mi rigs te/ bdag ni khyim khol lags pas bdag zhing las kyi mtha' rjes su bsgrub ⑦par rigs kyi/ blon por mi rigs so/ /rgyal pos de lta de ltar nan gyis mnan na ci nas kyang gdon mi za bar khas len par shes te/ nan gyis lamanan nas des kyang khas blangs so/ /de ⑨nas rgyal pos de blon por bcug nas khyim bdag gdangs can gyis chos dang / rigs pas rgyal po'i bya ba dang / rgyal po'i byed pa dag bya bar brtsams nas/ des blon po gzhan thams cad zil gyis mnan pa dang / de dag phrag ⑩dog skyes te yid mi bde bar gyur nas 'dus te smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di ltar khyim bdag gdangs can gyis zil gyis 'amanan par gyur na 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/de na kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di la ci'i phyir bsgrub7tu med/ 'di ji srid du gtan du gting 0tshugs par ma gyur pa de srid du 'di la rgyal pos chad pas gcod du gzhug par bya'o/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ ma nyes kyis de ltar bya'o zhes de dag thams cad 'dus te rgyal po'i gan du dong nas smras pa/ lha rgyal po su lags/ des smras pa/ khyed cag gasnyelas the tshom za/ rgyal po nga 8—317

yin mod gzhan su zhig yin/ de dag gis smras pa/ lha gdangs can rgyal po lags kyi khyod ni ma lags te/ gal te de 'tshal bar gyur na lha ①bgrongs te rang nyid cod pan bcings nas rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug gi bdag po bgyid du stsol⑧bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir de de ltare 'gyur te/ de ni chos gtso bor ②byed pa yin pas ji ltar de ltar byed par 'gyur/ de dag0gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis7lha'i mngon sum du 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag gdangs can rgyal pos nye bar 'tsho ba'i rgol ba dang / phyir rgol ba dag gis yongs su bskor cing rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang du ༷thams cad skye bo'i tshogs kyis ⑦gang bar des rgyal po'i ⑧bya ba dang / rgyal po'i byed pa dag byas nas rgyal po'i pho brang nas phyir byung ba dang / rgyal pos nye bar 'tsho ba snga nashe'akhod pa dag kyang de dang lhan cig phyir byung ste rgyal po'i 0tshogs med par 'dug pa dang / blon po de dag gis rgyal po la smras pa/ lha gzigs sam/ bdag cag gis gsol pa gang lags pa de ni 'di lags te/ gal te 'di 'tshal bar gyur na lha bkrongs te rang nyid cod pan bcings nas rgyas srid kyi dbang phyug gi (sprebadag po bgyid du stsolasnyibar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos7bsams pa/ re zhig 'di brtag par bya'o snyam nas/ des de rgyu ba dang gnas pa las brtag par brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na byang lam nas ded dpon gyis zong rta ded de kau shāsbyir phyin nas rgyal pos gdangs byacan la bsgo ba/ gser 'bum gyis rta dag nyos shig /des gser 'bum gyis rta dag nyos pa dang / rgyal pos gdangs can la bsgo ba/ 'bum gyi phyed byin la 'di skad ces bdag gis ⑫8—318

'bum tshang bar7byin zin to/ /zhes byos shigal /des smras pa/ lhasade mi rigs te/ gal te de ltar bgyis na slan cad 'dir chibs rta 'tshong ba dang /gzhanasre'aga' yang mchisnyebar mi 'gyur gyis 'di ltar lha'i dkorashelas 'bum phyed stsol gcig dang bdag gis 'bum phyed stsal to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag nga'i tshig de bzhin7smras na 'di ci 'gal/ des smras pa/ lha bdag gis tshe gcig gi yisdug bsngal gyi don du tshe rabs tsomang po'i sdug bsngal skyed par rngo mi thog gong/ /rgyal pos de la lan gsum gyi bar du smras na yang de ma btub nas/ de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang gis rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bor dbang bskur ba'i bka' lan gsum gyi bar du bcag pa de'i chad pa ci yin/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha de'i chad⑥pa ni dgum pa lags so/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na ngas khyim bdag gdangs can yongs su btang ngo / /blon po rnams kyis mi gshed ma pa tsodag la bsgo ⑩ba/ shes ldan dag lhas bka' stsal 8pa/ khyim bdag gdangs can sod cig ces byung ngo / /rgyal pos mi gshed ma pa de dag la gsang ste bsgo ba/ khyed kyis khyim bdag gdangs can gsad par mi bya bar 'di ltar bsdigs ⑥par bya'o/ /de dag gis de'i mgrin par ka ra bī ⑥ra'i phreng ba btags te grong khyer gyi dbus nas gsod sar khrid pa dang / de'i nye du dag dong ste0 smras pa/ khyim bdag 'di la lhas bka' ci stsal pa de ltar gyis la bdag nyid gsod du ma gzhug dushig /des smras pa/ kho bos ⑦lha'i bka' chos dang ldan pa bcag gam/ ci gal te lhas kho bos nyes pa med pa gnod pa mi byed pa gsod na gsod du zad/ kho bos tshe gcig gi sdug bsngal gyi phyir tshe 8—319

rabs mang po'i sdug bsngal skyed par mi nus so/ /mi gshed ma pa de dag gis de gsodakyisar khrid de smras pa/ khyim bdag lhas bka' ci stsal pa de ltar gyis la bdag nyid gsod du ma gzhug shig /des smras pa/ kho bos lha'i bka' chos dang ldan pa bcagashegam ci/ gal te lhas kho bo nyes pa med pa/ gnod pa mi byed pa gsod na gsod du zad/ kho bos tshe gcig gi sdug bsngal gyi phyir tshe rabs mang po'i sdug bsngal skyedasapar mi nus so/ /mi gshed ma pa de dag gis de0rgyal po'i gan du khrid de smras pa/ lha khyim bdag gdangs can 'disnye'adi skadakyimachi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag nga khyod gsodarnyupar 'dod pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar brtag par 'dod do/ /des smras pa/ lhas bdag brtag pa'i dgongs pas gnas skabs 'di lta bu stsal na/ gal te bkyon na jisheltar bgyis par 'gyur⑩/ 'di ltar gal te lha bdag la dgyes na bdag sbyin pa dag stsol cing / bsod nams dag bgyid par ci gnang / rgyal pos smras pa/khyim bdag gal te de lta tson gnang gis 8ci dgar tsosbyin pa dag byin cig /bsod nams dag gyis shig /de nas khyim bdag gdangs can gyis sbyin pa'i khang pa rtsig tu bcug ste/ sbyin pa'i zhal ta pa mi bsko nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te 'dir sngon ma byung ba'i rtags dang / cha lugs can gyi dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ gzhan dag 'ongs par gyur na kho bo la sgron cig /ji tsam na lho lam nas drang srong7lnga brgya tsam yul dbus su 'phags pa de dag mthar gyis lam du 'dong ba na dgon pa'i lam du phyin nas de dag dgon pa'i nang du son pa na chu zad nas de dag chu dang bral bas skom gyisalgegadungs nas dgon pa'i lam der phan tshun byul bar brtsams pa dang / de phan tshun nyul ba 8—320

de dag gis ha cang thag mi ring ba na gsingatum sngon po'i7phyogs na shing ljon pa zhig mthong nas de na kha cig gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag gsingakhum sngon po'i phyogs 'di na shing ljon pa zhig snang gis tshur sheg0dang / 'di na chu yod par 'gyur gyis ltarashe'adong ngo / /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ legs kyis de bzhin bya'o zhes de dag dong ba dang ci7tsam na chu med par mthong nas de dag gis gsol ba gdab par brtsams te/ shes ldan dag sa phyogs dang shing ljon pa 'di0/ lha'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ dri za'am/ mi'am ci'am/ lto 'phye chen po gang gnas pa des bdag cag drang srong lnga brgya skom gyis gdungs pa rnams la chu byin cig ces smras so/ /ji tsam na shing ljon pa de las lag pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig gser gyi ril ba sgring 8gar thogs te byung nas drang srong rnams kyis snyim pa 8bzed de chu btung bar brtsams nas/ ji tsam na myangs na chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa yin te/ bsil ba dang / mngar ba dang / yang ba dang / 'jam pa dang /gsal ba dang / dri nga7ba med pa dang / 'thung na mgul la mi gnod pa dang / 'thungs pa na lto mi na ba yin te/ de dag tshim par gyur nas ril ba bkang ste shis pa brjod nas 'phags te dong ba dang / de dag la blo skyes pa/shes ldan dag bdag cag gis de lta bu'i ya mtshan mthong nas de la khyod su yin/las gang gis 'dir skyes zhes ma dris pa ni bdag cag nyams pa yin gyis()/tshur sheg phyir log la dri'o snyam nas de dag thams cad 'dus te phyir log nas shing ljon pa de'i drung du 'khod de smras pa/ shing ljon pa de la lha'am/ klu'am/gnod sbyin nam nam mkha' lding ngam/ dri za'am mi'am ci'am/ lto 'phye chen 8—321

po gang gnas pa gang gis bdag cag dgon pa'i lam du song ba/ gnod pa dang nyam nga btumi bde bar gyur cing 'chi ba'i dbang du gyur pa rnams la chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas tshim par byas pa des bdag gang yin pa dang / las gang gis 'dir skyes pa smros shig /ji tsam na shing ljon pa de las tshig byung ba/shes ldan dag 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi rnams ni yid ches par dka' ②ba yin pas kho bo su yin pa dang / las gang ②gis 'dir skyes pa yid ches par mi 'gyur bas ji ltar smra bar bya/ drang srong rnams kyis smras pa/ kye bdag cag gis mngon sum dukho nar mthong dun ji ltar yid ches par mi 'gyur/ the tshom ma za bar sgros shig /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de ltasan nyon cig dang / kho bo gang yin pa dang / las gang gis 'dir skyes pa smra ⑨bar bya'o/ /yul ko sa la dag na grong khyer mnyan yod ces bya ba de na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin zhes bya ba 'dug ⑩pa de'i khyim drung na kho bo bzang mkhan byed cing 'duganye'adug ste/ de mgon med pa rnams la zas sbyin par byed pas yul tha dad pa na gnas pa'i slong mo ba dag lhags shing lhags shing kho bo la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim gang yin byazhes dris 8nas/ kho bos lag pa g.yas pa tsobarkyang ste/ de dag la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi ⑩khyim 'di yin no zhes smras pa dnganye/ de dag gis de nas lag balgegang ba dang /snod gang ba dang / 'byor pa thob pa dang / rnyed pa thob cing 'dong ba de dag kho bos mthong ngo5) / /mthong nas mchog tu dga' ba skyed par byed de/ kho bo las des rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes shing / shing ljon pa tso'adi la gnas te/ de'i ④phyir kho bo'i lag pa g.yas pa shin tu lham ⑥me/8—322

lhan ne/ lhang nger gyur to/ /de dag gis shis pa brjod pas bstod7de dong ngo / /ji tsam nasaphyogs gzhan zhig tu phyin nas bza' ba dang btungakhub zad de/ de dag bkres pas gdungs shing skom pas gdungs nas kun du brtag par brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na ha cang thag mi ring ba zhig na shing ljon pa chen po lo ma sngo zhingasasnum pa zhig snang nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag shing sngon pa chen po lo ma sngo zhing snum pa 'di lta bu snang ste/ sngar yang bdag cag gis shing ljon pa 'di lta bu kho nas chu grub kyis 'dir 'dong dang gal te na chung zad 'grub par 'gyur li/ /zhes de dag der dong steshegasol ba gdab par brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag sa phyogs dang shing ljon pa 'di la lha'am/klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ dri za'am/ mi'am ci'am/lto 'phye chen po gang gnas pa de yibadag cag drang srong lnga brgya bkres pas gdungs pa dang skom pas gdungs pa rnams la zas dang skom byin cig ces smras so / /ji tsam na shing ljon pa de las0tshig byung ba/ shes ldan dag deng shig dang 'di nas ha cang mi ring ba na rdzing bu zhig yod pa de'i 'gram na shing sngon pa zhig yod pa de'i drung na 'bras chan gyis bre bo gang zhing 'dug pa de las zos shing 'thungs nas bza' ba dang btung ba ci 'dod pa khyer cig /de dag dong ba dang / ji tsam na rdzing bu bya ngang pa dang / kā raṇḍa ba dang / ngur pas mdzes par byas pa zhig 'dug pa de'i 'gram na shing sngon pa zhig 'dug pa de'i drung na 'bras chan tshod ma sna tshogs dang bcas pas gang ba zhig 'dug pa mthong nas/ de dag gis der khrus byas te zos shing chu 'thungs nas ril ba chus bkang ste/ bza' ba dang btung ba ci 'dod pa khyer nas shis pa brjod 8—323

de dong ba dang / de dag la btuskyes pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag gis de lta bu'i yalgematshan mthong nas de la khyod su yin/ las gang gis 'dir skyes zhes ma dris pa ni bdag cag nyams pa yin gyis tshur shegasaphyir log la dri'o snyam nas/de dag thams cad 'dus te phyir log nas shing sngon pa de'i drung du 'khod de smras pa/ shing sngon pa 'di la lha'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ dri za'am/ mi 'am ci'am/ lto 'phye chen po gang gnas pa gang gis dubadag cag dgon pa'i lam du song ba gnod pa dang / nyam nga ba ⑦dang / mi bde bar gyur cing 'chi ba'i dbang du gyur pa rnams la chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa dang / zas kyis tshimasapar byas pa des bdag gang yin pa dang / las gang gis 'dir skyes pa smras shig /ji tsam na shing ljon pa de lasashetshig byung ba/ shes ldan dag 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi rnams ni yid ches par dka' ba yin pas kho bo su yin pa dang / las gang gis 'dir skyes pa yid ches par mi 'gyur bas ji ltar smra bar bya/ drang srong rnams kyis smras pa/ kye bdag cag gis mngon sumatshwa)kho nar mthong na ji ltar yid ches par mi 'gyur/the tshom ma za bar smros shig /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na nyon cig dang kho bo gang yin pa dang / las gang gis 'dir skyes pa smra bar bya'o//yul ko sa la dag na grong khyer mnyan yod ces bya ba de na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin zhes bya ba zhig 'dug pa de mgon med pa rnams la zas sbyin par byed nas ri brags shig na bram ze zhig 'dug pa longs spyod srabs nas des bsam pa/ mnyan yod na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'dug pa de mgon med pa rnams la zas sbyin par byed kyis7de'i gan du song na de las cung zad 'grub 8—324

par 'gyur ro snyam nas de de'i gan du song ba dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin yang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bshos gsol bar 'dod nas rgyal byed kyi ཿtshal du 'phags pa na/ des de mthong nas smras pa/khyim bdag bdag la zas kyi mgron gyis shig /des de la smras pa/ bram ze tshur shog /rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'dong la der zo shig /de de dang lhan cig 'phags pa dang / ji tsam na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyisakhulam kur zho'i bum pa zhig rnyedasnyenas des de bram ze de la byinasnyenas smras pa/ bram ze'i0zho'i bum pa 'di dge 'dun la brims shig /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyisashesangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun zhal zas bsod pas tshim par byas pa dang / bram ze des kyang zho'i bum pa de dge 'dun la brims so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyisashesangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol nas khyim pa dag zan sbyin par brtsams te/ des khyim pa gzhan dag la ni zas bsod pa byin0/ bram ze de la nisnyengan pa byin pa dang / des de la smras pa/ khyim bdag rab tu byung ba rnams ni bslab pa yang dag par blangs pa yin pas re zhig 'di dag la ni bsod pa sbyin ⑩par rigs na/ bdag cag khyim pa bslab pa yang dag par ma blangs par 'dra na ci'i phyir khyim pa gzhan dag la ni zas bsod pa sbyin la bdag la ni zas ngan pa sbyin/ des de la ⑩smras pa/ bram ze khyim pa 'di dag kyang bslab pa yang dag par blangs pa yin te/ 'di dag gis kyang yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs so/ /des de la smras pa/ khyim bdag gal te bdag gis kyang yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong len na bdag la yang zas bsod pa sbyin 8—325

nam/ des de la smras pa sbyin no/ /des yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs pa dang / de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de zas bsod pas tshim par byas nas des zos te 'phags pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ bram ze yud tsam zhig sdod cig dang skom 'ong b.ratu'agyur ro/ /des skom 'thungs te song ba dang / nyi ma nub pa'i dus la bab nas mnyan yod dang ha cang mi ring ba na ri brags ②shig yod pa der bram ze'i khyim zhig tu gnas pa dang / bram ze des de la ②smras pa/ bram ze zan zo zhig /des smras pa/ kho bos0zan mi za'o/ /des smras pa/ ci'i phyir/des smras pa/ kho bo rjodage sbyong gi ta ma la yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs so/ /des de la dusmras pa/ bram ze gal te ༅re zhig za na de lta na⑧legs/ gal te mi za na kho bo'i khyim du gnas par mi bya'o/ /des7dus ma yin par zos nas gso sbyong ral lo/ /ri brags ⑩na gnas pa'i bram ze gang yin pa gang gis yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs nas dral7ba de ni kho bo yin te/ kho bos yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs te/thams cad ma dral7na kho bo sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur bcazhig na/ kho bos yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs nas dus ma yin par zos te/ gso sbyong dral bas kho bo rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ shing ljon pa 'di la gnas shing / de'i phyir kho bo la rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che ba mthu che ba gso stong ral zhes bya bar shes so// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bdun bcu rtsa gsum pa/ drang 8—326

srong de dag mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes te smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag drang srong rnams kyis dus 'di srid du brtul zhugs la gnas pas kyang 'di'i 'bras bu cir 'gyur mi shes na/ lha'i bu gso sbyong ralatu'adis bram zer gyur pa na yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs shing / de dralaphun yang 'disnyergyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes kyisaX/ bdag cag kyang gang du 'dis yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs pa der 'dong ngo / /de ltar bya'o zhes de dag gis gros byas te/ mnyan yod du 'phags nas ji tsam na mthar gyis kau shāsbyir phyin pa dang / khyim bdag gdangs can gyi sbyin pa'i zhal ta byed pa'i mi rnams kyis de dag mthong nas/ de dag gis khyim bdag gdangs can la sbran0pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis bdag cag la bsgo ba/ sngon ma byung ba'i rtags dang cha lugs can dag mthong na kho bo la sgron cig ces byung ba de dag lhags te sgo na sdod do/ /des smras pa/ 'jug tu chug shig /de dag gis 'jug tu bcug pa dang / khyim bdag gdangs can gyis de dag mthong nas dris pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag gang nas 'ongs/ de dag gis smras pa/khyim bdag lho lam nas sonya/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed kyis lho lam du ngo mtshar balgemathong ba dang thos pa ci yod/ de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag re zhig bdag cag gis sngar mthong ba dang thos pa'i ngo mtshar gzhan dag lta zhig gi/ te por mthong ba dang thos pa'i ngo mtshar gang yin pa dag smra bar byas nyon cig /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag —smos shig dang kho bo ngo mtshar de dag nyan to/ /de dag gis khyim bdag gdangs can la ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par brjod pa dang / khyim bdag gdangs can gyis thos nas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes ci 8—327

te de dgashezan byin nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang du 'dengs/ de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag mnyan yod du 'dong ngo / /shes ldan dag de na ci yod/ khyim bdag de na⑧lha'i bu gso sbyong ral gyis gang la brtenasate/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs pa'i khyim bdag mgon medakhuzas sbyin yod do/ /sde the smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na de kho bo'i yang masnyemathong ba'i grogs yin gyis7'di nyid du dbyar gyi mtshan mo gyis la dbyar 'das nas kho bo dang lhan cig 'dong ngo / /de dag de nyid du dbyar gyi mtshan mo gnas te/ dbyar 'das nas mnyan yod du 'phags pa dang khyim bdag gdangs can gyis bad sa'i rgyal po shar pa la smras pa/ lha bdag mnyan yod du bgyi ba cung zhig mchis na/ gal te lhas gnang na der mchi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag gal te de lta na song la khyod kyis don bsgrub pa byas nas myur du phyir shog shig /de rgyal pos gnang nas drang srong lnga brgya po de dag dang lhan cig 'phags te mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas skyed7mos tshal na sdod cing 'dug go/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis khyim bdag gdangs can 'dir 'ongs te/ skyed mos tshal na sdod cing 'dug go zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang des bsams pa/ bdag gis khyim bdag gdangs can ma tshor ba kho nar gnas su 'jug tu gzhug pa ni bdag gi tshul dang mthun pa ma yin gyis0/ bkur ste0chen pos 'jug tu gzhug go snyam nas des de bkur ste chen pos 'jug tu bcug ste lam gyis dub pa'i ngal bsos nas zan byin no/ /de nas drang srong de dag lhags nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis 'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba'i tshig gis kun du spyad de smras pa/ shes ldan 8—328

dag khyed cag gtulas 'ongs/ 'dir ci la 'ongs/ de dag gis smras pal/khyim bdag khyod kyis lha'i bu gso sbyong ral la gang byin pa de bdagashecag la yang byin cig des smras pa/ shes ldan dag༄mi dran no/ /khyim bdag bdag cag gis khyod la dran par bya'o/ /shes ldan dag legs so/ /de dag gis dran par byas nas des smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci kho bo las len namanya/ 'on te bcom ldan 'das las len/ khyim bdag khyod kyis su las blangs/ shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das las so/ /khyim bdag gal te de lta7na bdag cag kyang de kho na las len to/ /shes ldan dag legs kyisaXde ltar gyis shig ces des de dag khrid de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i mdun ⑨na chos ston cing bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin thag ring po kho na nas gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 0khyim bdag mgon med zes sbyin thag ring thotepo kho na nas 'ong ba mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong ngo / /dge slong dag khyim bdag mgon med zas7sbyin 'di skyes dang bcas pas 'ong gho/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes ni 'di ltar gdul ba'i 8skyes lta bu gzhan med do/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin drang srong lnga brgya'i tso'akhor dang bcas pas tsobacom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa drang srong lnga brgya po 'di dag bcom ldan 'das las yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong len par 'tshal na/ de'i slad du bcom 8—329

ldan 'das kyis 'di dag ci nas kyang sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi ba dang / dge bsnyenatunyid du 'tshal bar 'gyur ba de ltarasrechos bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drang srong lnga brgya po de dag gi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas gang thos nas drang srong lnga brgya po de dag gis phyir mi 'ong ba'i ②'bras bu ༷mngon sum du byas pa de lta bur 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yang dag par so sor rtogasalgepar byed pa'i chos bstan pa0mdzad do/ /de dag gis bden pa mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs te gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang / rdzogs par bsnyen pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thob cing bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs ⑦par spyad pa ⑧spyod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la dge slong tshur shog ces pas rab tu phyung zhing7dge slong dag tshur shog /tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi bka'i mjug kho nar skra byi ba dang / snam sbyar gyon par gyur te/ skra dang kha spu zhag bdun skyes pa tsam dang / lag pa lhung bzed dang / bya ma bum gyis 'brel pa dang / dge slong rdzogs par bsnyen nas lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /yang smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /skra byi snam sbyar gyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhir gnas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la gdams ngag byin nas de dag gis spro ba dang / 'bad pa dang / brtsal ba dag gis nyon 8—330

mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon ①du byas shing dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthilasadu mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/tsan dan bzhag pa lta bu rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs dral bar gyur cing rig pa dang /mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pargya/ srid pa dang /'dod pa'i rnyedasapa dang / bkur stekyil rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang /nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjedakyipar bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag gdangs can bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag gdangs can la chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag par ston par mdzadargya/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug⑧par mdzad/ yang dag par7gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad cing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi dus sngar mdzad pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid gang yin pa 'di lta ste/sbyin pa'i bka' mchid dang / tshul khrims kyi bka' mchid dang / mtho ris kyi bka' mchid dang / 'dod pa rnams kyi ro myang ba'i nyes dmigs dang /kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa'i phan yon dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos dag rgya cher ston par mdzad do/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis de sems rangs pa dang / sems nyams bde ba dang / sems dga' 8—331

ba dang / sems la sgrib pa med pa dang / yang dag phul gyi chos bstan pa kun shes pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing mthu yod par gzigs pa de'i tshe na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis7yang dag phul gyi chos bstan pa gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba dang /'gog pa dang / lam dag rgya cher ston par mdzad do/ /'di lta ste dper na gos dag pa nag nog med pa kha bsgyur du rung ba/ tshon du bcug na tshon legs par 'jen ②par 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ khyim bdag gdangs can gyis kyang stan ②de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs0par gyur to⑤/ /de nas khyim bdag gdangs can chos mthong ba dang /chos thob ༷pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs ⑦pa dang /som nyikhulas rgal7ba dang / the tshom las rgal ba dang / ston pa'i bstan pa la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang gzhan gyis mi bkri zhing chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so//btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yis bdag dge bsnyen du gzung 'du gsol/ deng slan cad nas ⑩ji srid 'tsho'i ⑩bar du glo ba thag pa nas mngon par dad pas skyabs su mchi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag gdangs can la bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag khyodane8—332

ming ci/ btsun pa bdag nor bzangs ①zhes bgyi ba las rgyal po shar pas bdag gdangasakhulas 'tshal bas7de'i slad du bdag skye bo dag gis khyim bdag gdangs can zhes bgyi bar ④'tshal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kau shāsbyir gshegs par gsol/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la ji srid 'tsho'isnyebar du na bza' dang / bsod snyoms dang /gnas mal dang / bsnyung ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag gis bsnyen bkur 'tshal lo/ /khyim bdag kau shāsbyi na gtsug lag khang yod dam/ btsun pa ma mchis so/ /khyim bdag dge slong dag ni gang na gtsug lag khang yod pa der bgrod pa dang / 'gro ba dang / gnas par sems so/ /bcom ldan 'das gshegs su gsol dang / bdag gis ⑦ji ltar kau shāsbyi na gtsug lag khang mchis par 'gyurngo bsnyedang / dge slong rnams kyang bgrod pa dang / mchi ba dang / gnas par sems par 'gyur ba de ltar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag gdangs can la cang mi gsung bas7gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag gdangs can gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song nas/ de la mnyan yod na bya ba'am/ byed pa ci yod pa yithams cad byas shing bsgrubs nas yang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la grogs dge slong 'ga' zhig stsol cig dang bdag gis 8de dang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du gtsug lag khang rtsig tu stsal bar bgyi'o/ /8—333

bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag gdangs can 'khor dang bcas pa dang /kau shāsbyi na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dag dge slong ①gang gi gdul rgyab yin snyam du dgongs na dge slong skul byed chen po'i gdul ba yin par gzigs nas/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen po la bka' stsal pa/skul byed khyim bdag gdangs can 'khor dang bcas pa dang / kau shāsbyi na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la soms shig /tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen pos bcom ldan 'das las cang mi smra bas dang du blangs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen po de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang / chos gos thogs te/ mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la brgyusasnyenas zas kyi bya ba byas te/ phyi ma'i zas kyi bsod snyoms las phyir log pas ji ltar longs spyad pa'i gnas mal mkhos su phab ste/ lhung bzed dang / chos gos thogs nas khyim bdag gdangs can dang 'grogs te/ kau shāsbyi ga la ba de0logs su song nas mthar gyis rgyu zhing 'gro ba na kau shāsbyir phyin to/ /de nas khyim bdag gdangs can kau shāsbyir ma zhugs pa kho nar kun dga'akhur ba nas kun dga'i ra bar skyedasamos tshal nas skyed 0mos tshal du0/ tshal nas tshal du dang yigol bar song ste/ gang du bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang rtsig tu gzhug pa'i sa phyogs kau shāsbyi nas ha cang yang mi ring ha cang yang mi nye ba nyin mo rgyun lugs nyung zhing klag cor chung ba/ mtshan mo sgra chung zhing bur sgra chung ba/ sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu dang / rlung dang / nyi ma dang / sdig sbrul gyi reg pa nyung ba de lta bu ci yod ces btsal na/ khyim bdag gdangs can gyis rang gi tsokun 8—334

dga' ra ba kau shāsbyi nas ha cang yang mi ring ha cang yang mi nye ba nyin mo rgyun lugs nyung zhing klaganyecor chung ba/ mtshan mo sgra chung zhing 'ur sgra chung ba/ sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu dang / rlung dang / nyi ma dang / sdig sbrul gyisareg pa nyung bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ sa phyogs 'di bzang gis ③'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang rtsig tu gzhug go snyam mo/ /de na khyim bdag gdangs can dang / tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen pos/ skyedakyimos tshal der bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang rta babs mthon po dang ldan pa/ skar khung dang / skar rjokhung skum po dang /lan kun gyis brgyan pa rtsig tu bcug go/ /de nas gtsug lag khang byas shing zin nas khyim bdag gdangs can gyis tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bcom ldan 'das shul du gshegs pa'i gshegasashedagongs7kyi tshad ci tsam/ khyim bdag 'di lta ste dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang 'dra'o/ /'phags pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i ji tsam/khyim bdag 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po lam du 'gro ba'i dgongs malasani rgyang grags bcu'o/ /khyim bdag gdangs can gyis rgyang grags bcu bcur gshegs dgongs sa dag shom du bcug nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar pho nya btang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kau shāsbyir gshegs su gsol/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' dang / bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang / bsnyung ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag gis bsnyen bkur bgyi'o zhes gsol to/ /pho nyas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 8—335

'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la dge slong dag bcom ldan 'das bad sa dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyisarkyukhyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig⑧bad sa dag tu ljongs rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos dag longasashig ces bsgo0shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin ⑤'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas dge slong rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das bad sa dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyis0khyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig bad sa dag tu ljongs rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos dag long shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba dang ldan pa/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba dang ldan pa/ grol ba 'khor grol ba dang ldan pa/dbugs phyin pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa dang ldan pa/ thul ba 'khor thul ba dang ldan pa/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa dang ldan pa/ 'dod chags dang ‘bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba dang ldan pa/ mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ khyu mchog ltar ba lang gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ glang po che ltar glang po che'i phrug nigu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ seng ge ltar mche ba can gyi 0tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar ngang pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nam mkha' lding ltar bya'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ bram ze ltar slob ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/sman pa mkhas pa ltar nad pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dpa' bo ltar ru pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sa mkhan ltar lam du zhugs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ded dpon ltar tshong pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor 8—336

ba/ tshong dponatultar 'khor gyikhutshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mkhar gyi rgyal po ltar blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'khor los sgyurakhub ltar bu stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ zla ba ltar rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nyi ma ltar 'od zer stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/yul 'khor srung ltar dri za'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'phags skyes po ltar grul bum gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mig mi bzang dultar klu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nor dusbyin ltar gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ thags zangs ⑥ris ltar lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ brgya byin ltar sum bcu ⑦ rtsa gsum ⑧pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshangs pa ltar tshangs ris kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/dbang po rnams kyis7shin tu dul ba/ spyod lam dang spyod pa ma 'khrugs pa/chu gter ltar ting nge ba/ sprin ltar chu dang bcas pa/ glang po che'i rgyal po ltar dregs pa dang bral ba/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus7sku rnam par mdzes pa/'od 'dom gang gis gzugs can brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun tu bzang ba/ stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇḍi rgya dang / rlangs pa dang / ming chen 8dang / ma 'gags 8pa dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu dang / 'od srung dang / kun dga' bo dang / nam gru la sogs pa nyan thos chen po dag dang / gzhan yang dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos bskor te/8—337

kau shāsbyi ga la ba der rgyu zhing gshegs nas mthar gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa na kau shāsbyir byon to/ /de nas khyim bdag gdangs can gyis gtsug lag khang yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa de bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul nas/ 'di ltar gnas brtan ①dag gis kyang / bcom ldan 'das kau shāsdi na gdangs can gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes mdo sde'i mtha' nye bar sbyar to/ /de nas khyim bdag gdangs canakhubacom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la gtsug lag khang phul nas dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba skyes te rang gi khyim du song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen po bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad tshopa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang /bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba/ rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhisashin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che bsregadags su rung ngam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la bka' stsal pa/ skul byed rung ste/ skul ①byed bdun po 'di dag ni gang dag dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'amanya/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las 8—338

byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhitushin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba dag yin te/ bdun gang zhe na/ skul byed 'di la rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la kun dga'i ra ba 'bul bar byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'amanya/gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/② rgyas pa che ba dang po yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dnge ldan pas kun dga'i ra ba de nyid du gtsug lag khang rtsig tu 'jug pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba gnyis pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas gtsug lag khang de nyid du gnas mal 'di lta ste/ khri dang / khri'u dang / stan nang tshangs can dang / la ba dang / sngas dang / gor bu dag 'bul bar byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad ⑤par 8—339

bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba gsum pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pasashegatsug lag khang de nyid du gtan gyi rkyen ris ②rjes su mthun pa'i mchod sbyin 'bul b.rasnyebyed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang /bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba/bzhi pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas glo bur du 'ongs pa dang 'gro bar chas pa la sbyin pa sbyin par byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'ams nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang /bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba lnga pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas nad pa dang nad g.yog la sbyin pa sbyin par byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad 8—340

par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba drug pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas rlung langs pa'am/ yul ngan byung ba'am/ char patubab pa'am/ lhagasalgepa byung ba gang dag yin pa de lta bu'i rlung langs pa'am/ yul ngan byung ba'am/charashebab pa'am/ lhags pa byung ba'i tshe dge 'dun la 'bras chan dag gam/skyo ma dag gam/ thug pa'i btung0ba dag bskyal7te/ 'dis 'phags pa 'di dag lus mi rlan pa dang / chos gos mi gsher ba dang / longs spyadasnyen bde ba la reg par 'gyur ro snyam pas 'bul bar byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ cirigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las 0rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba bdun pa yin no/ /skul byed rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi bdun po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i bsod nams sam/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu'am/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa 'di tsam mo zhes bsod nams kyi tshad gzung bar mi nus te/ 'di ltar bsod nams mang ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi phung po chen po zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /skul byed 'di lta ste dper na gang du chu klung chen po lnga po 'di lta ste gang gā dang / ya 8—341

mu na dang / sa ranyeyu dang / gnas can dang / ma hi zhes bya bsatha mi dad gar 'bab par 'gyur ba de la ni chu'am/ chu'i bum pa'am/ chu'i bum pa brgya phrag gam/ chu'i bum pa stong phrag gam/ ③chu'i bum pa 'bum phrag 'di snyed yod do zhes chu'i tshad gzung dubar mi nus so/ /skul byed de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi bdun po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i bsod nams sam/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu'am/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang 'di tsam mo zhes bsod nams kyi tshad gzung bar mi nus te/ 'di ltar bsod nams mang ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi phung po chen po zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/’mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba dum lags pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba gdags su rung ngam/ bcom ldan 'das kyisashebaka' stsal pa/ skul byed rung ste/ skul byed bdun po 'di dag ni gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyisabu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/8—342

phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba dag yin te/ bdun gang zhe na/skul byed 'di la rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos grong tshigs ga ge mo zhig na nye bar brtenatucing bzhugs pa thos shing thos nas kyang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par 'byung ba dang ldan pa thob par byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pā dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba dang po yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos de nyid du ②tshur gshegs par rtsol bar thos shing thos nas kyang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par 'byung ba dang ldan pa thob par byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba gnyis pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos de nyid 8—343

shul7du zhugs pa thos shing thos nas kyang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par 'byung ba dang ldan pa thob par byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba gsum pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos de nyid grong tshigs de nyid du byon par thos shing thos nas kyang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgyasachen po desnyedage ba nges par 'byung ba dang ldan pa thob par byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba bzhi pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos de nyid la blta ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir 'gro zhing mthong nas kyang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par 'byung ba dang ldan pa thob par byed pa 'di ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa 8—344

rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba lnga pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa chadang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos de nyid kyi drung nas chos tshangs par spyod pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba yang dag par rab tu ston pa nyan cing thos nas kyang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par 'byung ba dang ldan pa thob par byed panye'adi ni skul byed gang dang ldan na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/ mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar〈skye ba rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba drug pa yin no/ /skul byed gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'am de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos de nyid kyi drung nas chos thos nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro/ chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro zhing bslab pa'i gzhi dag len par byed pa 'di ni/ skul byed rigs kyi bu'amasarigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa rgyu ba'am/ gnas pa'am/ nyal ba'am/8—345

mi nyal ba las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig nye bar skye ba rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi shin tu 'bras bu che ba/ phan yon che ba/ snang ba che ba/ rgyas pa che ba bdun pa yin no/ /skul byed rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi bdun po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams sam/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu'am / bsod nams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ni 'di tsam mo zhes bsod nams kyi tshad gzungakhubar mi nus te 'di ltar bsod nams mang ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi phung po chen po zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /skul byed 'di lta ste dper na gang du chu klung chen po lnga po 'di lta ste gang hā dang / ya mu na dang /sa ra yu dang / gnas can dang / ma nyisazhes bya bsatha mi dad par 'bab par 'gyur ba de la ni chu'am/ chu'i bum pa'am/ chu'i bum pa brgya phrag gam/ ‘chu'i bum pa stong phrag gam/ chu'i bum pa 'bum phrag 'di snyed cig yod do/ /zhes chu'i tshad gzung0bar mi nus te/ 'di ltar chu mang ba'i phyir chu'i phung po chen po zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /skul byed de bzhin du rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi bdun po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyikyibu mo dad pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams sam/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu'am bsod nams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa yang 'di tsam mo zhes tshad gzung dubar mi nus te/ 'di ltar bsod nams mang ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi phung po chen po zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal te/ bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs rgyanas/8—346

ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mi dang ri dgas tshogs kyis bsten7pa yi/ /chu klung tha dad 'bab par gyur pa dag /mtsho mchog bkra shis gtsang ma ngogs bde ba/ /rin chen 'byung gnasakhurgya mtshor 'bab pa ltar/ /de bzhin bsod nams rgyun kyang rnam kun tu/ /sbyin bdag gos sbyin zas skom sbyin pa dang / /mal cha stan dang gding sbyin mi la 'bab/ /chu klung chu 'bab rgya mtshor ji bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/tshe dang ldan pa skul byed chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la yi rangs te ②mngon par bstod do/ /de nas khyim bdag gdangs ༷can ni dad pa dang ldan la de'i 'khor ni ma dad nas des bsams pa/ bdag gi 'khor 'di ma dad na bdag gi gtsug lag khang du ji ltar spyod pa jisnyebartag go snyam nas de cha lugs mi mngon par byas te sham thabs dma' bar bgosashenas gtsug lag khang du song ste tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mchod rten la phyag 'tshal nas gtsug lag khang du 'jug par brtsams pa dang / rgan zhugs shig sgo khang ⑧na 'dug nas des7de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ 'phags pa gtsug lag khang snying dang mig 'phrog par bgyid pa mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa 'di su'i lags/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag gdangs 0can gyi'o/ /'phags pa ci 'di gtsug lag khang lags sam/ 'on te phongs pa lags/ bzhin bzangs gtsug lag khang ni ji lta bu/ phongs pa ni ji lta bu/ 'phags pa gang na yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ni gtsug lag khang lags la/ gang na yo byad ma mchis pa ni phongs pa lags so/ /bzhin bzangs 'di phongs pa yin no/ /ji ltar gyur/khyim bdag de ni dad pa dang ldan pa yin na de'i 'khor ma dad pas mkho ba mi 8—347

stobs sol/ /'di ltar khyim bdag de la bu mo mngag gzhugasnyem mgu byed ces bya ba dad pa dang ldan zhing bzang la dge ba'i bsam pa can zhig yod na/ 'on kyang de'ikhukhyim de na dbang med de/ gal te de la dbang yod par gyur na de dge slong rnams la mkho ba stobs par byed pas 'di gtsug lag khang du 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag gdangs can gyis bsams pa/ da ltar bdag gson pa nyid na yang bdag gi gtsugasalag khang na dge slong rnams kyi gnas skabs 'di 'dra na bdag shi na ci 'dra bar 'gyur snyam du rig nas dge slong de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ rang gi khyim du song nas nang mi rnams la smras pa/ khyed cag las gang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed par spro ba des tshul shing long0shig /de'i tshe na mgu byed bum pa thogs te chu bcu ba'i phyir phyir byung ba dang / des der ras ma zhig rnyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyang de la phan gdags pa'i slad du phyogs der gshegs pa dang / des bcom ldan 'das la brtag par brtsams so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul gyis na bza' chos gos kyi grwa rgyardol bar de la bstan pa dang ⑨/ des bsams pa/gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi ras ma 'di bzhes su gnang na bdag gis 'di bcom ldan 'das la dbul lo snyam mo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i sems thugs kyis mkhyen nas bka' stsal pa/ mgu byed gal te khyod kyis yongs su btang na phul cig /des bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad pa byas nas gus pa bskyed 8de phul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de de nyid kyi mdun du na bza' chos gos kyi grwa glan te btsems pa dang / kha dog mthun par gyur to/ /de dad pa skyes pas 8zhabs gnyis la gtugs te smon lam 8—348

btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag bran7mor ma gyur cig /dbul b.rasnyem gyur cig ces smras nas bum pa chus bkang ste khyim du song ngo / /khyim bdag gdangs can gyis nang mi la tshul shingasabrims pa dang / mgu byed kyis smras pa/khyim bdag 'di ci lags/ gdangs can gyis smras pa/ mgu byed khyed cag las gang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed par spro ba des tshul shing long 0shig dang kho bo la longs spyod rgya chen po dag yod do/ /des myur ba myur bar chu'i bum pa bzhag ste tshul shing blangs nas smras pa/bdag sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bgyid par spro ste/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur bgyi yis0khyod thugs las chungaXngur mdzod cig ces des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs te gus par bsnyen bkur bya bar brtsams so/ /khyim bdag gdangs can gyis yang cha lugs mi mngon par byas te sham thabs dma' bar bgos nas gtsug lag khang du song ste tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mchod rten la phyag 'tshal nas gtsug lag khang du 'dug ⑦par brtsams pa dang /yang rgan zhugs gzhan zhig sgo khang na ⑧'dug nas des de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ 'phags pa gtsug lag khang snying dang mig 'phrog par bgyid pashematho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa 'di su'i lags/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag gdangs can gyi'o/ /'phags pa ci ⑩gtsug skyelag khang lags sam/'on te phongs pa lags/ bzhin bzangs8/ gtsug lag khang ni ji lta bu/phongs pa ni ji lta bu/ 'phags pa gang na yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ni gtsug 8—349

lag khang lags la/ gang na yo byad ma mchis pa ni phongs pa lags so/ /bzhin bzangasatu'adi sngon ni phongs par gyur pa las da ni gtsug lagasakhang du gyur to/ —/ji ltar gyur/ bzhin bzangasasakhyim bdag gdangs can la bu mo mngag gzhug ma mgu byed ces bya ba/ dad pa dang ldan zhing bzang la dge ba'i bsam pa can zhig yod pa de khyim bdag des 'dir las su bskos 0te sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la yo byad thams cad kyis stobs shig ces bsgo nas/ da 0ltar de sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byed pas des na 'di gtsug lag khang yin te phongs pa ma yin no/ /khyim0bdag gdangs can gyis thos nasalgedaga' ste khyim du song nas des bu mo mgu byed kyi lag tu lde mig dang / lde mig kyog po gtad nas nang mi rnams la smras pa/ khyed cag mgu byed kyis ci byin pa des gnas par gyis shig /kau shāsbyi na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyang byubasdus te smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bos bu mo mgu byed 'di bran mo las phyungasheste khyim gyi bdag mor bcug go zhes bsgrags so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa khyim bdag gdangs can rgyal po shar pas gdangs las 'tshal ba la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da7ltar du ma zad de 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang khyim bdag gdangs can 'di rgyal po shar pas gdangs las shes par gyur te de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po tshangs byin phonyezhes bya bas rgyal srid 'byor pa/rgyas pa/ bde ba/ lo legs pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba/ thab mo 8—350

dang / 'thab pa dang / phyi dgra dang / nang 'khrug rab tu zhi ba/ chom rkunatudang ske/ mu ge dang / nad dang bral ba/ rsākhulu dang / bu ram shing gi phreng ba dang / ba lang dang / ma hesaphun sum tshogs pa byed du bcug ste/ chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal pos chos kyisakyirgyal srid byed du bcug go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na ltas pa dag gis lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bab par lung bstan nas rgyal po tshangs byin ༷gyis rang gi yul du dril bsgrag pa dubyed du bcug ste phyogs su bsgo ba/ nga'i yul na gnas pa dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi dag nyon cig /ltas pa dag gis lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bab par lung bstan gyis7de'i phyir khyed cag las gang dag la lo bcu gnyis kyi zan bdog pa de dag gis ni 'khod par bya'o/ /gang dag la mi bdog pa de dag gis ni gzhan du 'dong bar bya zhing lo bcu gnyis 'das nas phyir 'ong bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe na bā rā ṇa sī na khyim ⑧bdag gzungs byed ces bya ba phyug pa/ nor mang ba/longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung7ba yangs shing rgya che ba zhig 'dug pa des mdzod pa bos te smras pa/ kwa'i nang rje mdzod pa kho bo 'khor dang bcas pa'i lo bcu gnyis kyi zan yod dam/ des smras pa/ jo bo mchis so/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa'i tshe rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang bkren pa la rjes su snying brtse ba/ bsalgematha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ bse ru lta bu gcig pu 'jig rten gyi yon 8gnas su gyur pa dag 'jig rten du byung ngo / /ji tsam na rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya ljongs rgyu zhing 'dong ba na bā rā ṇa sīr phyin nas de dag khyim bdag gzungs byed kyi gan du dong ste phyin nas smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis kho bo cag rab tu byung ba lnga brgya la lo bcu gnyis su mkho ba stobs ⑫8—351

par nus sam/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag jitumadzod pa la rmas7te slad kyis gsol lo zhes des mdzod pa bos te smras pa/ kwa'i⑧nang rje mdzod pa kho bo 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rab tu byung ba lnga brgya po 'di dag gi lo bcu gnyis kyi zan yod dam/ des smras pa/ jo bo mchis so/ /khyim bdag gzungs byed kyis rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya po de dag la smras pa/ 'phags pa dag mchis kyisalgebazhugs shig dang gsol lo/ /de dag der 'khod do/ /ji tsam na rang sangs rgyas gzhan lnga brgya ljongs rgyu zhing 'dong ba na bā rā ṇa sīr phyin nas de dag kyang khyim bdag gzungs byed kyi gan du dong ste phyin nas smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis kho bo cag rab tu byung ba lnga brgya la lo bcu gnyis su mkho ba stobs ⑤par nus sam/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed la gsol lags na/ci'i slad du yang sgrub par mdzad/ khyim bdag de dag kyang gzhan la kho bo cag kyang gzhan no/ /'phags pa dag je mdzod pa la mesashete slad kyis gsol rnalo zhes des mdzod pa bos te smras pa/ kwa'ikhunang rje mdzod pa kho bo 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rab tu byung ba stong gi lo bcu gnyis kyi zan yod dam/ des smras pa/ jo bo mchis so/ /khyim bdag gzungs byed kyis rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya po de dag la smras pa/ 'phags pa dag mchis kyisashebazhugs shig dang gsol lo/ /de dag kyang der 'khod do/ /khyim bdag gzungs byed kyis sbyin pa'i khang pa rtsig tu bcug gho/ sbyin pa'i zhal ta pa'i mi dag dang spyan 'dren bskos nas/ spyan 'dren des nyi ma re re zhing song ste gdugs tshod la 'bod par byed do/ /spyan 'dren des khyi zhig gsos pa de nyi ma re re zhing spyan 'dren de dang lhan cig 'gro bar byed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na spyan 8—352

'dren de la brel ba zhig byung nas/ desalgerje 'di bsgrubs te phyis spyan drang bar bya'o snyam nas de gzhan⑧du song ba dang / khyi des de ma rnyed nas sngon goms pas rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi gan du song ba dang / der yang de ma mthong nas des skad phyungasango / /rang sangs rgyas de dag gi dgeX'adun gyi gnas brtan gang yin pa des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag spyan 'dren dus lasasnyeyol nas khyi 'dis spyan drangs kyis tshur spyon bzhud do/ /de ltar bgyi'o zhes de dag 'phags pa dang / spyan 'dren 'ongs te khyi des de mthong nas skad dbyung bar brtsams pa dang / spyan 'dren gyis bsams pa/ 'dis 'di dag spyan drangs pas des na bdag nyid chen po 'di dag byon gor ma chag snyam du rig nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed sus spyan drangs/ de dag gis smras pa/bzhin bzangs khyikhu'adis so/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ma nongs kyisalge slad kyis kyang gang gi tshe bdag la brel ba 'ga' zhig byung ba de'i tshe na 'di nyid khyed spyan 'dren par 'gyur gyis khyed cag gshegs su gsol/ dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag gzungs byed gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na mdzod pa gang yin pa de ni khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na spyan 'dren gang yin pa de ni bad sa'i rgyal po shar pa yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na khyi gang yin pa de ni khyim bdag gdangs can yin te/ khyim bdag gdangs can 'di de'i tshe yang rgyal po shar pas gdangs las shes par gyur la/ de ltar yang 'di des gdangs las shes so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i gan du mi stong thub gciganye'ongs nas rgyal pos de la smras pa/ kwa'i nang rje khyod su yin/ des smras pa/ lha bdag 8—353

stong thub lags so/ /rgyal pos blon ponyernams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag stong thub la 'tsho ba byin cig /de dag gis de la 'tsho ba byin no/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga dmar byung ba'i rgyal po bzosasbyangs gzugs can snying po lha brgyad khri dang ma ga dhā pa'i bram ze dang / khyim bdagashe'abum phrag du ma dang0lhan cig bden pa dag la bzhag pa de'i tshe na des rgyal po'i khab tu dril bsgragasalgepa byed du bcug ste bsgo ba/ rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang / yul tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs shes ldan dag nyon cig /nga'i yul du sus kyang rkun po mi bya'o/ /nga'i yul du gang rkun po7byed pa de ngas yul med par bya zhing brkus pa rnams kyi nor ni ngasherang gi mdzod dang bang ba nas sbyin no zhes bsgo'o/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa lar7byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gzhon nu'i dpe'i mdos btul ba de'i tshe na des kyang mnyan yod du dril bsgrags 4)pa byed du bcug ste bsgo ba/nga'i yul du sus kyang rkun po7mi bya'o/ /nga'i yul du gang rkun po byed pa de ngas gsad par bya zhing brkus pa rnams kyi nor ni nga rang gi mdzod dang bang ba nas sbyin no zhes bsgo'o/ /bar du yul ma ga dhā na gnas pa'i chom rkun pa gang dag yin pa dang / yul ko sa la na gnas pa'i chom rkun pa gang dag yin pa de dag mtshams kyi bar du dong stenye'akhod cing g.yul ma ga dhā nas don mthun pa gang dag 'ong ba de dag kyang 'joms par byed/ yul ko sa la nas don mthun pa gang dag 'ong ba de dag kyang 'joms par byed nas thams cad du yul ma ga dhā na 'khod pa'i chom rkun pa gang dag yin pa dang / yul ko sa la na 'khod pa'i chom rkun pa gang dag yin pa de dag mtshams kyi bar du dong ste 'khod cing 8—354

don mthun 'joms par byed pas don mthun 'gro ba dang 'ong ba rgyun chad de/rgyal po'i dpya dang lo thang mi 'du'o zhes bya ba de lta bu'i sgra grags par gyur to/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos de thos nas ru gcig btang na de bcom zhing rab tu bcom stenyephyir 'ongs so/ /de bzhin du ru gnyis pa dang / ru gsum pa btang na de yang bcom zhing rab tu bcom ste phyir 'ongs so/ /ji tsam na yul ma ga dhā nas don mthun yul ②ko sa lar 'phags pa de chom rkun pas ②'jigs pas rgyal po'i khab tu zhugs te bsel ba tshol bar byed nas blon po rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa/ lha stong thub 'di lha'i 'tsho bas 'tsho na ci'i slad du don mthun gyi bsel mi bgyid/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de 'gro la rag gis thongakyishig /blon po rnams kyis de bos te smras pa/ kwa'ishenang rje khyod rgyal po'i 'tsho bas 'tsho lasaci'i phyir rgyal po'i bka' bzhin mi byed/ des smras pa/ khyed kyis bsgo ba gang zhig7kho bos ma byas na de skad du spyo bar byed/ de dag gis smras pa/ don mthun 'di yul ko sa lar 'gros7'di'i bsol gyis shig /des smras pa/ ma nyes kyis de ltar bya'o zhes des mda' lnga brgya pa'i dong pa gnyis thogs te shing rtar zhugs nas don mthun gyi mdun du 'phags so/ /chom rkun pa rnams kyis de don mthun gyi mdun nas 'ong ba thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas/ de la pho nya btang ste bsgo ba/ chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon na re shing rta phyir zlog shig /gnod pa thob par gyur ta re zhes zer ro/ /des smras pa/ dpa' bo la dpa' bo'i7yongs su spang ba byin cig /chom rkun pa'i pho nyas smras pa/ ci khyod gcig pu dpa' bo yin nam/ kho bo cag kyang dpa' bo yin gyis tsophyir log shig /de nas phan tshun mda' khar ⑩dgye bar 8—355

brtsams nas des chom rkun pa'i pho nya'i gnad du bsnun nas de7phyir log go/ /de bzhin du chom rkun pa gnyis dang / bzhi dang / brgyad dang / bcu drug dang / sum bcusartsa gnyis dang / drug bcusartsa bzhi nas com rkun pa lnga brgya'i bar dag lhags nas des de dag gi gnad du bsnun nas de dag phyir log go/ / de bzhin dusachom rkun pa gzhanasalnga brgya lhags nas des de dag la smras pa/ ngas khyed ༷kyi chom rkun pa lnga brgya bsad na ༅khyed cag kyang srog gis 'gebs par mi 'dod dam/ niphyir log shig /chom rkun pa rnams kyis smras pa/ nged kyishegacig kyang ma sod na ci'i phyir nged phyir ldog khyod kyang rung nged kyang rung ngo / /des smras pa/ gal te khyed cag yid mi ches na gang dag ngas bsnun pa de dag gi go phud cig /de dag gis go 'bud par brtsams pa dang /gang gis ji ltar go phud yipa de de ltar dus la bab nas chom rkun pa de dag mi 'di ni gnod sbyin zhig go zhes byer te dong ngo / /stong thub mtshams kyi bar na mi'adug cing de don mthun yul ko sa la nas 'ong ba gang yin pa de'i bsel yang byed/ yul ma ga dhā nas 'ong ba gang yin pa de'i bsel yang byed do/ /des bsams pa/ bdag gis ci'i phyir phar 'gro tshur 'gro bya 'di nyid du 'dug par bya'o snyam nas des der 'khyim brtsigs te 'dug nas don mthun gnyi ga'i bsti gnas su'ang gyur/ de ⑩'brog na gnas pa yin pas 'brog gnas 'brog gnas zhes bya ba'i ming du gyur to// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bdun bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ 'brog gnas su don mthun dag lhags nas kha cig gis ni 'bras btsong bar brtsams so/ /kha cig gis ni phye btsong bar brtsams kha cig gis ni bee reg /kha cig 8—356

gis ni khuratub/ kha cig gis ni ril bukhubatsong bar brtsams so chang 'tshongasadag gis kyang chang btsongasabar brtsams te/ de nyid du 'khod nas der tshong 'dusashechags par gyur to/ /'brog gnas kyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po la phrin yig lha bdag0gis 'dir tshong 'dus btsugs kyis lhas 'dir zhal ta pa btangasnyiba'i rigs so zhes spring ngo / /rgyal pos bsams pa/ gang du bdag gi ru gsum bcom zhing rab tu bcom zhing 'ongs pa der des tshong 'dus btsugs pas de ni de nyid kyir7gyur cig snyam nas des de la phrin yig ngas tshong 'dus 0de khyod la byin gyis ⑩der dpya dang lo thang ci 'du ba de dag khyod nyid ci dgar spyod cig ces spring ngo / /'brog gnas su tshong 'dus btsugs ⑩nas 'brog gnas 'brog gnas zhes bya ba'i ming du gyur to/ /'brog gnas na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis bsams pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag gang cung zad bde bar gnas pa gang yin pa de thams cad 'brog gnas kyi mthu yin pas bdag cag gis 'di la phan pa cung zad bya gor ma chag go snyam mo/ /de na kha cig gis smras pa/ ma nyes kyis de bzhin bya'o/ /ci zhig bya/ de na kha cig gis smras pa/ bdag cag las gang su yang rung ba bag ma gtong bzlom/ bag ma len pa des de 'khor dang bcas pa zan sbyin zhing gos phrugs re yang bskon par bya'o/ /ma nyes kyis de ltar bya'o zhes de dag las gang bag ma gtong ba'amanya/ bag ma len pa des 'brog gnas 'khor dang bcas pa zan sbyin zhing gos phrugs re bskon par byed do/ /ji tsam na mi dbul po zhig bag ma len du nye nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag la 'brog gnas 'khor dang bcas pa zan sbyin zhing gos phrugs re bskon pa'i 'byor pa 8—357

ga la yod kyis①/ 'di ltar bdag gis bag ma de blangs nas dang po kho nar 'brog gnas la dga' mgurarnyuspyod du phul las/ des dga' mgur0 spyad nas de'i 'og tu bdag gisasaspyad par bya'o snyam du rig nas/ de 'brog gnas kyi gan du song ste mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ grong dpon bdag bag ma len du nye na bdag la khyod 'khor dang bcas pa dubashos gsol zhing na bza' phrugs re gsol ba'i 'byor pa ma mchis kyisargya/ 'di ltar bdag gis bag ma de blangs nas dang po kho canar khyod la dga' mgurarnyuspyod du 'bul gyisal/ khyod kyis dga' mgur 0spyad nas de'i 'og tu bdag gis spyad ⑩par bgyi'o/ /'brog gnas kyis smras pa/ kye7nang rje gang yang rung ba bag ma len pa'am/bag ma gtong ba de thams cad kyis kho bo 'khor dang bcas bakhezan7sbyin zhing gos phrugs re bskon mi dgos kyis khyod song la bag yangs su bag ma longanyeshig /grong dpon de lta lags mod kyi 'on kyang bdag 'di ltar dga'as7dang du bzhes shig /bud med kyi yul ni dbang po rnams 'phrog cing don du gnyer bar 'gyur ba yin pas 'brog gnas kyis dang du blangs so/ /des kyang bag ma blangs nas dang po kho nar 'brog gnas la phul nas des kyang dga' mgur spyad do/ /'brog gnas 'dod pa la 'dod chags kyis lhag par chags pas mi de la ’byams parngo bya bar trebartsams so/ /gzhan zhig gis de la smras pa/ kyi nang rje khyod la 'brog gnas te por byams par gyur pa 'di la rgyu ci yod/ des ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang / des kyang de bzhin bya bar brtsams so/ /gzhan zhig gis de la dris pa dang / des kyang de la ji ltar gyur pa brjod pa dang / des kyang de bzhin bya bar brtsams so/ /gzhan zhig gis kyang de la dris pa dang /8—358
